  • Lead and oversee the full lifecycle of event management initiatives, spanning strategic planning, vendor sourcing and oversight, logistics coordination, and budget adherence, ensuring alignment with overarching brand and business objectives.

jobs.description:
Supplier.io is the data foundation that enterprises build their supplier decisions on. Fragmented, duplicated, and unreliable supplier data quietly limits the ROI of source-to-pay platforms, analytics, risk, and AI initiatives, so we resolve, enrich, and continuously maintain the industry's most complete supplier identity, then put it to work for the teams that buy and the suppliers themselves. Relied on by companies across the Fortune 2000 for accurate data, our platform helps corporate procurement, finance, and compliance teams manage their vendor master, source diverse and sustainable suppliers, and mitigate risk, all from one verified identity instead of a dozen disconnected systems.

Our solutions turn that foundation into action: accurate data and continuous maintenance for teams managing a fragmented vendor master, sourcing intelligence built resolving even the hardest-to-identify suppliers, small, local, and diverse businesses, for teams tracking sustainability and compliance, and direct visibility for the suppliers themselves into where they stand with the enterprises that buy from them. Whether you're resolving vendor records, sourcing alternatives, or measuring program results, Supplier.io transforms complexity into clarity, so teams can lead with confidence and build supply chains that deliver for both business and community.

For more information, visit .

The Opportunity

The Director, Data Architecture owns the strategy, standards, and team behind how data moves through Supplier.io, from source systems and web-scraping pipelines through ingestion, transformation, and governed delivery into the warehouses and marts the rest of the business relies on. You'll operate as a peer to our other engineering leaders, setting data architecture direction jointly with the CTO, while staying accountable for the reliability, quality, and governance of every data workflow we run.

You'll lead two distinct groups: a Data Engineering team building new pipelines, models, and architecture, and a Data Operations Engineering team running and maintaining the processes already in production. In the near term, before the team and its processes are fully built out, this role is hands-on: you'll be designing pipelines, data models, and orchestration directly, not just directing from a distance.

What You Will Do

Data Architecture & Platform Strategy

  • Own the multi-year data architecture strategy across our data warehouses and operational data stores, including evolving toward a medallion (bronze, silver, gold) lakehouse model.
  • Design and own our data lake and warehouse architecture, including the formation and population of data marts that serve analytics, product, and stakeholder reporting needs.
  • Set the orchestration strategy and standards for all data workflows, including source ingestion, web-scraping pipelines, ETL/ELT, and automated workflow management, and standardize the tooling used across the function.
  • Own the infrastructure and administration behind our data warehouses and pipelines, including capacity, reliability, and cost.
  • Own data governance end to end: the policies, standards, and practices for data quality, lineage, access, retention, and classification across every system of record.

Team & Execution Leadership

  • Build, lead, and grow two functions: Data Engineering, building new pipelines, models, and architecture, and Data Operations Engineering, running and maintaining existing production data processes.
  • Decide how the function is organized as it scales, including when and whether to add management layers beneath you to run day-to-day execution.
  • Stay hands-on early: design and review pipelines, data models, and orchestration directly until the team is built out to carry that execution independently, and stay close enough to the technology afterward to make credible architecture calls.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with engineering leadership to keep data architecture decisions aligned with company-wide standards.
  • Work closely with data engineering teams on technical planning and delivery for our core data products.
  • Partner with product, analytics, and other business stakeholders across the company to understand data needs and translate them into warehouse and data mart designs.

Data Quality & Compliance

  • Define and enforce data quality gates, lineage tracking, and auditability standards across all data pipelines.
  • Own data access controls, classification, and retention policy across the data estate.
  • Ensure compliance-relevant and audit-sensitive data is handled according to governance standards as our data sources and customer base grow.

What You Will Need to Succeed

  • 10+ years in data engineering, data architecture, or related roles, including 5+ years in a Director or Manager-level leadership role owning architecture strategy and a team, not just individual delivery.
  • Deep, hands-on experience designing and operating cloud data warehouse or lakehouse architectures (Snowflake and/or BigQuery), including medallion (bronze, silver, gold) patterns.
  • Experience integrating a range of source systems (MongoDB, PostgreSQL, MySQL) and building ingestion and ETL pipelines from varied and unstructured sources, including web-scraping pipelines and background job orchestration.
  • A track record of building and scaling a data engineering or data platform organization, including deciding when and how to split engineering and operations functions.
  • Strong data governance background: establishing policies and standards for data quality, lineage, access, and retention in a regulated or compliance-sensitive environment.
  • Experience setting technical direction jointly with peer engineering leaders and influencing architecture decisions across teams.
  • Excellent communication skills, comfortable setting strategy with peer leaders and reporting data platform health, cost, and risk directly to the CTO.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience consolidating or re-architecting data platforms following an acquisition or significant data source expansion.

  • Background establishing data marts and self-service analytics layers for non-engineering stakeholders.

POSITION SUMMARY:

This position is permanently remote.

Qualified candidates must provide a stable internet connection and have a quiet and secure space that is free from interruptions to work from home

The Patient Services Rep is responsible for handling inbound and outbound communications for up to 6 BMC ambulatory practices. The Patient Services Rep will handle patient inquiries, scheduling/rescheduling appointments, following-up with patients resolving patient questions/concerns regarding medication reconciliation and refills, and insurance verification and authorization management. They will document and relay patient information to the Practices as required by the Practice’s Guidelines.

Position: Patient Service Representative (Remote)

Department: Ambulatory Call Center

Schedule: Full Time

ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES / DUTIES:

Essential Responsibilities:

  • The Patient Services Rep communicates with patients and staff using multiple advanced communication tools, including phone calls, online chats, emails, faxes or mail.

  • Answers and resolves patient inquires, in a professional, empathetic and patient-centered way, through the use of effective listening, written and verbal communication skills.

  • Utilizes established Practice guidelines to ensure patients issues are addressed in a timely manner and when necessary, transfers the call to the appropriate person at the Practice for additional consultation.

  • Uses a computerized scheduling system to schedule/reschedules appointments determining the right amount of time required for each patient appointment.

  • Provides accurate and detailed information and updates patients’ records, using Epic

  • Provides detailed confirmation to the patient detailing where and when the appointment is, providing directions as needed, providing applicable and language specific home instructions as well as instructions for any required labs or imaging.

  • Identifies opportunities to improve the work processes and environment, and changes in Practice protocols; remains current on new developments in health care.

  • Escalates appropriately any issues that fall outside of an existing protocol or process to meet the needs of the patient

  • Attends scheduled training sessions for phone support, customer service, systems upgrades, newly acquired clinical systems, additional practices or other relevant training sessions, as directed by manager.

  • Assists in the training/orientation of new personnel under the direction of a manager and/or supervisor.

  • Participates in staff meetings/is expected to identify process issues that are obstacles to providing a positive patient experience.

General Duties and Standards

  • Adapts to changes in the departmental needs including but not limited to: offering assistance to other team members, floating, adjusting assignments, etc.

  • Conforms to hospital standards of performance and conduct, including those pertaining to patient rights and HIPAA and privacy rules, so that the best possible customer service and patient care may be provided.

  • Utilizes hospital’s behavioral standards as the basis for decision making and to support the department and the hospital’s mission and goals.

  • Follows established hospital infection control and safety procedures.

  • Other duties as needed.

JOB REQUIREMENTS

EDUCATION:

  • A minimum of a High School diploma/GED is required.

KNOWLEDGE AND SKILLS:

  • Ability to explain complicated healthcare issues to patients with empathy and concern

  • Ability to empathize with and coach the patient in navigating the healthcare system

  • Effective interpersonal skills to with a diverse group of professional and personalities in a team environment

  • Excellent English communication skills (oral and written) with the ability to communicate effectively with patients over the phone and in email and other communications

  • Must be comfortable using multiple advanced communication tools, including phone calls, online chats, emails, faxes or mail.

  • Strong computer skills and knowledge of Microsoft Office applications (Internet Explorer, MS Word, Excel & Outlook)

  • Ability to document work in a professional and efficient manner

Position Summary

The Data Analyst II keeps data accurate, complete, and on time for a large enterprise Salesforce platform that exchanges records with multiple external partners. These positions process and validate incoming data feeds, correct data issues at the source, and produce the counts and reports that leadership relies on. Analysts must already be working with Salesforce data.

Responsibilities

  • Receive, validate, and load external partner data feeds against the data dictionary, and resolve rejected or inconsistent records.
  • Profile data, identify quality issues, trace root causes, and carry corrections through to closure.
  • Produce point-in-time counts, lists, and recurring reports on a fixed calendar.
  • Query and update Salesforce data using SOQL, reports, and Data Loader, following the approved request process.
  • Build and maintain dashboards and reports in Tableau or CRM Analytics.
  • Support data validation and reconciliation for the Education Cloud migration.
  • Communicate data issues and resolutions to external partners in the language of the data dictionary.
  • Estimate work in hours, log time against assigned Jira tickets, and document procedures in Confluence.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Data Analytics, Information Systems, Statistics, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of data analysis experience.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce data within the last 12 months: SOQL, reports, and Data Loader.
  • Advanced SQL and Excel.
  • Experience validating and reconciling data exchanged between organizations.
  • Experience with Tableau, CRM Analytics, or a comparable reporting tool.
  • Active Salesforce Trailblazer account with a public profile.
  • U.S. citizenship.
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a favorably adjudicated federal background investigation. A security clearance is not required.
  • Ability to handle and safeguard Controlled Unclassified Information.

Required Salesforce Certifications

The certification requirement must be current and verifiable:

  • Salesforce Certified Platform Administrator.

Candidates must list their certifications on their resumes and provide their Trailblazer profile URL. Required certifications will be verified before interviews are scheduled.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Salesforce Education Cloud or EDA data.
  • Salesforce Certified CRM Analytics and Einstein Discovery Consultant or Salesforce Certified Tableau Data Analyst.
  • Python for data validation and automation.
  • Experience supporting federal government technology programs.
  • Current favorably adjudicated federal background investigation.

Location: Remote.
The selected candidate must be currently located in, or willing to relocate to, a state supported by Tripoint Solutions corporate offices: AL, CO, DC, DE, FL, GA, IL, IN, KS, LA, MD, MN, MS, NC, NJ, OH, PA, SC, TN, TX, or VA.(No relocation assistance provided)

Clearance Requirements:

  • A favorably adjudicated (approved) National Agency Check with Inquiries (NACI) or equivalent (Tier 1 Investigation) or ability to obtain a government clearance.

About Tripoint Solutions

Our Agile teams are responsible for envisioning, launching, and operating the massive data systems and analytics platforms used to manage $14.5B in government procurements and $200B in military real estate assets globally. At TPS, we apply the power of cloud technologies to help the government think smarter and function better—for everyone.

TPS Company Values

Benefit Offerings

jobs.description:
Are you ready to be a big part of something big?

At Trader Interactive, we make buying and selling a great experience. We’re a group of go-getters who decided they didn’t want to settle for the status quo. We come together as one team to build value and drive innovation across our industries - but we have fun while we do it and make sure our people are always our #1 priority.

When it comes to your career, we want to provide big opportunities to help you make a big impact. But for this to be possible, we strive to feel small. Small enough to quickly change tack, small enough to learn from different teams and small enough to connect authentically with leadership.

What We Offer

  • An inclusive and supportive work environment where you can move your career forward and will have the chance to do work that has real, significant impact on the world.

  • The opportunity to be a part of a global group of digital marketplace businesses (CAR Group) located across Australia, Brazil, Chile and South Korea - collectively we have around 1,800 team members worldwide, and our Global Talent Exchange Program means you might just find yourself working in one of those businesses sometime soon.

  • Plenty of flexible leave options and employee benefits including up to 31 days of paid time off in your first year, continuing education with access to LinkedIn Learning, a full benefits package including medical, dental & vision, 401K with company match, and wellness program.

What You’ll Do

We’re seeking a results-driven Acquisition Sales Manager to lead and scale a high-performing team growing the supply side of our Recreational and Commercial vehicle marketplaces. You’ll drive dealer acquisition strategy, develop sales talent, and accelerate revenue growth through disciplined execution and performance management.

You’ll own the end-to-end acquisition engine, from territory planning and prospecting to closing, onboarding, and long-term dealer activation. You’ll set performance expectations, establish KPIs, monitor pipeline health, and ensure consistent attainment of revenue targets.

You’ll also build a scalable sales culture rooted in accountability, coaching, and continuous improvement. Partnering with Marketing, Product, and Operations, you’ll refine messaging, optimize go-to-market strategy, and position our digital advertising solutions as must-have, performance-driven channels for dealers.

Sitting at the intersection of sales leadership, ad-tech, and marketplaces, you’ll empower your team to understand dealer marketing objectives, consult strategically, and deliver measurable ROI. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Build, coach, and develop a high-performing digital sales team focused on new business and consistently exceeding revenue goals.

  • Lead sales professionals through a consultative sales approach to drive revenue and expand our digital solutions footprint.

  • Conduct regular one-on-ones, performance reviews, and pipeline coaching sessions.

  • Build, document, and improve new business development playbooks and processes.

  • Use data-driven insights to adjust strategy, coaching, and resourcing.

  • Monitor funnel metrics and conversion rates to optimize team performance.

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of B2B digital marketing/advertising experience in account management and/or business development.

  • 2+ years of people management experience.

  • Track record of exceeding budget and KPI expectations.

  • Experience selling B2B digital marketing solutions (marketplace, media, or marketing preferred).

  • Self-motivated, highly organized, and goal-oriented.

  • CRM experience (we use Salesforce).

  • Comfort developing actionable insights from large data sets.

Bonus Points

  • Experience and decision-maker relationships in the Recreational (Powersports, RV, Marine) and Commercial (Commercial Truck, Heavy Equipment) industries.

  • Familiarity with digital marketing, media sales, or technology platforms.

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business or a related discipline.

So come and join our team - because every role is a big role in our plans to go big.

TI proudly supports a diverse workforce, and we encourage candidates from underrepresented groups to apply. Trader Interactive is an equal opportunity employer where hiring is based entirely on business needs, job requirements, and individual merit.

jobs.excerpt: About SuiteOp Hospitality is one of the most human businesses in the world, and one of the hardest to run.
jobs.description:
About SuiteOp

Hospitality is one of the most human businesses in the world, and one of the hardest to run. Behind every great stay is someone who answered a guest at midnight, a cleaner who turned a home in two hours, and an operator holding it all together with spreadsheets and group chats.

We started SuiteOp because we've been those operators. Our founders ran rentals before they built software for them, and that's still how we build: we sit with operators, watch where their day breaks, and fix it.

Today more than 30,000 units run on SuiteOp, across short-term rentals and boutique hotels. With SuiteOp V2, AI agents take on the repetitive work, from guest messages to turnovers, so operators and their teams can get back to the part that matters: hospitality.

We're a small team (seed stage, $3M+ raised), headquartered in New York with customers around the world. We care deeply about the craft. We sweat the details operators feel every day, we ship fast, and we use AI in everything we do because it lets a small team build something great.

About the role

SuiteOp is growing fast in Europe, and we need someone on the ground to make sure every European operator who signs with us gets live and loves it. Onboarding is the heart of this role. You'll guide new customers from signed contract to launch day and beyond. Our onboarding is heavily powered by AI: agents handle much of the setup, and you'll be the person who makes sure every customer feels supported, confident, and ready. Then you'll help us make it even faster for the next one.

You bring energy to every conversation and keep momentum going. You guide customers confidently through each step, secure clear next steps, and get them live.

You'll work closely with our Customer Success & Solutions Lead in New York, and what you learn from European operators will shape what we build next.

What you'll do

  • Own onboarding from signed contract to go-live for new customers across Spain and the rest of Europe
  • Lead onboarding calls in Spanish and English: kickoff, configuration, training, and launch
  • Become a SuiteOp V2 expert and guide customers through best practices
  • Use AI to build onboarding plans, checklists, and timelines, so every account keeps moving without manual overhead
  • Turn customer conversations into clear, actionable feedback for Engineering, using Claude and our internal tools to spot patterns across accounts
  • Build onboarding guides, videos, and templates in Spanish and English that help customers succeed on their own
  • Watch account health and remove blockers before customers feel them

AI is how we work

Our team runs on Claude. It isn't a trend for us. It means less time on busywork and more time with customers. We're looking for someone who already works this way and loves it.

  • You build AI workflows and agents that make onboarding faster and more personal, and you can't wait to show us one you're proud of
  • You reach for AI first to draft, summarize, and organize, so your time goes to the customer
  • You don't wait for structure: you build it, then automate it
  • Bonus: you've built with Claude Code, n8n, Zapier, or similar tools

What you bring

  • You love helping people, and you stay calm and kind on a customer's busiest day
  • You can make a complex product feel simple
  • Native or fluent Spanish and English, written and spoken
  • 2 to 5 years in SaaS onboarding, customer success, account management, consulting, or a similar role
  • Experience running customer meetings and guiding customers through technical setup
  • Familiarity with tools like HubSpot, Intercom, Notion, or Zendesk
  • Organized and detail-oriented, comfortable managing several customers at once
  • Bonus: Portuguese, French, Italian, or German
  • Bonus: experience in hospitality, property management, or a startup

Why you'll love it here

  • You'll see the difference you make: operators get hours of their week back, and you'll hear it from them
  • You'll work closely with the founders and engineers, and your ideas will turn into product
  • You'll be one of our first team members in Europe and help shape how we take care of every European customer

Compensation

  • Base salary: €42,000 to €50,000
  • Equity in SuiteOp

This is a remote role based in Spain (Madrid or Barcelona is a plus), working European business hours.

If you love helping people succeed and want operators to fall in love with how their business runs, we'd love to meet you.

jobs.excerpt: Title: Regional Finance Coordinator Type of contract: Employment Contract duration: 24-month fixed-term contract with possibleextension Work time: Full-time position (40 hours per week) Reporting to: Head of Programme Finance Location: Home-based (ideally within GMT-6 and GMT time zone), with regular travel within the assigned portfolio Start date: February 2027 Application deadline: 08/12/2026 Background The Global Survivors Fund (GSF) was launched in October 2019 by Dr Denis Mukwege and Nadia Murad, 2018 Nobel Peace Prize laureates.
jobs.description:
Title: Regional Finance Coordinator

Type of contract: Employment

Contract duration: 24-month fixed-term contract with possibleextension

Work time: Full-time position (40 hours per week)

Reporting to: Head of Programme Finance

Location: Home-based (ideally within GMT-6 and GMT time zone), with regular travel within the assigned portfolio

Start date: February 2027

Application deadline: 08/12/2026

Background

The Global Survivors Fund (GSF) was launched in October 2019 by Dr Denis Mukwege and Nadia Murad, 2018 Nobel Peace Prize laureates. Its mission is to enhance access to reparations for survivors of conflict-related sexual violence around the globe, thus responding to a gap long identified by survivors. GSF acts to provide interim reparative measures in situations where states or other parties are unable or unwilling to meet their responsibilities. GSF advocates for duty bearers as well as the international community to develop reparations programmes. It also guides states and civil society by providing expertise and technical support in designing reparations programmes. GSF’s survivor-centric approach is the cornerstone of its work.

Role Summary

The Regional Finance Coordinator is the senior finance partner for an assigned portfolio of countries, projects and grants to implementing partners. The role combines business partnering, donor financial management, partner-finance oversight, financial risk management and supporting sound financial management of partnerships.

Working closely with Regional, Country and Finance teams, the role maintains senior finance leadership and operational understanding through regular engagement and programme visits.

Position Responsibilities

Programme, Partner and Portfolio Finance

  • Act as senior Finance Business Partner to Regional and Country Teams, providing financial analysis, advice and constructive challenge to support programme design, planning, resource allocation and decision-making;

  • Lead the technical budgeting, forecasting and financial monitoring processes, based on input from Programme teams;

  • Maintain a consolidated portfolio view and produce relevant analysis, forecasts, KPIs and scenarios, communicating material risks and ensuring agreed actions are monitored;

  • Provide financial leadership throughout programme and partnership cycles, from design and partner selection through implementation, monitoring and closure;

  • Lead financial part of partner’s selection and partnership building, assessments, agree proportionate mitigation and strengthening plans, and advise programme and partnership decisions;

  • Oversee partner planning, forecasting, reporting and disbursement recommendations, ensuring financial information is satisfactory;

  • Ensure appropriate use of GSF funds through proportionate partner review, monitoring, controls, audit and escalate to Head of Programme Finance when required;

  • Provide contextualised training and technical guidance and apply GSF partner-finance tools and minimum standards proportionately to partner maturity, context and capacity;

  • Maintain operational understanding through regular engagement with Programme Teams, partners and programme visits.

Project-specific Funding Accountability

  • Lead development and quality review of project-specific donor budgets, aligned with programme design, donor rules, cost recovery and delivery capacity;

  • Ensure appropriate grant set-up, coding, allocation, monitoring and documentation in coordination with the relevant finance function;

  • Lead or quality-assure donor financial reports, budget revisions and financial input to grant amendments, ensuring accuracy, timeliness and consistency with programme progress;

  • Oversee cost-eligibility reviews, donor audits and expenditure verifications, ensuring complete responses and follow-up;

  • Monitor grant compliance, co-financing, foreign-exchange, cost-recovery and financial risks, escalating material issues.

Financial Risk, Controls and Assurance

  • Maintain programme and partner financial risk assessments and ensure proportionate controls, mitigation, assurance and escalation;

  • Exercise delegated controls and approvals in line with GSF policies, donor requirements and authority limits;

  • Plan partner financial reviews and risk-based audits, follow up on priority actions, and contribute with portfolio insight to organisation-wide assurance processes;

  • Identify and escalate material errors, suspected misuse, fraud indicators, control failures and other material concerns.

Functional Leadership and Continuous Improvement

  • Contribute to practical finance and partner-finance policies, systems, tools and guidance, promoting reliable data, simplified processes and shared learning;

  • Coordinate detailed country, grant and partner-finance activities with the Programme Finance Officer where available, providing technical direction and review while retaining portfolio-level financial accountability;

  • Provide technical leadership, coaching and quality assurance to colleagues supporting the portfolio, and contribute to cross-functional planning and support across portfolios.

Position Requirements

Education and Experience

  • Relevant professional finance or accounting qualification, advanced degree in finance, accounting, business administration or a related field, or equivalent substantial professional experience;

  • 10+ years of experience in programme finance, grant or partner-finance in an international, multi-country and multicurrency organisation operating in complex or humanitarian contexts;

  • Demonstrated experience of financial business partnering, budgeting, forecasting, donor financial management, partner due diligence, reporting, financial risk assessment and audit;

  • Experience strengthening local or national partners and applying proportionate approaches across different levels of financial maturity and capacity;

  • Strong knowledge of financial controls, donor compliance, cost eligibility and grant-management requirements;

  • Experience working across projects, country, regional and global levels.

Other Requirements

  • Excellent written and spoken English and Spanish; French and/or Arabic would be an asset;

  • Strong analytical judgement and ability to translate complex information into practical recommendations;

  • Ability to combine constructive challenge with partnership, coaching and contextual sensitivity;

  • High integrity, accountability and ability to identify and escalate material concerns;

  • Advanced spreadsheet skills and proficiency using financial, grant-management and reporting systems; Power BI experience is an asset;

  • Ability and willingness to travel regularly, including to complex environments;

  • Commitment to GSF’s survivor-centred values, safeguarding, inclusion and responsible stewardship.

How to Apply

Please click apply to submit your application including two references by 8th December 2026 (midnight CET).

Kindly note only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

The Global Survivors Fund (GSF) is dedicated to fostering diversity, gender balance, and inclusion, reflecting the varied landscapes where we operate and the communities we work with. We welcome applications from qualified professionals of all backgrounds, cultures, and beliefs. We particularly encourage candidates from regions where GSF is active to apply.

At GSF, we are committed to enforcing stringent Safeguarding policies, covering protection from exploitation, abuse, harassment, misuse of power, and discrimination, as well as child safeguarding and financial and fiscal integrity. We uphold a zero-tolerance approach to any form of unacceptable behaviour.

Job Title: Executive Director, Global Medical Affairs – Obesity (Weight Management & OSA)

Job Location: Thousand Oaks, California, United States|Copenhagen, Capital Region, Denmark

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients


At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.


Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer.


As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.


Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Executive Director, Global Medical Affairs – Obesity (Weight Management & OSA)


What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In vital role as Executive Director, Global Medical Affairs – Obesity, you will lead the chronic weight management (CWM), patient impact expansion (PIE) and obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) Global Medical Affairs strategy and activities in Global Medical Affairs, Obesity and Related Conditions Area.


You will lead a team of Global Medical Affairs Leads to drive the development and execution of integrated CWM, PIE/OSA medical strategies that maximize Amgen’s scientific and clinical value proposition in alignment with product and franchise objectives.

This role will provide enterprise leadership across evidence generation, scientific communication, launch excellence, congress strategy, external engagement, medical education, and strategic partnerships. The successful candidate will collaborate extensively with cross-functional stakeholders to shape medical strategies throughout the lifecycle of Obesity and Related Conditions assets.

This role will partner with leaders across Global Development, Commercial, Access, R&D, and regional medical organizations to support the advancement of innovative therapies and optimize scientific engagement with the external communities.


Amgen continues to rapidly advance its Obesity and Related Conditions pipeline, requiring strong leadership to build scalable medical capabilities, support launch readiness, drive external scientific engagement, and ensure alignment across global and regional stakeholders.

This role will serve as a key member of the Global Medical Affairs Obesity and Related Conditions leadership team and will report to the Vice President, Global Medical Affairs Therapeutic Area Head.

Responsibilities:

  • Serve on the Global Medical Affairs leadership team to help shape Obesity and Related Conditions strategic priorities
  • Lead the development and execution of integrated global medical strategies across CWM and PIE/OSA
  • Partner with cross-functional leaders in Global Development, Commercial, Access, R&D, and regional medical teams to ensure alignment on scientific and medical objectives
  • Lead and develop Global Medical Affairs Leads to drive excellence in launch planning, evidence generation, scientific communication, congress strategy, medical education, and stakeholder engagement
  • Oversee global congress strategy and scientific engagement activities across Obesity and Related Conditions, ensuring strategic prioritization, cross-functional alignment, and budget stewardship across regions
  • Drive the development of scientific narrative frameworks, core content, educational initiatives, publications strategies, and external engagement plans
  • Engage with key opinion leaders, cooperative groups, professional societies, and academic networks to strengthen Amgen’s scientific partnerships and reputation
  • Support strategic planning and execution of medical education initiatives across physicians, nurses, pharmacists, and patient-focused stakeholders
  • Collaborate with Field Medical leadership to develop a coordinated approach to external engagement and insight generation
  • Ensure capture, analysis, and dissemination of scientific insights and emerging trends from congresses, professional societies, and external stakeholder interactions
  • Support launch readiness and lifecycle management activities for both marketed and pipeline assets
  • Provide strategic input into reimbursement, access, and value-based partnership initiatives
  • Lead resource planning, prioritization, and budget allocation to support Medical Affairs objectives
  • Drive innovation and operational excellence, including the integration of AI-enabled solutions across medical engagement, congress planning, stakeholder management, and medical operations
  • Recruit, develop, and mentor high-performing Medical Affairs teams while fostering a collaborative, patient-focused culture
  • Continue to strengthen Amgen’s reputation as a science-driven, patient-focused partner within the obesity and related conditions communities

What we expect of you

We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The executive candidatewe seek is an experienced leader with the following qualifications.


Basic Qualifications:

  • Doctorate degree & 6 years of global medical affairs experience OR
  • Master’s degree & 10 years of global medical affairs experience OR
  • Bachelor’s degree & 12 years of global medical affairs experience AND
  • 6 years of managerial experience directly managing people and/or leadership experience leading teams, projects, programs or directing the allocation of resources

Preferred Qualifications:

  • MD, PharmD, or PhD with expertise in obesity
  • Launch experience with GLP-1 based medicines
  • 8+ years of biopharmaceutical industry experience across Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, or related functions
  • Demonstrated experience supporting product launches and lifecycle management
  • Strong knowledge of evidence generation, scientific communication, congress planning, and external engagement strategy
  • Experience partnering with cooperative groups, professional societies, and academic institutions
  • Experience managing global and regional medical strategies
  • Expertise in medical education strategy and stakeholder engagement
  • Strong financial, budgeting, and resource management capabilities
  • Experience building and developing high-performing Medical Affairs teams
  • Strong strategic thinking, communication, and organizational leadership skills
  • Experience leveraging digital and AI-enabled solutions to improve medical engagement and operational effectiveness
  • Deep understanding of global healthcare systems, reimbursement environments, and commercialization processes
  • Knowledge of Good Clinical Practices (GCP) and global regulatory requirements

They will also embody the Amgen leadership attributes which are:

  • Inspire: Create a connected, inclusive, and inspiring work environment that empowers talent to thrive
  • Accelerate: Enable speed that matches the urgency of patient needs by encouraging progress over perfection
  • Integrate: Connect the dots to amplify the collective power of Amgen to drive results for patients, staff, and shareholders
  • Adapt: Lead through change by adapting to an ever-changing environment and defining a clear course of action to deliver results

What you can expect of us

As we work to develop treatments that take care of others, we also work to care for your professional and personal growth and well-being. From our competitive benefits to our collaborative culture, we’ll support your journey every step of the way.


The expected annual salary range for this role in the U.S. (excluding Puerto Rico) is $325,302 - $440,114. Actual salary will vary based on several factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills, experience, and qualifications.


In addition to the base salary, Amgen offers a Total Rewards Plan, based on eligibility, comprising of health and welfare plans for staff and eligible dependents, financial plans with opportunities to save towards retirement or other goals, work/life balance, and career development opportunities that may include:


  • Comprehensive employee benefits package, including a Retirement and Savings Plan with generous company contributions, group medical, dental and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, and flexible spending accounts.
  • A discretionary annual bonus program, or for field sales representatives, a sales-based incentive plan
  • Stock-based long-term incentives
  • Award-winning time-off plans and bi-annual company-wide shutdowns
  • Flexible work models where possible. Refer to the Work Location Type in the job posting to see if this applies.

Sponsorship for this role is not guaranteed.


As an organization dedicated to improving the quality of life for people around the world, Amgen fosters an inclusive environment of ethical, committed and highly accomplished people who respect each other and live the Amgen values to continue advancing science to serve patients. Together, we compete in the fight against serious disease.


Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer. We make all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

We provide reasonable accommodations to applicants and employees with disabilities, consistent with legal requirements. Please contact us to request accommodation.

jobs.excerpt: Director, AI Product Management Remote Opportunity About Reveleer Reveleer delivers a unified platform spanning risk adjustment, quality improvement, clinical intelligence, and member management for health plans and provider organizations navigating the complexity of value-based care.
jobs.description:
Director, AI Product Management

Remote Opportunity

About Reveleer

Reveleer delivers a unified platform spanning risk adjustment, quality improvement, clinical intelligence, and member management for health plans and provider organizations navigating the complexity of value-based care. Trusted by 80+ customer organizations nationwide, the platform integrates data, analytics, and intelligent workflow automation into one governed system designed to support traceable documentation across diagnoses, quality measures, and submissions. With regulatory expertise and transparent, human-in-the-loop AI at its core, Reveleer supports organizations working to advance care quality, strengthen documentation integrity, and sustain the operational readiness needed to navigate audits with confidence.

Role Summary

The Product Director, AI defines and executes Reveleer’s AI product strategy across Risk Adjustment, Quality, Retrieval, and the broader platform. You own a portfolio of AI capabilities from discovery through development, launch, adoption, and commercialization. The job is to turn clinical, operational, and customer opportunities into AI products that scale and deliver measurable value.

This is an AI-native product role. Product management has moved away from day-to-day execution and toward strategy, human alignment, and rapid prototyping. You frame the problem, design intelligent systems and agent workflows, evaluate model performance against business goals, and decide when a system needs more learning, more guardrails, or a change of direction. You use AI tools in your own work every day, and you expect your team to do the same.

You’ll partner closely with Engineering, Data Science, Clinical Operations, Legal/Compliance, Security, and Go-to-Market teams, and directly with customers. Together you make sure every AI release meets enterprise standards for accuracy, transparency, security, and responsible adoption.

Current Portfolio

Day one ownership includes the following. Scope will expand as Reveleer’s AI services converge on a shared platform.

What you own

GenECS-Generative AI for evidence capture and coding support; expansion, adoption strategy, and CSM enablement.

Skyline-Next-generation AI product roadmap, including release strategy for generative AI under customer and contractual constraints.

Retrieval / agentic AI-Agentic workflows that automate and accelerate medical record retrieval.

Smart Overread-ML-prioritized quality review that targets the charts most likely to contain errors while preserving objective accuracy reporting.

AI benchmarking-Reveleer’s Value-Based Care AI Benchmark and the evaluation methods behind it.

Emerging AI-New AI services and agents, prioritized against reuse across the platform.

Key Responsibilities

AI Product Strategy & Portfolio

  • Define and maintain the AI product strategy, portfolio priorities, and roadmap.
  • Find high-value opportunities to apply generative AI, machine learning, agentic workflows, and automation across Reveleer products.
  • Recommend investments and priorities based on customer value, operational impact, unit economics, technical feasibility, differentiation, and commercial potential.
  • Favor reusable AI services over one-off features so each initiative strengthens the broader platform.
  • Help score and prioritize candidate AI agents on value, economics, reusability, readiness, and risk.

AI-Native Discovery & Prototyping

  • Use AI tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, and Figma Make to speed up competitive research, synthesize customer and user feedback, and build working prototypes to test with users before committing to full development.
  • Run market and competitive analysis specific to payer, provider, and value-based care workflows.
  • Set the standard for AI-assisted product work on the team, and keep experimenting with new tools that shorten the development cycle.

Product Definition & Execution

  • Own AI products through discovery, requirements, definition, development, validation, release, and ongoing optimization.
  • Write clear product definition documents covering the problem, personas, workflows, scope, ML approach, operational workflow, acceptance criteria, and quantitative success metrics. These should be easy for AI, Data, Engineering, and Marketing teams to act on asynchronously.
  • Design intelligent workflows rather than standalone UIs: orchestrate AI agents, set human-in-the-loop checkpoints, and integrate models with internal and external APIs.
  • Work with Data Science and Engineering on model and product architecture, confidence thresholds, and integration into production workflows.
  • Define rollout strategies and adoption plans, including moving customers and users from legacy workflows to AI-enabled experiences.

AI Evaluation & Quality

  • Design evaluation frameworks that measure model outputs against business, clinical, and user goals. Contribute to Reveleer’s AI benchmarking program.
  • Be accountable for failure modes, bias, drift, and reliability in production, and decide when to add guardrails, retrain, or change direction.
  • Track both product metrics (adoption, retention, productivity, ROI) and AI metrics (precision, recall, confidence, latency, and cost per transaction).

AI Governance & Responsible Deployment

  • Work with Legal, Compliance, Security, Engineering, and leadership to set release and governance approaches for AI capabilities.
  • Spot contractual, regulatory (HIPAA, NCQA, CMS), privacy, security, and customer-policy constraints on generative AI early, and design alternative release paths when they apply.
  • Define controls such as customer gating, consent, human review, monitoring, and model-performance measurement.
  • Turn technical AI considerations into clear product decisions.

Commercialization & Customer Adoption

  • Build positioning and value propositions that turn complex AI capabilities into clear customer benefits.
  • Work with Sales, Customer Success, Marketing, and Clinical teams on launch readiness, pricing and packaging input, and enablement.
  • Build customer trust, readiness, policy, and contract considerations into rollout and adoption plans.
  • Represent Reveleer’s AI products with customers, advisory boards, and industry forums.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Connect Product, Engineering, Data Science, Clinical, Operations, Legal/Compliance, and GTM on AI.
  • Drive product decisions where clinical workflows, machine intelligence, operations, and customer requirements meet.
  • Explain direction, trade-offs, risks, progress, and business outcomes clearly to leadership, customers, and non-technical teams.
  • Lead product direction for shared AI capabilities that span multiple product lines, and share AI-native practices with fellow PMs.

Qualifications

Required

  • 7+ years of product management experience, including experience owning complex products or major platform capabilities.
  • A track record of taking AI/ML products from concept through production and commercialization.
  • Technical fluency in generative AI, LLM-enabled applications, RAG, fine-tuning, agentic workflows, model evaluation, and human-in-the-loop design, plus enough depth in APIs and data pipelines to hold credible conversations with engineering teams.
  • Hands-on, daily use of AI tools for research, synthesis, prototyping, and product definition.
  • Sound judgment when outcomes are uncertain and models are non-deterministic, balancing innovation, customer value, regulatory requirements, technical feasibility, and speed to market.
  • Experience working directly with Engineering and Data Science teams.
  • The ability to explain complex AI concepts to executives, customers, clinical stakeholders, and commercial teams.
  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science, healthcare management, business, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred

  • Experience in healthcare technology, especially payer/provider workflows, Risk Adjustment, Quality/HEDIS, medical record retrieval, or clinical data.
  • Working knowledge of HIPAA, HITRUST, NCQA, and CMS requirements as they apply to AI-enabled products.
  • Experience building AI evaluation or benchmarking programs, or publishing AI performance results externally.
  • A master’s degree or MBA.

How Success Is Measured

  • Business impact. Measurable revenue, retention, operational savings, or productivity attributable to AI products.
  • AI product adoption. How much customers and end users actually use released AI capabilities.
  • Model and product performance. Accuracy, precision, confidence, workflow effectiveness, and capability-specific KPIs. For example, Smart Overread targets 2 to 3x the random error-detection rate on prioritized charts while keeping random sampling for objective customer accuracy reporting.
  • Speed to value. How quickly a validated opportunity reaches production, including prototype-to-decision cycle time.
  • Portfolio execution. Delivery against the agreed AI roadmap and priorities.
  • Responsible deployment. Every AI release meets customer, contractual, compliance, security, and governance requirements.

WHAT YOU’LL RECEIVE:

• Competitive salary 

• Medical, Dental and Vision benefits 

• 401k match

• Generous PTO plan 

 Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several US geographic markets. Pay is based on several factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Reveleer E-Verifies all new hires.

Reveleer is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or genetic information, in compliance with applicable federal, state and local law.

Salary: $160,000 – $180,000 / year

Use your gas industry expertise to make a real difference to public safety, industry standards and the reputation of Gas Safe Register.

We are looking for an experienced gas professional to join the Gas Safe Register team as a Technical Support Officer. This is a home-working role and an excellent opportunity to move into a trusted technical advisory position where your knowledge, judgement and communication skills will help support registered businesses, stakeholders and members of the public.

In this role, you will provide clear, accurate and practical technical information on gas safety, associated building industries and ACS-related matters. You will play an important part in helping people understand their responsibilities, supporting compliance with relevant legislation and promoting safe standards across the gas industry.

Job title:

Gas Technical support Officer

Job Description:

About Gas Safe Register

Gas Safe Register is the official gas registration body for the United Kingdom, Isle of Man, Jersey and Guernsey. By law, gas businesses and engineers must be registered to carry out gas work legally. The register helps protect the public from unsafe gas work by maintaining the official list of competent businesses and engineers, supporting inspections, investigating safety concerns and raising awareness of gas safety standards.

Capita delivers the Gas Safe Register service under a concession arrangement with the Health and Safety Executive and related authorities. Together, we help maintain gas safety standards and give consumers confidence that gas work is carried out safely, legally and professionally.

Why Join Us?

  • Use your technical gas experience in a role focused on advice, guidance and public protection.
  • Move into a varied support role where no two enquiries are the same.
  • Influence safety awareness by helping stakeholders, gas businesses and the public understand key requirements.
  • Contribute to technical publications, guidance and bulletins that support the wider industry.
  • Join a service with a clear purpose: helping improve and maintain gas safety standards across the UK.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Respond to telephone, written and email enquiries from stakeholders, registered businesses and the general public, providing clear and professional technical guidance.
  • Provide information and advice on gas safety, associated building industries and Nationally Accredited Certification Scheme for Individual Gas Fitting Operatives (ACS) matters.
  • Support other Gas Safe Register departments with accurate technical guidance to help ensure compliance with relevant legislation and industry standards.
  • Research, write, review and edit technical articles, publications and bulletins, ensuring information is accurate, consistent and easy to understand.
  • Keep up to date with industry changes, technical standards and legislation so that advice remains current and reliable.
  • Provide cover and support across technical areas when required, helping maintain high service standards.
  • Promote Gas Safe Register positively across the gas industry, associated trades and the general public.

What We’re Looking For

This role would suit an experienced gas industry professional who enjoys sharing knowledge, solving technical queries and communicating clearly with a wide range of people. You will be confident interpreting technical information, making sound decisions and providing advice that supports compliance, safety and strong customer service.

Essential Requirements

  • A minimum of eight years’ experience working within the gas industry.
  • City & Guilds, NVQ or equivalent qualification in gas service engineering.
  • Appropriate ACS proof of competence.
  • Broad knowledge of the gas industry and related technical standards.
  • Excellent understanding of health and safety, Building Regulations and other relevant legislation.
  • Strong customer service skills, with the ability to explain technical information clearly and professionally.
  • Ability to gather information, research topics and use evidence to support effective decision making.
  • Strong prioritisation, organisation and time management skills, with the ability to work under pressure.
  • Good knowledge and confidence using computer-based systems.

What’s in It for You?

  • A role where your experience is valued and used to support safer gas standards.
  • £41,000 annual salary
  • The flexibility of a home-working role, allowing you to use your technical expertise in a professional support environment.
  • The opportunity to step away from hands-on engineering while staying connected to the industry.
  • Varied technical work, including advisory support, research, publications and stakeholder engagement.
  • A professional environment where accuracy, knowledge and good judgement make a meaningful impact.
  • Career development opportunities across Capita, with support to build skills and progress your career.

Ready to Apply?

If you are an experienced gas professional looking to use your technical knowledge in a role with purpose, variety and real public safety impact, we would welcome your application. This is a great opportunity to support the wider gas industry, help improve safety awareness and be part of a trusted national service.

  • Metrics and leadership: Define and report product security metrics, such as SDL coverage and remediation against SLA, and mentor engineers and security champions.

  • Cloud security architecture on AWS and/or GCP, including Kubernetes, identity, network design and infrastructure as code.
  • Experience leading a Secure Development Lifecycle and application security testing program (SAST, SCA, secret scanning, DAST, fuzzing) in engineering teams.
  • Practical experience assessing the security of AI and LLM features and agentic AI systems, such as prompt injection, data leakage, model supply chain risk, tool and MCP server permissions, and agent sandboxing.
  • Experience using AI to automate security work, such as AI-assisted code review, triage or threat modeling.
  • Track record of building developer security training and tools that engineering teams adopt, including guidance on secure coding with AI assistants.

Flourish and Thrive Labs is a woman-owned and led consulting firm specializing in public health solutions. Our team, composed of former public health officials, works with state and local health departments across the country, building resilient public health operating systems. We pride ourselves on being different, holding ourselves to high ethical standards, and taking care of each other.

We view our company as an urban neighborhood—a diverse group of individuals coming together to live and work, embracing the beauty in that diversity. We are a wacky bunch who are intent on spreading joy! (We just mailed out stickers to over 200 local health health professionals because we felt they could use more joy!)

As Salesforce, Microsoft, Snowflake, and AWS partners, we specialize in technology implementation with a strong people focus. We combine this with strategic planning, data analysis, coaching, and facilitation to effectively support local public health department staff.

Our core values are:

  • People First
  • Focus on Capacity Building
  • Belief in Continuous Experimentation
  • By Public Heath; For Public Health
  • We Do What Is Right. Always.

We're seeking passionate, joyful individuals who align with our ethos of being different and making a difference.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR A TEAM MEMBER WITH PUBLIC HEALTH EXPERIENCE (LOCAL/ TRIBAL/ STATE/ FEDERAL).

About Consulting at F&T Labs

If you're new to consulting, we want to help you understand what makes F&T Labs different and why our approach might be perfect for you. We know transitioning from government and non-profit to consulting can be a big step, but we've designed our work environment to blend the best of both worlds.

First, let's talk about how we work. Unlike traditional consulting firms, we hire you for a role, not a specific project. This means you can contribute to various initiatives that match your expertise and interests. Think of it as bringing your public health superpowers to different challenges where they're needed most.

We believe in measuring what matters. While many consulting firms focus on billable hours, we care about the quality and impact of your work. Time sheets don't measure your success with us – it's measured by the meaningful solutions you help create for our clients and their communities.

Yes, we have utilization targets (consulting speak for how much of your time is spent on client work), but we view these as guideposts rather than strict rules. They help us ensure we're making a sustainable impact while maintaining a healthy business. These targets are meant to motivate, not to create stress.

One of the most dynamic aspects of consulting is its natural rhythm. Some weeks might be bustling with activity, while others might be quieter. We embrace these ebbs and flows because they create space for both intense, focused work and time for learning, reflection, and personal growth. This is part of our philosophy that work and life shouldn't be at odds – they should be integrated in a sustainable and energizing way.

At our core, we're built on a simple belief: when our team members flourish, our clients flourish, and ultimately, communities thrive. That's why we've created an environment that supports your growth, values your expertise, and understands that the best solutions come from people who feel empowered and energized by their work.

If you're passionate about public health and excited about the possibility of expanding your impact through consulting, we'd love to talk with you. Your experience in public health is valuable, and we're here to help you apply it in new and meaningful ways.

Notice

No 3rd Party Recruiters. No Phone Calls. We are unable to do informational interviews at this moment. Candidates who call or schedule a "coffee chat" will be considered disqualified.

jobs.description:
Spoiler: This is where your next big move begins.

What this Journey Looks Like
At Pearster, we connect talented professionals from around the world with exciting opportunities at international companies. We are a dynamic, people-oriented team passionate about building meaningful professional connections and creating a positive employee experience.

We are looking for a Senior Configuration Management Analyst (CMDB & Discovery) to join our growing international team and support the administration, governance, and continuous improvement of enterprise Configuration Management processes.

This role combines ServiceNow CMDB administration, Discovery, Service Mapping, ITSM governance, and cloud infrastructure management. You will be responsible for ensuring accurate, complete, and reliable configuration data across complex enterprise environments, supporting critical IT operations and service management processes.

We are looking for someone with strong technical expertise in ServiceNow CMDB, Discovery, and Configuration Management, along with excellent analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve data quality, operational visibility, and ITSM efficiency.

What You'll Lead and Build

  • Define and maintain CMDB standards, policies, Configuration Item (CI) classifications, ownership models, and lifecycle processes.

  • Lead the administration, governance, and continuous improvement of the ServiceNow Configuration Management Database (CMDB).

  • Coordinate Configuration Control Board (CCB) meetings and drive the resolution of configuration data quality issues.

  • Administer, configure, and optimize ServiceNow Discovery, Service Mapping, MID Servers, discovery patterns, and integrations.

  • Identify and resolve discovery gaps across infrastructure, cloud environments, networks, databases, and enterprise applications.

  • Troubleshoot discovery failures, CI identification issues, and reconciliation conflicts to ensure accurate configuration records.

  • Maintain accurate service maps, CI relationships, and dependencies across enterprise technology environments.

  • Monitor CMDB health and implement controls to improve data completeness, correctness, compliance, and overall reliability.

  • Proactively identify and remediate duplicate CIs, outdated records, missing ownership information, and orphaned relationships.

  • Develop dashboards, reports, and performance metrics to monitor CMDB effectiveness and support governance decisions.

  • Support discovery and configuration governance across AWS, Azure, and hybrid cloud environments.

  • Improve visibility and tracking of external-facing assets, including public IP addresses, DNS records, URLs, and third-party hosted services.

  • Collaborate with Infrastructure, Cloud, Security, Network, Database, and Application teams to maintain accurate enterprise asset information.

  • Ensure CMDB data effectively supports Incident, Problem, Change, Asset, and Service Management processes.

  • Identify opportunities to automate configuration management activities and improve operational efficiency.

  • Provide technical guidance, training, and consultation on Configuration Management best practices.

  • Develop and maintain technical documentation, governance standards, operational procedures, and knowledge articles.

  • Work closely with international stakeholders to drive CMDB maturity, data integrity, and continuous process improvement.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Advanced English (C1) – excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • 5+ years of experience in Configuration Management, ServiceNow CMDB administration, Discovery, or related ITSM roles.

  • Degree or diploma in Information Technology, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.

  • Strong hands-on experience with ServiceNow CMDB, including configuration governance, CI lifecycle management, and data quality processes.

  • Experience administering ServiceNow Discovery and/or Service Mapping, including MID Servers, discovery patterns, and integrations.

  • Solid understanding of CMDB Health, Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE), and configuration data reconciliation.

  • Strong knowledge of ITIL Service Asset and Configuration Management (SACM) principles and best practices.

  • Experience defining and maintaining CI classifications, ownership models, relationships, and configuration standards.

  • Familiarity with AWS, Azure, and hybrid cloud infrastructure environments.

  • Good understanding of Windows, Linux, networking, databases, and enterprise infrastructure technologies.

  • Experience troubleshooting discovery issues, duplicate configuration items, and data integrity challenges.

  • Ability to develop reports, dashboards, and KPIs to monitor CMDB performance and data quality.

  • Experience integrating CMDB processes with Incident, Problem, Change, and Asset Management.

  • ITIL Foundation Certification (required).

  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with technical and non-technical teams.

  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and make sound decisions in complex technical environments.

  • Strong ownership mindset, organizational skills, and commitment to continuous improvement.

  • Experience working with international teams in dynamic enterprise environments.

Benefits that Move you Forward.

We’re here to amplify your brilliance, not contain it.

  • Work from anywhere with true flexibility and freedom.

  • Earn in USD with compensation that matches your expertise.

  • Recharge confidently with dedicated paid time off.

  • Advance your career with fully covered international certifications.

  • Access coworking spaces worldwide whenever you want a professional setup.

  • Strengthen your English and expand your global reach.

  • Connect and have fun with activities that unite our international team.

  • Feel appreciated with personalized gifts and a thoughtful welcome kit.

  • Grow our community and earn through our referral program.

At Pearster, your journey matters, and we’re here to help you go further than you imagined.

jobs.title: Senior Service Manager
jobs.excerpt: We are seeking an experienced Senior Service Manager with at least 5 years of experience in Service Management and 8+ years of overall experience in IT.
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Service Manager with at least 5 years of experience in Service Management and 8+ years of overall experience in IT. The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring the effective delivery, governance, and continuous improvement of IT services, maintaining high levels of service quality and customer satisfaction.

The role requires a strong understanding of IT Service Management practices, excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, and the ability to drive service performance through effective governance, monitoring, reporting, and coordination.

Key Responsibilities

  • Service Governance: Establish and maintain effective service governance frameworks, ensuring adherence to agreed processes, policies, and service management standards.
  • SLA & KPI Management: Define, monitor, and manage Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), ensuring service performance meets contractual obligations and business expectations.
  • Service Reporting: Prepare, review, and present regular service performance reports, providing meaningful insights, identifying trends, highlighting risks, and proposing improvement actions.
  • Escalation Management: Act as a senior escalation point for service-related issues, ensuring timely resolution, effective communication, and appropriate stakeholder engagement.
  • Service Coordination: Coordinate across technical teams, operational units, vendors, and business stakeholders to ensure seamless service delivery and effective resolution of operational challenges.
  • Stakeholder Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders, ensuring transparency, alignment, and effective communication on service performance and priorities.
  • Continuous Service Improvement: Identify service gaps, operational inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities, driving initiatives to enhance service quality, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.
  • Service Review Meetings: Lead regular service review and governance meetings, tracking performance, outstanding actions, risks, issues, and agreed improvement plans.
  • Risk & Issue Management: Proactively identify and manage service delivery risks and operational issues, ensuring appropriate mitigation and follow-up.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • At least 8+ years of overall experience in IT, with a minimum of 5+ years in Service Management or a similar service delivery leadership role.
  • Strong experience in IT Service Management, service governance, and operational service delivery.
  • Proven experience in managing SLAs, KPIs, service performance, and contractual service obligations.
  • Experience in preparing and presenting service reports, management dashboards, and performance reviews.
  • Strong background in escalation management, issue resolution, and cross-functional coordination.
  • Proven ability to manage relationships with customers, senior stakeholders, technical teams, and third-party service providers.
  • Good understanding of ITIL principles and IT Service Management best practices. ITIL certification will be considered an advantage.
  • Excellent organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and stakeholder management capabilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, work under pressure, and drive results in a complex IT environment.
  • Very good command of English, both written and spoken.
  • Nice to have: previous experience in a multinational or international organization.

About us

Joining Busuu means being part of one of the top EdTech companies in the world, a multiple award-winner recognised for its innovation and impact in language learning.

Busuu’s vision is to empower people through languages. We are the world’s largest online community for language learning, with 120+ million registered users. We make learning a language easy by combining AI-powered courses with feedback from our global community of native speakers and lesson content designed for real life.

Busuu is part of the global Chegg family. Chegg is the leading student-first connected learning platform and a NYSE listed company.

What does a Freelance Online German Teacher do at Busuu?

As a Freelance Online Teacher at Busuu, you’ll play a key role in helping students learn language effectively and confidently. On a day-to-day basis, your responsibilities will likely include:

  • Planning, preparing, and teaching online lessons (45 minutes each) for corporate clients.

  • 1:1 Lessons: Deliver private lessons that include both language teaching and personalised coaching- conducting needs analyses, assessing levels, creating bespoke learning paths, checking progress during lesson time, and setting clear goals.

  • Group Lessons: Teach online group classes that focus on active learning and communication.

What we’re looking for in a Freelance OnlineGermanTeacher:

  • C2 Level ofGerman

  • Valid teaching certificate such as TEFL/CELTA or related university degrees

  • Experience in online teaching and providing 1:1 coaching or personalised learning support

  • Fluency in additional languages:

    • B2 or above in an additional language

    • Bonus: Speaking more than two languages

  • Comfortable teaching: presentation skills, negotiations, business email etiquette, meeting management, multicultural communication, etc.

  • Excellent communication skills to engage and teach students

  • High-Speed Internet, Modern Laptop / PC with a microphone and camera

  • Must comply with local freelance/contractor regulations

What are the terms of this freelance role?

  • $17 paid per lesson taught

  • Materials Provided

  • Remote position

  • Freedom to set your own schedule

  • Access to Busuu Premium, to continue your own language learning

  • Opportunity to interact with and teach students from around the world

  • Valuable teaching experience with one of the industry’s leading companies

What happens next?

We aim to have a simple and speedy hiring process and want to make sure that we are right for you as much as the other way around. The hiring process for the freelance online role are the following 3 steps:

  1. CV application review - We will review it as quickly as possible and update on the next steps

  2. Let’s chat - Quick interview with the teacher operations manager about your experience and the role

  3. Short onboarding course

Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. We pride ourselves on embracing our differences, whether they're cultural, racial, religious, or otherwise. This means each one of us comes to work knowing that we have a voice – and a safe, judgment-free zone to speak freely.

If you like the sound of that, join us. We'd love to hear what you have to say.
