About the Role

We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Real Estate Acquisition Specialist to handle inbound seller leads generated through direct marketing campaigns.

This is a phone-intensive, consultative sales role focused on qualifying motivated property sellers, building rapport, evaluating opportunities, negotiating offers, and securing signed contracts. The ideal candidate has direct experience in real estate wholesaling, acquisitions, FSBO transactions, subject-to deals, or distressed property sales and understands how to navigate conversations with motivated homeowners.

You will play a critical role in converting inbound opportunities into signed contracts while maintaining a high level of professionalism, empathy, and persistence throughout the sales process.

Responsibilities

Lead Qualification & Seller Engagement

  • Answer inbound calls from property owners responding to cash buyer, foreclosure, probate, and distressed property marketing campaigns.
  • Conduct structured seller qualification calls to assess motivation, timeline, property condition, and pricing expectations.
  • Build trust and rapport with homeowners while uncovering their unique circumstances and goals.
  • Identify highly motivated sellers and determine deal viability.

Property Evaluation & Offer Negotiation

  • Conduct preliminary property evaluations over the phone.
  • Assess repair requirements, estimated after-repair value (ARV), and overall investment potential.
  • Present cash offers within company-approved acquisition guidelines.
  • Negotiate effectively with property owners to secure favorable agreements.
  • Handle objections professionally and guide sellers through the decision-making process.

Pipeline Management & Follow-Up

  • Maintain consistent follow-up with leads that do not convert during the initial conversation.
  • Manage lead pipelines to ensure opportunities remain active and engaged.
  • Update CRM records accurately and maintain complete documentation of all interactions.
  • Track seller conversations, follow-up schedules, and contract status.

Contract Execution & Team Collaboration

  • Secure signed purchase agreements from qualified sellers.
  • Coordinate with acquisitions, underwriting, and disposition teams on qualified opportunities.
  • Ensure a smooth handoff process once contracts are executed.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to maximize deal conversion and efficiency.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You have direct experience speaking with motivated property sellers and negotiating real estate transactions.
  • You understand wholesaling, acquisitions, distressed properties, and creative real estate strategies.
  • You are confident handling objections and difficult conversations over the phone.
  • You know how to balance relationship-building with performance-driven sales goals.
  • You are highly organized and disciplined with follow-up.
  • You thrive in a remote, results-oriented environment.

Required Experience & Skills

Must-Have

  • Previous experience in Real Estate Wholesaling, Acquisitions, FSBO, Subject-To transactions, or Distressed Property Sales.
  • Proven track record of getting motivated sellers under contract.
  • Strong phone sales, rapport-building, and objection-handling skills.
  • Experience negotiating real estate transactions and purchase agreements.
  • Familiarity with ARV calculations, repair estimates, and wholesale deal analysis.
  • Experience using CRM systems and managing sales pipelines.
  • Excellent verbal and written English communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience working with U.S.-based real estate investors or wholesaling companies.

  • Experience using Podio, GoHighLevel, Salesforce, or similar CRM platforms.

  • Track record of consistently exceeding acquisition, contract, or sales goals.

What Does a Typical Day Look Like?

Your day begins by reviewing new inbound seller leads and prioritizing follow-up opportunities. Throughout the day, you'll speak directly with homeowners, uncover motivation, evaluate property opportunities, negotiate offers, and move qualified prospects toward signed contracts.

You will maintain detailed CRM records, coordinate with internal teams regarding active opportunities, and ensure no lead falls through the cracks. Consistent follow-up is a critical part of the role, as many deals require multiple touchpoints before converting.

Success comes from building trust, understanding seller motivations, and creating win-win solutions that result in executed contracts.

Candidate will be required to create and respond to communications for and from all types of functional and technical customers through a variety of formats such as conference calls, emails, NARA taskers and directives, Service Hold Requests, File Plans and annual NARA requests regarding records managed by and for the client. An example would be addressing the NARA directive to perform an annual Records Management Program (RMP) assessment survey and submit to NARA’s ePortal.

Candidate will be responsible for maintaining a Record Maintenance Support process and System Maintenance Support process that provides ongoing RM support to assess problems, seek process improvements and adhere to Federal Regulations. Candidate will work with client to establish internal policy and other governance to ensure the following are addressed in the time and/or manner specified/acceptable by the appropriate authority:

  • Advise in Agency-wide Annual RM Training.
  • Assess and embed RM capabilities in the design of current, or new systems.
  • Create and maintain RM Governance Policy and Guidance.
  • Respond to RM related inquiries (24 hours).
  • Respond and support any requests for information needed because of audit or internal or external analysis.
  • Respond to NARA inquiries and surveys.
  • Implement revisions to records retention schedule.
  • Provide support to incidents or inquiries related to various matters related to the Agency’s RM program to include but not limited to records security, records transitioning, incidents-damaged, lost-spillage, RMS, and archiving.
  • Provide administrative support and guidance for creating and maintain current file plans and associated taxonomy to better enable configuration of systems retaining Agency’s records.

The candidate will work closely with the client’s Record Manager and/or Records Owners the following actions will be implemented to maintain system support:

  • Implement steps that include identifying and maintaining a current list of staff responsible completing files, training designated staff how to complete records file plan, tracking designated staff for ongoing reference.
  • Refer to completed Files Plans or like documents to assess how best to configure/automate SharePoint Purview and SharePoint collaboration sites to manage recordkeeping and non-recordkeeping records in a secure manner, and when applicable the routing of permanent records to NARA.
  • Identify and prioritize records for transition to SharePoint such as Finance, Personnel and Audit related supporting documents.
  • Develop an Agency-wide RM awareness training program.
  • Establish forums that enables Records Liaisons, Records Custodians or staff in similar roles to communicate in a practical/efficient manner. For example, FAQ Web Site, and Brown Bag Meetings.
  • Issue taskers or similar requests periodically (at a minimum every 12 month) to Process Owners/Records Liaisons to review if information applicable to them in the Agency’s Records Retention Schedule-and Records File Plans is accurate/relevant/current.
  • Hold weekly meetings (at a minimum) with Records Management Office to discuss issuances/changes from NARA or other authorities within DoD
  • Ensure client record support system is on NARA’s notification list to be kept informed of any activity that impacts clients RM program to include but not limited to training, updates to NARA tools for submission of SF115s and SF135s.
  • Attend meetings and/or training as required to stay abreast of changes to clients record management system, NARA record management guideline
  • Help implement the findings from NARA Self-Assessments where clients Record Management Program needs to improve such as with implementation of a RM training program; in-out processing protocol to ensure key records especially at the senior level are preserved; embedding RM in the Agency’s vital records program; web site RM, email management and when applicable social media.

Job Description

The STAGES Sign Language Interpreter -CONTRACTOR is responsible for interpreting or transliterating all academic content to allow students who are D/HH to access instruction, communicate with other members of the school community, and participate in school-based activities. The scope of services and supports provided by the Educational Interpreter will be determined by the students’ Individualized Education Plans (IEPs). The Educational Interpreter serves as a collaborative member of a team that supports students identified as D/HH in a virtual academic environment and are fluent in American Sign Language (ASL). The Sign Language Interpreter- Contractor may be asked to obtain licensure in multiple states and serve students across multiple schools.

This is an Independent Consultant position (1099).

This is a Part-Time position.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS: Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential duties.

  • Experience using one or more signing systems in an educational setting, including American Sign Language (ASL), Manually Coded English, Conceptually Accurate Signed English (CASE), and/or Finger Spelling
  • Interpret and transliterate content presented in the live, synchronous virtual academic setting as delineated in the assigned students’ IEPs
  • Adapt language and materials to meet the individual needs of students with hearing loss
  • Collaborate with other members of the school community (e.g., general education teachers, special education teachers, caregivers, related service providers) to share information regarding students’ progress and needs, as well as to ensure services are delivered in compliance with IEPs
  • Serve as an integral member of the IEP team and attend IEP meetings
  • Provide expressive and voice interpretation of classroom instruction, clarify curricular content, support work completion, and provide language support in small groups or during one-on-one interactions
  • Interpret for school activities outside of the virtual classroom, extracurricular activities, and meetings with caregivers
  • Adhere to professional standards as outlined in the Code of Ethics of the National Registry of Interpreters for the Deaf
  • Serve as a liaison between students who are D/HH, hearing peers, staff, community members, and/or caregivers
  • Develop and maintain positive relationships with students, caregivers, and school staff
  • Be available to students, caregivers, and staff during designated work hours
  • Work from a professional home office environment, conducive to video and audio needs and a structured schedule
  • Must be self-motivated, dependable, creative, and passionate about meeting the needs of students
  • Prior experience supporting students identified as D/HH in the academic environment is desired but not required.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

This position has no formal supervisory responsibilities.

MINIMUM REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

Minimum 1 year experience interpreting in educational environment and

Minimum 1 year experience providing interpreting services virtually

Certificates and Licenses:

National Interpreter Certification issued by the Registry of Interpreters for the Deaf and/or

State specific educational interpreter licensure

DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Ability to work independently, with availability during typical school hours of at least 20 hours per week is required. Ability to maintain a professional home office without distraction during workday, typically 9 - 5 as defined by the school and time zone
  • Strong content and subject-matter knowledge
  • An ability to support and guide adults as well as students
  • Receptive to receiving coaching on a regular basis with administrators
  • Ability to embrace change and adapt to ensure excellent student outcomes
  • Ability to create and deliver staff development
  • Exceptionally strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong organizational and time management skills
  • Ability to rapidly learn and adapt to new technologies and teaching platforms
  • MS365 Proficient
  • Ability to clear required background check

This position is remote and open to residents of the 50 states and D.C. This is an Independent Consultant position (1099).

Posting Title

Undergraduate/Graduate (3-12 Month, Remote) Intern - Power System/Power Electronics Modeling

Working at NLR

NLR is located at the foothills of the Rocky Mountains in Golden, Colorado is the nation's primary laboratory for energy systems research and development.

Join the National Laboratory of the Rockies (NLR), where world-class scientists, engineers, and experts are accelerating energy innovation through breakthrough research and systems integration. From our mission to our collaborative culture, NLR stands out in the research community for its commitment to an affordable and secure energy future. Spanning foundational science to applied systems engineering and analysis, we focus on solving complex challenges to deliver advanced, secure, reliable, and cost-effective energy solutions. Our work helps strengthen U.S. industries, support job creation, and promote national economic growth.

At NLR, you'll find a mission-driven environment supported by state-of-the-art facilities, multidisciplinary research teams, and strong collaborations with industry, academia, and other national laboratories. We offer robust professional development opportunities, and a competitive benefits package designed to support your career and well-being.



Job Description

The Power Systems Engineering Center (PSEC) at the National Renewable Energy Laboratory (NREL) is inviting applications for one or two internship positions to work on in the area of power systems and power electronics interfaces. This position will perform dynamic modeling and validation of power systems with high percentage of inverter-based resources and evaluate their impact on power grids. This work will be conducted at NREL’s Flatiron Campus. The researcher should have knowledge of power system stability analysis and control theory.

Job responsibilities will include:

  • Provide technical analysis related to power electronics and power systems control of renewable generation, battery energy storage systems, and large industrial drives.
  • Work under supervision to build power system EMT simulation and perform power system validation.
  • Integrating, testing, and using user-written “black box” models in PSCAD for wind turbine generators, solar inverters, battery energy storage systems (BESS), or other advanced power electronic based systems.
  • Evaluate studies that examine the impact of high percentage of inverter-based resource on power systems.
  • Writing and publishing results of analysis in peer-reviewed journals and technical reports
  • Follow all Environmental, Safety, and Health policies to ensure and maintain a safe working environment.

.

Basic Qualifications

Minimum of a 3.0 cumulative grade point average.

Undergraduate: Must be enrolled as a full-time student in a bachelor’s degree program from an accredited institution.
Post Undergraduate: Earned a bachelor’s degree within the past 12 months. Eligible for an internship period of up to one year.

Graduate: Must be enrolled as a full-time student in a master’s degree program from an accredited institution.
Post Graduate: Earned a master’s degree within the past 12 months. Eligible for an internship period of up to one year.
Graduate + PhD: Completed master’s degree and enrolled as PhD student from an accredited institution.

Please Note:

• Applicants are responsible for uploading official or unofficial school transcripts, as part of the application process.
• If selected for position, a letter of recommendation will be required as part of the hiring process.
• Must meet educational requirements prior to employment start date.

* Must meet educational requirements prior to employment start date.

Additional Required Qualifications

  • Experience with power system EMT software tools such as PSCAD, MATLAB/Simulink, DIgSILENT, RSCAD, or other EMT simulation tools.
  • Solid knowledge on power system EMT modeling, power system stability and control.
  • Solid knowledge on the modeling and control of inverter-based resources.
  • Ability to present technical results to multi-stakeholder audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Coursework or project experience in power system or power electronics modeling.
  • Coursework or project experience using Python, R, or similar programming programing languages.
  • Experience with RTDS modeling and HIL testing.
  • Basic familiarity with EMTP-RV and/or EMTP-ATP.

.

Clinical Analytics Specialist – MD

Are you a licensed MD looking to help drive innovation within our global organization?

About the role. We are looking for an MD to serve as our Clinical Analytics Specialist to join the Data Discovery and Enrichment Team (DDE). The Clinical Analytics Specialist will provide support for clinical decision support (CDS) product development to improve the search and discovery experience for users of products such as ClinicalKey at the point-of-care. You will have a critical role in working with the Clinical Solutions and Education business units to provide clinical analytics support and drive growth, revenue generation, and innovation.

"Active US license " and The Clinical Analytics Specialist should be a clinician (MD or DO)

About the team. This team is entrusted with the validation of extracted medical information from Elsevier corpus and electronic health care records, information retrieval, creating data for gold set generation, and participating in content enrichment workflows aiding in clinical decision support.

Experience

  • Clinical degree required (MD, MBBS,GP) Preference given to those with formal training or significant experience in evidence-based medicine, clinical research, epidemiology, biostatistics, and the application of evidence to practice.
  • Experience in semantic technologies, including text mining, ontology management is a plus.
  • Excellent command of the English language in both spoken and written forms is required and some level of proficiency with another language is a plus.
  • Experience with medical vocabularies such as SNOMED CT and ICD-10 is beneficial, as is knowledge of ontology modeling.
  • Extensive computer skill competency. Proficiency in a Microsoft Windows environment; and strong MS Word/Powerpoint skills and ability to work with templates using an electronic content management system. Visualization and dashboarding skills (e.g. using Tableau) is a plus.
  • Demonstrated problem-solving ability, sense of urgency, and ability to prioritize tasks, to work simultaneously on multiple projects, and to ensure completion of editorial team projects per tight timelines.
  • The Clinical Analytics Specialist should be a clinician (MD, MBBS or GP) with experience in informatics and knowledge retrieval
  • Able to work with a variety of stakeholders at the mid and senior management level 

Responsibilities

  • Appling clinical knowledge to extract and integrate data in a healthcare environment.
  • Adapting domain ontologies for information extraction, data modeling and analysis.
  • Working closely with data scientists, clinicians, subject matter experts (SMEs), taxonomists, and data analysts to provide insights used in automation and applications for our businesses in health markets
  • Working on the modeling, validation, and maintenance of core extracted clinical relationships to deliver an evidence-based and development of Elsevier’s healthcare knowledge graph (H-graph).
  • Providing insight for ensuring high quality of automated indexing for search & discovery.
  • Appling own domain knowledge and work with external clinical experts to confirm and validate clinical accuracy of content. Ensure that content is clinically accurate, current, and supported by the best available evidence from the medical literature, current guidelines, and accepted performance standards.
  • Building domain specific training data sets for machine learning (ML) models used in Point-of-care products
  • Predictive analytics and insights from combining big datasets in healthcare
  • Participating in design, prototyping, and analytics in their day to day providing insights for algorithm codification that will improve clinical workflows and content creation.

  Elsevier is a renowned global information analytics company that primarily focuses on providing scientific, technical, and medical (STM) research content, tools, and services. It is one of the largest publishers of academic journals and scholarly literature in the world.

Elsevier operates in various domains, including science, technology, medicine, social sciences, and more. They publish a vast number of peer-reviewed journals covering a wide range of disciplines. These journals act as platforms for researchers and academics to share their findings and contribute to the advancement of knowledge in their respective fields.

In addition to publishing, Elsevier offers a suite of digital solutions and services to support researchers, scientists, and professionals in their work. They provide online platforms like ScienceDirect, Scopus, and Mendeley, which offer access to a vast repository of scholarly articles, research papers, and other scientific content. These platforms often serve as essential resources for software developers seeking to stay updated with the latest scientific advancements.

Furthermore, Elsevier offers tools and services to help researchers with tasks such as data management, article submission, and citation tracking. They also provide metrics and analytics to assess the impact and reach of scientific publications. Additionally, Elsevier hosts conferences and events to facilitate knowledge sharing and collaboration within the scientific community.

We're looking for a part time Crisis Helpline Responder with proven experience as a helpline counsellor or responder, and completed training in Crisis intervention or Suicide prevention.

About Intellect

Intellect is a digital mental healthcare company providing an entirely new way for employers to effectively care for their employees' health & mental wellbeing. We're a team of psychologists, clinicians, and technologists providing an evidence-based approach to proactively help anyone, no matter where they are on their mental health journey. Our mission is to make mental health support radically more accessible, preventative & relatable, and stigma-free. Join us on our mission to reinvent how mental healthcare is being delivered

Role & Responsibilities

  • Responding to telephone hotline for crisis support of those bereaved through suicide, engaging in self-harm, experiencing suicide ideation and concerned friends or family members.
  • Providing a range of evidenced based, professional crisis counselling services and personal support, employing de-escalation techniques and crisis intervention techniques
  • Assessing the caller's needs and triage for immediate safety or emergency medical attention of callers, or referrals to appropriate service referrals such as face-to-face crisis intervention, case management/advocacy services, individual therapy, or group services.

  • Complying with responsibilities under the Data Protection Acts 1988, 2003 & 2018 (GDPR)
  • Supporting in the development of appropriate crisis management plans to support callers in crisis
  • Make a quick in-the-moment decision on how to move forward if the responder is not sure how to proceed
  • Ensuring smooth and diligent handover process to next shift personnel
  • Dedicating entire shift to intellect tasks and responsibilities only
  • Conducting risk assessments, including lethality assessment for suicide cases

Requirements

  • 1 - 3 years of experience in helplines, either in a paid or voluntary capacity
  • Can effectively communicate in their native language
  • Experience working with high risk clinical situations (at risk of or affected by suicide or crisis cases) and
  • Ability to maintain emotional composure in high stress situations, ability to bounce back from stressful interactions and high-risk case

Plus Points if you:

  • have a background in mental health or emergency services
  • Completed training in Crisis Intervention or Suicide Prevention
  • can effectively communicate in more than 1 language
  • maintain professional indemnity insurance

We're looking for a Digital Marketing Manager to take full ownership of social media and paid advertising for a premier debate and speech education company serving students across Greater China and Southeast Asia. You will develop and execute content strategy, design graphics in Canva, coordinate with in-house video and design staff, run paid campaigns on Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn, and drive the inquiry volume that fills enrollment.

This is an end-to-end ownership role, not a task-execution role. You will identify opportunities, chase down content from coaches and staff, set your own priorities, and build systems that produce consistent results without waiting to be told what to do next. The company has strong programs, a talented in-house creative team, and a clear market. What it needs is someone who can translate that into digital engagement and measurable inquiries across the Asian education market. If you thrive on autonomy, take pride in building things from scratch, and are motivated by seeing your work drive real enrollment conversions, this role is a strong fit.

Why You'll Want to Join

  • You will be paid in USD (bi-monthly: every 15th and 30th)
  • Paid Time Off in accordance with company policy
  • Observance of Holidays per company guidelines
  • 100% remote setup so you can work wherever you're most productive
  • This role requires availability Tuesday through Saturday, 12:00 PM to 8:00 PM Hong Kong Time — this schedule is non-negotiable given the need for real-time coordination with the Asia-based team and audience during peak engagement hours
  • Own the full digital marketing function for an established education brand with a strong reputation across Greater China and Southeast Asia
  • High-autonomy role with direct ownership over strategy, execution, and results

What You'll Work On

Content Strategy and Execution

  • Audit current social channels and develop an ambitious growth strategy focused on generating inquiries and boosting engagement across Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn
  • Generate fresh, high-converting content ideas tailored to parents and students in the target markets, with a clear understanding of what drives families to inquire about extracurricular education services
  • Serve as the primary project manager for content production — proactively chase coaches, staff, and students for raw footage, photos, testimonials, and program updates without waiting for content to come to you
  • Manage the content calendar and execute all posting and scheduling aligned with Hong Kong Time peak engagement windows

Graphic Asset Creation and Post-Production Coordination

  • Design static graphics independently in Canva for ads, carousels, stories, and promotional materials — this is a core hands-on responsibility
  • Brief and coordinate with the in-house video editing team for all video post-production needs, providing clear creative direction, assets, and deadlines
  • Collaborate with the in-house graphic designer for complex branding assets, providing clear briefs and managing timelines

Paid Advertising and Community Management

  • Plan, launch, and optimize paid ad campaigns on Facebook, Instagram, and LinkedIn with a strict focus on cost per inquiry and enrollment conversion
  • Monitor engagement, respond to DMs and comments during core hours, and track analytics weekly to refine strategy toward inquiry generation
  • Translate educational value propositions into compelling marketing copy that resonates with families in the target markets

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Liaise with the marketing and post-production team to ensure all deliverables meet deadlines
  • Participate in daily async check-ins and weekly strategy syncs and over-communicate progress and blockers during core hours
  • Build repeatable workflows and systems that reduce dependency on manual oversight over time

What You Bring

  • Proven track record of owning digital marketing end to end with a portfolio or case studies showing where you identified a gap, built a solution, and drove measurable results with minimal direction
  • Deep understanding of Greater China and Southeast Asian education markets including Hong Kong, Singapore, and Mainland China, and how families in these regions evaluate extracurricular education services
  • Demonstrated success running paid campaigns and growing organic engagement on Facebook and Instagram targeting Asian education audiences
  • Experience coordinating with subject matter experts to extract content — comfortable following up persistently and professionally to get what you need
  • Strong Canva proficiency for creating polished, on-brand static graphics independently — video editing skills are not required
  • Inquiry-focused mindset with a genuine obsession over conversion metrics rather than vanity metrics
  • Strong written English with the ability to adapt tone for both students and parents in the target markets
  • Mandarin or Cantonese proficiency is highly valued for authentic market connection

Nice to Have

  • Background in education, tutoring, enrichment, or service-based industries
  • Experience with WeChat, Rednote (Xiaohongshu), or other regional platforms
  • Experience with CRM integration and lead tracking in Asian markets
  • Existing network or community connections in Hong Kong, China, or Singapore education circles

How to Apply

Please include:

  1. Your updated resume
  2. A portfolio link or case studies showing digital marketing work you have owned including paid campaigns, content strategy, or social growth results — ideally with evidence of inquiry or conversion outcomes
  3. A short Loom video (1 to 2 minutes) introducing yourself, describing your experience marketing to Asian education audiences, and walking through one campaign or content initiative you owned end to end and the results it produced

Only candidates who submit both a portfolio and Loom video will be moved to the next step of the hiring process.

If you are a self-directed digital marketer who understands the Asian education market, can build systems that generate consistent inquiries, and want full ownership over strategy and execution for a brand with a strong product and a clear market, this role gives you the autonomy and the direct impact to do your best work.

Our comprehensive selection process ensures we find the right fit for both you and our clients:

6. Client Interview - Final interview with the client team you'd be supporting
7. Background & Reference Check - Professional reference verification
8. Job Offer - Successful candidates receive a formal offer to join the team

Each stage is designed to evaluate your fit for the role while giving you insights into our company culture and expectations.

We'll keep you informed throughout the process and provide feedback at each step.

Department: Supply Chain – Global Demand Planning

The Sr. Manager, Global Demand Planning is responsible for defining and leading Nextpower's Global Demand Planning capability, establishing the processes, governance, and analytical framework that enable effective Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) and long-term business strategic decision-making, at the enterprise level and for all business units

As the functional owner of Demand Planning, this role translates commercial opportunities into actionable demand intelligence, providing strategic insights that guide strategic decisions in Supply Chain, Sourcing, Manufacturing, Engineering, Logistics, and Commercial teams in planning up to 1 year ahead. Partnering closely with Executive Leadership, the role drives cross-functional alignment, identifies risks and opportunities, and continuously improves planning capabilities through standardization, automation, and people development.

Demand Planning Strategy & Governance

  • Lead the monthly demand planning cycle across regions, business units, channels, and product categories.
  • Define and continuously improve the Global Demand Planning process, standards, and governance at the enterprise level and for all business units
  • Develop rolling demand plans and planning assumptions that support short-, medium-, and long-term business objectives.

Demand Alignment & S&OP Governance

  • Establish the governance and cadence for global Demand Reviews within the S&OP process.
  • Drive alignment between Sales and Supply Chain by facilitating data-driven planning discussions and challenging assumptions.

  • Integrate statistical forecasts with sales, marketing, customer, market, and product inputs.
  • Challenge commercial assumptions and identify unsupported optimism, conservatism, or bias.
  • Deliver business analyses, scenario-modelling, and demand insights that support strategic Supply Chain decisions over a 1–3-year planning horizon.

  • Develop executive dashboards and reporting that improve visibility into demand, supplier capacity, project pipeline, and business performance with the support of your team.

Executive & Cross-Functional Leadership

Planning Excellence & Digital Transformation

People Leadership

jobs.description:
About DigiStor

DigiStor develops secure data-at-rest solutions for enterprise, government, defense, and other security-conscious organizations. Our portfolio includes secure and self-encrypting SSDs, removable NVMe storage solutions, and technologies designed for demanding client, workstation, server, and edge environments.

Role Overview

The Field Engineer, EMEA will be DigiStor's primary customer-facing technical resource supporting two EMEA Sales Representatives.

The role combines technical pre-sales, solution design, product demonstrations, platform qualification, and field support. You will help customers select, evaluate, integrate, and deploy DigiStor secure-storage solutions within Dell Technologies and HP/HPE client, workstation, server, and edge platforms.

You will work closely with customers, channel partners, OEM contacts, Sales, Product Management, Engineering, Testing, and Technical Support. Your purpose will be to remove technical barriers, reduce risk, and help convert qualified opportunities into successful deployments.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Pre-Sales

  • Partner with two EMEA Sales Representatives throughout the customer engagement lifecycle.
  • Lead technical discovery sessions to understand the customer's platform, workload, security, performance, environmental, and compliance requirements.
  • Recommend the most appropriate DigiStor product, capacity, form factor, interface, and security configuration.
  • Translate complex storage and security concepts into clear business and operational benefits.
  • Deliver technical presentations, product demonstrations, workshops, and architecture discussions.
  • Support customer responses, proposals, RFIs, RFPs, technical questionnaires, and tender submissions.
  • Help Sales identify technical risks, dependencies, and qualification requirements early in the opportunity.

Platform and Solution Engineering

  • Advise customers on the integration of DigiStor solutions into Dell and HP/HPE servers, workstations, desktops, laptops, and edge platforms.
  • Assess compatibility across NVMe, SATA, PCIe, BIOS/UEFI, operating systems, firmware, physical form factors, power, cooling, and thermal requirements.
  • Support storage technologies and form factors including M.2, U.2, U.3, E1.S, SATA, and removable NVMe solutions.
  • Develop recommended configurations, compatibility guidance, bills of material, and solution documentation.
  • Work with DigiStor Engineering and Testing teams to coordinate platform validation and resolve compatibility questions.

Evaluations and Proofs of Concept

  • Define and manage customer evaluations, proof-of-concept activities, and product qualification plans.
  • Establish clear technical success criteria with customers and Sales.
  • Assist with product installation, configuration, testing, benchmarking, and results interpretation.
  • Capture diagnostic information, reproduce reported issues where possible, and coordinate escalation to the appropriate Engineering or Support team.
  • Maintain ownership and clear customer communication through technical resolution and handover.

Secure-Storage Expertise

  • Explain secure-storage technologies including hardware encryption, self-encrypting drives, TCG Opal, pre-boot authentication, key management, and secure erase.
  • Help customers understand relevant certification and compliance requirements, including FIPS, Common Criteria, TAA, NATO, and regional security programmes.
  • Ensure that technical claims and recommendations accurately reflect product capabilities and certification status.
  • Support customers operating in regulated, government, defence, financial-services, healthcare, and critical-infrastructure environments.

Partner and Field Enablement

  • Develop strong technical relationships with customers, distributors, resellers, integrators, and OEM stakeholders across EMEA.
  • Deliver technical training and enablement sessions for channel and sales partners.
  • Create and maintain technical guides, configuration notes, FAQs, reference architectures, and field playbooks.
  • Bring structured customer feedback, competitive intelligence, and emerging requirements back to DigiStor's Product and Engineering teams.
  • Represent DigiStor at customer meetings, partner events, industry events, and technical briefings.

Required Experience and Knowledge

  • Proven experience as a Field Engineer, Sales Engineer, Systems Engineer, Solutions Architect, Field Applications Engineer, or Technical Pre-Sales Engineer.
  • Strong working knowledge of Dell Technologies and HP/HPE client, workstation, and server platforms.
  • Practical understanding of enterprise storage, SSDs, NVMe, SATA, PCIe, firmware, BIOS/UEFI, and storage-device integration.
  • Experience supporting both Windows and Linux environments.
  • Ability to diagnose hardware, firmware, operating-system, performance, and compatibility issues.
  • Experience planning and delivering customer evaluations or proofs of concept.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with infrastructure architects, security teams, IT operations, procurement teams, partners, and senior decision-makers.
  • Strong written and spoken English.
  • Willingness and ability to travel regularly across EMEA.
  • Ability to work independently within a geographically distributed organisation.

Desirable Experience

  • Knowledge of self-encrypting drives, TCG Opal, AES-256 encryption, pre-boot authentication, and data-at-rest security.
  • Familiarity with FIPS 140-2/140-3, Common Criteria, CSfC, TAA, NATO, UK, or European security requirements.
  • Experience with Dell OEM, HP/HPE, or other major hardware-manufacturer ecosystems.
  • Experience with storage-testing and diagnostic tools such as NVMe CLI, SMART utilities, fio, Iometer, and operating-system hardware tools.
  • Experience supporting government, defence, financial-services, healthcare, industrial, or other regulated customers.
  • Knowledge of removable storage, rugged systems, edge computing, or industrial computing environments.
  • Fluency in an additional European language.

Core Competencies

  • Customer focus: Builds trust and remains accountable throughout the technical engagement.
  • Technical depth: Understands systems, storage, security, and platform integration at a practical level.
  • Commercial awareness: Connects technical recommendations to customer value and sales outcomes.
  • Problem-solving: Approaches complex technical issues logically and remains effective under pressure.
  • Communication: Explains technical subjects clearly to both specialist and non-specialist audiences.
  • Ownership: Drives activities through to completion and communicates progress proactively.
  • Collaboration: Works effectively across Sales, Engineering, Product, Testing, Support, and external partners.
  • Adaptability: Learns new technologies quickly and remains current with changing platforms and standards.

Measures of Success

Success in this position will be demonstrated through:

  • Effective technical coverage of EMEA sales opportunities.
  • Faster and more accurate qualification of customer requirements.
  • Successful customer evaluations and proofs of concept.
  • Reduced technical risk and fewer late-stage compatibility issues.
  • Strong customer, partner, and Sales satisfaction.
  • Clear and timely resolution or escalation of field issues.
  • Improved technical enablement and knowledge across the EMEA partner network.
  • High-quality field feedback that contributes to DigiStor's product and technology roadmap.

DigiStor is committed to building an inclusive working environment. Employment decisions are based on business needs, role requirements, and individual qualifications.

jobs.title: Finance Data Analyst
jobs.excerpt: Sekoia is an AI-native SOC platform combining next-generation SIEM, SOAR, and Cyber Threat Intelligence.
jobs.description:
Sekoia is an AI-native SOC platform combining next-generation SIEM, SOAR, and Cyber Threat Intelligence. Following a €26M Series B in 2025, we are scaling the company and preparing for the next stages of our development.

As Finance Data Analyst, you will turn fragmented financial and corporate data into reliable information for decision-making. Reporting to the Head of Finance and working closely with Data Engineering, you will act as the bridge between Finance and technical teams.

You will map data sources, clarify definitions, investigate discrepancies, and structure the datasets and reporting needed for financial and corporate steering. You will work hands-on with the available data without owning the data lake or every integration end-to-end. Your role will be to challenge data quality and assumptions, document what is missing, and help Finance and leadership rely on consistent and actionable information.

In this evolving environment, you will bring structure while keeping a practical focus on delivering useful analysis, reporting, and automation.

Systems in scope:

Your scope will cover data from the main systems used for financial, commercial, operational, and corporate steering:

  • Data: Metabase (you will be the owner of the tool)

  • Finance and planning: Pennylane, Agicap, Pigment (you will be the owner of the data in the tool), and Excel

  • Revenue and CRM: HubSpot and Younium

  • People and expenses: Lucca, SILAE, Navan, and TeamTailor (ATS - recruitment tool)

  • Cloud and infrastructure: AWS, Azure, and OVH billing data

You will work with Data Engineering and the relevant system owners to connect, transform, document, reconcile, and improve the accessibility of this data.

Your missions:

1. Map and structure Finance data

  • Map the systems, data sources, owners, definitions, and flows used for financial and corporate steering.

  • Identify gaps, inconsistencies, duplications, and reconciliation issues between sources.

  • Define the data requirements for monthly closing, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting.

  • Clarify the definitions and calculation rules for key metrics such as revenue, ARR, NRR, headcount, payroll cost, COGS, cash, and spend.

  • Maintain a prioritised backlog of data needs and improvement opportunities with Finance and Data Engineering.

2. Turn data into reliable analysis

  • Explore and model data from the data lake and connected business systems.

  • Build consistent, documented, and reusable Finance and corporate datasets.

  • Reconcile data across accounting, billing, RevOps, HR, payroll, cash management, and spend-management systems.

  • Produce recurring analyses and reporting to support Finance and leadership decision-making.

  • Build dashboards and self-service views when the underlying data is sufficiently reliable.

  • Support budget-versus-actuals analysis, variance analysis, cash monitoring, headcount planning, and SaaS metrics analysis.

3. Improve data quality and automate reporting

  • Work with Data Engineering and system owners to complete missing data sources, transformations, and quality checks.

  • Automate recurring analyses, reconciliations, and reporting where this creates clear value.

  • Contribute to data quality monitoring, documentation, and governance for Finance-related data.

  • Document data lineage, metric definitions, business rules, and known limitations.

  • Prepare reliable datasets for forecasting, anomaly detection, and future AI use cases.

  • Handle HR, payroll, and other sensitive data with a high level of confidentiality and rigour.

You will work closely with the Head of Finance, Data Engineering, the RevOps Manager, the FinOps Manager, and other data owners across the company to align definitions, clarify responsibilities, and make Finance data more reliable and accessible.

📍The position is ideally based in Paris, but can also be based in Rennes, or fully remote from Europe. Professional trips paid for by the company might be required.

Your profile:

🤩We are excited to meet you if :

  • You have a minimum of 3 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, Finance analytics, FP&A analytics, or a related role.

  • You have strong analytical skills and are able to investigate data across several systems to identify the reasons behind discrepancies.

  • You have a good command of SQL and experience with at least one BI or data-visualisation tool.

  • You are able to translate business questions into clear data requirements, metrics, and analyses.

  • You understand Finance concepts such as budgeting, forecasting, monthly closing, variance analysis, revenue, cash, costs, and unit economics.

  • You have strong Excel or Google Sheets skills, including the ability to audit and structure existing models.

  • You are professionally fluent in English, both written and spoken.

  • You have excellent documentation and communication skills, and are able to work effectively with both Finance and technical teams.

  • You are curious about how the business works, rigorous about data quality, and comfortable making definitions and assumptions explicit.

  • You are able to work autonomously, prioritise pragmatically, and bring structure to an evolving environment.

Nice-to-have:

  • You have experience in a B2B SaaS, software, or scale-up environment.

  • You are familiar with SaaS revenue metrics such as MRR, ARR, NRR, churn, and bookings.

  • You are familiar with SaaS cost metrics, including Storage, Compute, and Retention hosting costs, AI costs, and gross margin.

  • You have experience working with accounting, billing, HRIS, payroll, CRM, spend-management, or planning tools.

  • You understand data warehouses, data modelling, ETL concepts, APIs, or data-quality frameworks.

  • You have experience with Python or another language used for analysis and automation.

  • You have been exposed to HR or payroll data and understand its confidentiality requirements.

👀Are you interested in this job but feel you haven't ticked all the boxes? Don't hesitate to apply, and tell us in the cover letter section why we absolutely must meet!

Recruitment Process:

📝Here's what's in store for you if you apply :

  • HR Interview with Clémentine, Talent Acquisition Manager (30')

  • N+1 Interview with Elie, Head of Finance (60’)

  • Use case to prepare at home

  • Restitution of the use case with a Data team member (30’)

  • N+2 Interview with Thérèse, CFO (60’)

Our process usually takes about 3 weeks, depending on availability; it includes reference calls.
The program: discussions rather than trick questions ! These discussions will help you understand how Sekoia works and what it stands for. But they are also (and above all) an opportunity for you to tell us about your career path and your expectations for your next job!

jobs.description:
Le côté brillant de l'hypothèque
nesto est le chef de file du financement hypothécaire résidentiel numérique au Canada. Nous offrons aux Canadiens les taux les plus bas dès le départ, en toute transparence et sans négociation.

À propos de nous
Pionnier du financement hypothécaire en ligne au Canada, nesto transforme la façon dont les Canadiens financent leur propriété. Notre mission est d'offrir une expérience de financement immobilier positive, valorisante et transparente, simplifiée du début à la fin.
Les emprunteurs profitent de taux souvent plus avantageux que ceux offerts par les grandes banques, ainsi que d'une expérience hypothécaire exceptionnelle, simple et fluide, du début à la fin. Le tout est propulsé par une technologie d'intelligence artificielle de pointe.
Rapide, simple et entièrement numérique, nesto a été nommé Prêteur hypothécaire de l'année par la CLA pendant trois années consécutives. Voilà le côté brillant de l'hypothèque.

Groupe Nesto
Le Groupe Nesto est le principal fournisseur de technologies hypothécaires et de solutions de financement au Canada, avec plus de 80 milliards de dollars canadiens en prêts hypothécaires résidentiels et commerciaux sous administration. Fort de la confiance de plusieurs des principales institutions financières du pays, le Groupe Nesto combine plus de 50 ans d'expertise hypothécaire à ses technologies infonuagiques et d'intelligence artificielle exclusives pour transformer l'avenir du financement.

Grâce à ses technologies infonuagiques et d'intelligence artificielle exclusives, nesto est devenu l'un des prêteurs hypothécaires à la croissance la plus rapide au Canada, gagnant des parts de marché dans le financement résidentiel direct aux consommateurs (D2C), le réseau des courtiers hypothécaires et le financement commercial multirésidentiel. Reconnue au palmarès Fast 50 de Deloitte pendant trois années consécutives, l'entreprise continue de faire progresser le secteur grâce à l'innovation, à la technologie et à des solutions axées sur les clients.

Grâce à sa famille de marques — CMLS, nesto et Nesto Cloud —, le Groupe Nesto a pour mission de bâtir l'écosystème hypothécaire canadien de demain et de devenir un véritable chef de file canadien en technologies de financement et en services financiers.
Pour en savoir plus:
vie chez nesto
Chez nesto, nous avons à cœur de remettre en question le statu quo, d'offrir une meilleure expérience hypothécaire et d'aider les Canadiens à économiser sur leur hypothèque. Nous cultivons une culture de collaboration, de transparence et de créativité, où chaque membre de l'équipe est encouragé à prendre ses projets en main, à avoir un impact concret et à évoluer.
Si vous souhaitez relever des défis stimulants et trouver des solutions à des enjeux importants aux côtés de collègues ambitieux, passionnés et toujours prêts à s'entraider, vous vous sentirez chez vous chez nesto.

À propos du poste
En tant que gestionnaire en ingénierie dans le volet IA, vous dirigerez une équipe de développeurs qui conçoit de l'IA appliquée au service de la souscription hypothécaire chez nesto et chez nos partenaires prêteurs. Vous serez responsable de ce que votre équipe livre et des résultats d'affaires qu'elle génère. Vous travaillerez avec l'équipe Produit pour façonner la feuille de route, fixer des objectifs clairs et livrer des solutions robustes en production. Vous recruterez, accompagnerez et ferez grandir une équipe responsable, rapide et fière de son travail.

À propos de l'équipe

Le volet IA développe Maestro, la plateforme hybride de nesto qui combine des règles déterministes et l'IA pour l'intelligence documentaire, la validation et la prise de décision. Notre travail comprend la classification et l'extraction de documents, les règles de validation, les évaluations (evals) et les services d'IA qui les soutiennent. Nous servons les souscripteurs de nesto et des partenaires prêteurs externes, dans une industrie réglementée où la précision et l'auditabilité sont essentielles.

Dès le début, nous avons créé une plateforme technologique moderne et native du cloud (basée sur Google Cloud) respectant les normes les plus élevées de l'industrie en termes de processus de développement et d'exploitation. Notre back-end est écrit en Go et en Python, sous forme de microservices conteneurisés docker bien découplés via des API RESTful et des files d'attente pub-sub. Ces conteneurs sont orchestrés à l'aide de Kubernetes et instrumentés avec Datadog, et notre infrastructure est gérée à l'aide de Pulumi.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Porter les résultats de votre équipe : fixer des objectifs de sprint et de feuille de route avec des jalons d'affaires et des dates, et les livrer
  • Travailler avec l'équipe Produit comme une seule équipe pour prioriser le travail à plus forte valeur et rendre les compromis visibles
  • Livrer des fonctionnalités d'IA appliquée avec les évaluations, garde-fous et suivis nécessaires dans une industrie réglementée
  • Transformer le travail incertain ou exploratoire en objectifs à durée limitée, avec des décisions et des critères d'arrêt clairs
  • Recruter, accompagner et faire grandir les développeurs; donner une rétroaction directe et gérer la sous-performance
  • Bâtir les dossiers de promotion sur les résultats en production, selon les standards de l'entreprise
  • Tenir la direction et les parties prenantes informées des progrès, des risques et des décisions
  • Améliorer la façon de travailler de l'équipe en éliminant les goulots d'étranglement et en adoptant les outils d'IA

Qui nous recherchons

  • 5+ années d'expérience en développement logiciel, dont 2+ années à gérer une équipe de 5 développeurs ou plus
  • Vous avez livré en production des fonctionnalités basées sur l'IA ou les LLM, ou vous apprenez vite et avez livré des systèmes complexes de données ou de ML
  • Vous êtes assez à l'aise avec Python et/ou Go pour réviser des conceptions et du code avec confiance
  • Les résultats d'affaires vous importent plus que la technologie pour elle-même
  • Vous exprimez vos désaccords ouvertement, puis vous vous engagez et aidez l'équipe à avancer
  • Vous assumez vos échecs et êtes fier(ère) de la croissance de votre équipe
  • Maîtrise de l'anglais requise; le français est un atout important

Pourquoi vous aimeriez travailler ici
Nous croyons que les personnes de talent donnent le meilleur d'elles-mêmes lorsqu'elles sont soutenues sur les plans professionnel, personnel et financier. C'est pourquoi nous offrons un programme de rémunération globale complet, conçu pour vous aider à vous épanouir à chaque étape de votre carrière.

  • Rémunération concurrentielle — Salaire compétitif, primes de rendement (le cas échéant) et reconnaissance de vos contributions.
  • Santé et bien-être — Couverture complète pour les soins médicaux, dentaires et de la vue, comptes de gestion des dépenses santé et bien-être (le cas échéant), télémédecine, programme d'aide aux employés (PAE) et soutien en santé mentale pour vous et votre famille.
  • Du temps pour refaire le plein — Vacances généreuses (4 semaines), congés mobiles et jours fériés pour vous permettre de vous ressourcer.
  • Planification de l'avenir — Cotisation de contrepartie au REER pour soutenir votre bien-être financier à long terme.
  • Soutien aux familles — Prestations complémentaires bonifiées pour les congés de maternité et parentaux.
  • Apprentissage et perfectionnement — Aide financière aux études, mentorat, formations et occasions de faire progresser votre carrière au sein du Groupe Nesto.
  • Des outils pour réussir — Technologies modernes, équipes collaboratives et toutes les ressources nécessaires pour vous dépasser.

Diversité, équité et inclusion
Au sein du Groupe Nesto, nous croyons que la diversité des points de vue fait notre force. Nous nous engageons à favoriser un milieu de travail inclusif où chacun se sent respecté, soutenu et habilité à réussir.
Nous accueillons les candidatures de personnes de tous horizons, y compris les membres des Premiers Peuples (Premières Nations, Inuit et Métis), les personnes en situation de handicap, les membres des communautés racisées, les femmes et les personnes de la communauté 2ELGBTQIA+.
Si vous avez besoin de mesures d'adaptation à n'importe quelle étape du processus de recrutement, nous nous engageons à collaborer avec vous pour répondre à vos besoins.

Product Strategy & GTM Analytics

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.excerpt: Vividly is the leading modern trade promotion management (TPM) solution built by and for the consumer packaged goods industry.
jobs.description:
Vividly is the leading modern trade promotion management (TPM) solution built by and for the consumer packaged goods industry. From campaign creation to deductions management and promotion measurement, we help brands manage every element of trade spend. With our easy-to-use platform and industry-leading experience, we pride ourselves on our ability to bring businesses to the next level.

Not familiar with trade promotion spend? That’s OK. Most people aren’t. It’s an $8 trillion dollar problem that is ripe for disruption by an innovative SaaS startup. In order to grow, consumer packaged goods (CPG) brands spend 20% of their topline revenue to get into retailers and promote their products within those retailers. The problem is that today 70% of those promotions are not ROI positive. This is because ROI is hard to track. The industry operates on emails, pdfs, and xls spreadsheets. At Vividly, we’re solving this massive problem with exciting tactics including AI, Machine Learning, and Fintech and adding value to everyone in the chain. Some of our customers include brands you may use and love - Liquid Death, Amy’s, and Perfect Snacks.

The Opportunity

We’re looking for an Account Executive who brings both SaaS sales expertise and a deep understanding of the CPG ecosystem. This is a unique opportunity to operate at the intersection of technology, finance, and commercial strategy - selling a high-impact solution into organizations where trade spend directly influences revenue, margin, and growth. You will own the full sales cycle, lead complex, multi-stakeholder deals, and partner with senior leaders across Sales, Finance, and Operations to drive meaningful business outcomes.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the full sales cycle - from prospecting through close - focused on acquiring new CPG customers
  • Build and manage a pipeline through outbound prospecting, self-sourcing, and collaboration with SDR and Marketing teams
  • Lead consultative discovery to uncover inefficiencies in trade spend, promotions, and revenue execution
  • Translate customer challenges into quantified business value (e.g., ROI improvement, margin expansion, revenue lift)
  • Navigate and align cross-functional buying groups, including Sales, Finance, Revenue Management, and Operations
  • Drive complex, multi-threaded deals with multiple stakeholders and decision-makers
  • Deliver tailored, value-based presentations that clearly articulate Vividly’s impact
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure long-term customer value
  • Consistently exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets through disciplined pipeline management

Who You Are

You are a consultative, value-driven seller who thrives in complex environments and understands how large organizations make decisions.

You bring a strong grasp of how CPG businesses operate and can confidently engage stakeholders across both commercial and financial functions. You are equally comfortable discussing margin impact with Finance as you are with execution challenges with Sales teams.

You are resourceful, proactive, and motivated by solving real business problems - not just closing deals.

What We’re Looking For

Required

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying experience in SaaS sales, with a track record of closing complex, multi-threaded deals
  • Experience working in or selling into the CPG industry (brand, broker, retailer, or distributor ecosystem)
  • Proven ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders, including Director, VP, and C-level executives
  • Strong experience with consultative sales methodologies (e.g., MEDDIC, Challenger, SPIN, Sandler, or similar)
  • Demonstrated success in outbound prospecting and building pipeline independently
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and storytelling skills

Highly Preferred

  • Experience with trade promotion, revenue management, retail execution, or deductions workflows
  • Background selling data, analytics, or financial SaaS solutions
  • Familiarity with TPM, TPO, or adjacent systems
  • Experience selling into Finance or RevOps functions

Why This Role Is Different

  • Sell into a mission-critical problem: Trade spend is one of the largest and least optimized investments in CPG
  • Engage at the executive level: Work directly with leaders responsible for revenue, margin, and growth
  • Operate in a complex, strategic sales environment: Multi-stakeholder deals with real business impact
  • Define a category: Be part of modernizing trade promotion management—not selling a commoditized solution
  • Leverage your domain expertise: Your CPG knowledge is not a “nice-to-have”—it’s a competitive advantage

Compensation Range:

Base salary: $ 100,000 per year

On-Target Earnings (OTE): $200,000 per year

This information reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position, based on current national and/or regional market data. Minimums and maximums may vary by geography. Individual pay will be determined by factors such as skills, experience, and role relevance. In addition, for this role you will be eligible for On-Target Earnings (OTE): the total compensation you can expect if you achieve 100% of your sales targets (base salary + commission/bonus) — a common practice in sales compensation. Your actual earnings may vary depending on performance, quota attainment, ramp period, and other factors.

Why Choose Vividly?

A modern, remote-first workplace

We are committed to succeeding as a fully remote team, empowering you with the flexibility to thrive, no commute required. Every Vividly team member receives a stipend upon hire to help create a comfortable and productive home office.

Vividly days off & flexible PTO

For most USA holidays that fall on a Monday or Friday, we turn it into a 4 day weekend! Vividly also offers Flexible Time Off (and we really mean it) to help prevent burn out and fuel creativity.

Competitive Benefits

  • Healthcare, Dental and Vision - We cover 100% of your monthly premiums and 50% of all dependents
  • 401(k) - With a 3% employer contribution
  • Weekly $20 Sharebite Meal Stipend - For every meal you purchase, they donate a meal through Feeding America!
  • Monthly $50 Wellness Reimbursement
  • Monthly $200 Remote Work Stipend

Commitment to our values - The Vividly Code

  • Kind Ambition -We push boundaries with empathy and integrity
  • Keep It Real - We are transparent, honest, and authentic
  • Customer Love - We act as trusted advisors to our customers
  • Own It - We take responsibility and drive outcomes
  • Urgency Wins - We move quickly and focus on impact
  • Pull Together - We collaborate to win as a team

Please note: Vividly will never request sensitive information such as your social security number, bank account information, or other non-publicly available information during the application and interview process. If an applicant is extended an offer of employment, such sensitive information will be requested at that time during the onboarding process. Vividly will never ask you to receive and ship packages or goods as part of the interview. Other practices to be on alert for:

vie chez nesto

Nous cultivons une culture de collaboration, de transparence et de créativité, où chaque membre de l'équipe est encouragé à prendre ses projets en main, à avoir un impact concret et à évoluer.
Si vous souhaitez relever des défis stimulants et trouver des solutions à des enjeux importants aux côtés de collègues ambitieux, passionnés et toujours prêts à s'entraider, vous vous sentirez chez vous chez nesto.

À propos du poste
En tant que gestionnaire en ingénierie dans le volet IA, vous dirigerez une équipe de développeurs qui conçoit de l'IA appliquée au service de la souscription hypothécaire chez nesto et chez nos partenaires prêteurs. Vous serez responsable de ce que votre équipe livre et des résultats d'affaires qu'elle génère. Vous travaillerez avec l'équipe Produit pour façonner la feuille de route, fixer des objectifs clairs et livrer des solutions robustes en production. Vous recruterez, accompagnerez et ferez grandir une équipe responsable, rapide et fière de son travail.

À propos de l'équipe

Le volet IA développe Maestro, la plateforme hybride de nesto qui combine des règles déterministes et l'IA pour l'intelligence documentaire, la validation et la prise de décision. Notre travail comprend la classification et l'extraction de documents, les règles de validation, les évaluations (evals) et les services d'IA qui les soutiennent. Nous servons les souscripteurs de nesto et des partenaires prêteurs externes, dans une industrie réglementée où la précision et l'auditabilité sont essentielles.

Dès le début, nous avons créé une plateforme technologique moderne et native du cloud (basée sur Google Cloud) respectant les normes les plus élevées de l'industrie en termes de processus de développement et d'exploitation. Notre back-end est écrit en Go et en Python, sous forme de microservices conteneurisés docker bien découplés via des API RESTful et des files d'attente pub-sub. Ces conteneurs sont orchestrés à l'aide de Kubernetes et instrumentés avec Datadog, et notre infrastructure est gérée à l'aide de Pulumi.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Porter les résultats de votre équipe : fixer des objectifs de sprint et de feuille de route avec des jalons d'affaires et des dates, et les livrer
  • Travailler avec l'équipe Produit comme une seule équipe pour prioriser le travail à plus forte valeur et rendre les compromis visibles
  • Livrer des fonctionnalités d'IA appliquée avec les évaluations, garde-fous et suivis nécessaires dans une industrie réglementée
  • Transformer le travail incertain ou exploratoire en objectifs à durée limitée, avec des décisions et des critères d'arrêt clairs
  • Recruter, accompagner et faire grandir les développeurs; donner une rétroaction directe et gérer la sous-performance
  • Bâtir les dossiers de promotion sur les résultats en production, selon les standards de l'entreprise
  • Tenir la direction et les parties prenantes informées des progrès, des risques et des décisions
  • Améliorer la façon de travailler de l'équipe en éliminant les goulots d'étranglement et en adoptant les outils d'IA

Qui nous recherchons

  • 5+ années d'expérience en développement logiciel, dont 2+ années à gérer une équipe de 5 développeurs ou plus
  • Vous avez livré en production des fonctionnalités basées sur l'IA ou les LLM, ou vous apprenez vite et avez livré des systèmes complexes de données ou de ML
  • Vous êtes assez à l'aise avec Python et/ou Go pour réviser des conceptions et du code avec confiance
  • Les résultats d'affaires vous importent plus que la technologie pour elle-même
  • Vous exprimez vos désaccords ouvertement, puis vous vous engagez et aidez l'équipe à avancer
  • Vous assumez vos échecs et êtes fier(ère) de la croissance de votre équipe
  • Maîtrise de l'anglais requise; le français est un atout important

Pourquoi vous aimeriez travailler ici
Nous croyons que les personnes de talent donnent le meilleur d'elles-mêmes lorsqu'elles sont soutenues sur les plans professionnel, personnel et financier. C'est pourquoi nous offrons un programme de rémunération globale complet, conçu pour vous aider à vous épanouir à chaque étape de votre carrière.

  • Rémunération concurrentielle — Salaire compétitif, primes de rendement (le cas échéant) et reconnaissance de vos contributions.
  • Santé et bien-être — Couverture complète pour les soins médicaux, dentaires et de la vue, comptes de gestion des dépenses santé et bien-être (le cas échéant), télémédecine, programme d'aide aux employés (PAE) et soutien en santé mentale pour vous et votre famille.
  • Du temps pour refaire le plein — Vacances généreuses (4 semaines), congés mobiles et jours fériés pour vous permettre de vous ressourcer.
  • Planification de l'avenir — Cotisation de contrepartie au REER pour soutenir votre bien-être financier à long terme.
  • Soutien aux familles — Prestations complémentaires bonifiées pour les congés de maternité et parentaux.
  • Apprentissage et perfectionnement — Aide financière aux études, mentorat, formations et occasions de faire progresser votre carrière au sein du Groupe Nesto.
  • Des outils pour réussir — Technologies modernes, équipes collaboratives et toutes les ressources nécessaires pour vous dépasser.

Diversité, équité et inclusion
Au sein du Groupe Nesto, nous croyons que la diversité des points de vue fait notre force. Nous nous engageons à favoriser un milieu de travail inclusif où chacun se sent respecté, soutenu et habilité à réussir.
Nous accueillons les candidatures de personnes de tous horizons, y compris les membres des Premiers Peuples (Premières Nations, Inuit et Métis), les personnes en situation de handicap, les membres des communautés racisées, les femmes et les personnes de la communauté 2ELGBTQIA+.
Si vous avez besoin de mesures d'adaptation à n'importe quelle étape du processus de recrutement, nous nous engageons à collaborer avec vous pour répondre à vos besoins.

Preferred Qualifications - Certified Payroll Professional (CPP) certification or equivalent advanced payroll expertise. - Experience with iSolved, or a comparable enterprise payroll system. - Experience with payroll tax account registrations, closures, agency correspondence, and account remediation. - Experience in payroll tax advisory, accounting, consulting, or another professional-services environment. - Experience presenting technical payroll findings and recommendations to clients, managers, or other business stakeholders. Technology at eXp builds the products and platforms that power a cloud-based brokerage serving 80,000+ agents across 29 international markets. With no physical offices, every agent, transaction and piece of data lives on our platform, which makes security and privacy part of the product itself. We're looking for a leader who can protect that platform and the people who rely on it, without slowing down the teams building it.

This role owns the enterprise security and privacy program end to end. You'll set strategy, lead the teams that execute it, and be the accountable leader for cyber risk, incident response, data protection and privacy compliance across the U.S., Canada and our international markets. You'll work closely with AI governance, engineering, Legal and vendor management as we scale AI-enabled tools for our agents.

How you will make an impact:

  • Set security and privacy strategy: define and own the multi-year roadmap, aligned to business and technology priorities, and own the budget behind it.
  • Lead and develop the team: build and grow security engineers, analysts, GRC and privacy professionals, in-house and through partners.
  • Run security operations and incident response: oversee 24/7 monitoring, detection, vulnerability management and threat intelligence; own the incident response plan, tabletop exercises and breach notification process with Legal, Communications and regulators.
  • Embed security in engineering: set standards for secure development, threat modeling, identity and access (SSO, MFA, privileged access) and cloud, endpoint and data platform security.
  • Own the privacy program: manage compliance with applicable laws (including PIPEDA, CCPA/CPRA, other U.S. state laws and GDPR where relevant), privacy impact assessments, data mapping, retention and data subject requests.
  • Manage governance, risk and compliance: maintain the control framework (for example NIST CSF, ISO 27001 or SOC 2), the risk register, policies and standards; run internal and external audits and support SOX requirements with Finance, Legal and Internal Audit.
  • Secure AI and third-party use: partner with AI governance to set security and privacy requirements for AI tools, models and agents; review vendor security and data handling terms, including PII handling and AI usage, before and during every contract.
  • Build awareness: run security and privacy training for employees and 80,000+ independent agents, including phishing simulation.
  • Report on risk: give the CTO, executive team, Audit Committee and Board a clear, business-level view of risk posture and progress.

How you will grab our attention:

  • 10+ years in information security, including 6+ years leading security teams at a large, distributed or cloud-native company.
  • Proven ownership of an enterprise security and privacy program, covering incident response, vulnerability management, identity and cloud security.
  • Working knowledge of privacy law and practice across multiple jurisdictions, including Canadian and U.S. requirements.
  • Experience with at least one major framework (NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2) and with external audits.
  • Strong executive and board communication: you explain risk and trade-offs in plain business terms.

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical field, or equivalent experience.
  • Bonus: public-company experience including SOX-related controls; hands-on experience securing AI and LLM-based systems and agentic workflows; vendor risk experience at enterprise scale; CISSP, CISM, CRISC, CIPP/C, CIPP/US or CIPM; experience in real estate, financial services or another regulated, data-rich industry.

The Staff Global Supply Manager owns supplier relationships from sourcing strategy through purchase order execution for key equipment and hardware suppliers, where cost, supply continuity, and day-to-day delivery all matter at once. The role develops sourcing strategies, leads negotiations and supplier performance governance, and manages supply risk. It also issues and tracks purchase orders, maintains the accuracy of item data and transaction records, and provides the data that Finance, Accounting, and Project Management rely on for cash spend and order liability reporting. Sourcing Strategy & Commercial Leadership

  • Develop and own sourcing strategies for high-value, complex, or strategically important categories and supplier relationships.

  • Drive total cost of ownership analysis, and identify and quantify cost reduction opportunities.
  • Apply knowledge of global supply markets to identify sourcing risks, evaluate alternative supply options, and develop contingency plans, including dual-source plans.

Supplier Relationship & Performance Governance

Procurement & Order Management

  • Own the monthly reporting of open, non-cancellable equipment order liabilities and support the inventory reconciliation process with Accounting.
  • Remain accountable for inventory accuracy and SOX compliance pertaining to transaction records in systems of record, including resolving inventory discrepancies.
  • Support Funding and Legal with invoice management, audits, and compliance documentation.
  • Define, document, and continually improve transaction entry processes to reduce error and cost and to improve visibility of critical information for key internal customers.
