jobs.title: Event Manager Europe
jobs.excerpt: About the Role Europe is where a large share of the endurance sports calendar happens, and COROS shows up at more of it every season.
jobs.description:
About the Role

Europe is where a large share of the endurance sports calendar happens, and COROS shows up at more of it every season. The Event Manager Europe owns how we get there and how it goes, from major running, trail and cycling events to activations in a key retailer's store and alongside COROS athletes, across our five direct European markets and distributor-led territories. This is a delivery role with a seat at the table.

Together with the Country Managers and the Head of Europe, you build the European event calendar and propose events based on what you and the country teams see in the market. Then you make it happen, from logistics, equipment, crew and build-up to on-site presence and an honest post-event read on whether it was worth it. On some projects you lead from concept to post-event report; on others you contribute to a project led by a market team. Which is which depends on the event, the local team and the wider calendar, and agreeing that split early, season by season, is part of the job. The role reports directly to the Head of Europe.

Your playground

  • Build and own the European event calendar together with the Country Managers and the Head of Europe, proposing events proactively based on market and community insight.

  • Plan and deliver COROS integrations and activations at running, trail running, cycling and outdoor events across Europe.

  • Own event logistics end to end: equipment, booth and activation build, demo and test devices, shipping and stock across markets, crew planning and on-site execution.

  • Source and commission event material and suppliers, manage production timelines and keep the European event kit in shape and in the right place.

  • Deliver retail-linked activations and community formats, such as community runs with partner stores, in close coordination with the Retail Marketing Manager Europe and the sales organisation.

  • Act as the point of contact for Country Managers and Sales Managers on everything event-related, from first idea to post-event report.

  • Contribute delivery capacity to projects led by others, whether a market team running a local event or a global vertical team owning a larger brand or sports event.

  • Work with the events function in the US as a peer, engage directly with the headquarters teams in China on event material sourcing, and collaborate with the brand team on event assets.

  • Track cost, reach and outcome per event, report back honestly, and use the data to shape the following season's calendar.

  • Make independent spending decisions within approved event projects.

What you bring to the starting line

Professional Background

  • Experience: 2 years+ in event management, brand activation or field marketing, ideally in sports, outdoor or a comparable consumer brand environment.

  • Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience.

  • Event Delivery: Proven track record of planning and executing physical events and activations end to end, including the unglamorous parts: logistics, shipping, equipment, crew and build-up.

  • Market Knowledge: Familiarity with the European endurance sports calendar and the organisers, communities and audiences around it.

  • Supplier and Budget Handling: Experience negotiating with organisers and suppliers, tracking spend against plan and making the call on what a given event is worth.

  • Multi-Market Work: Comfort coordinating with several country teams whose needs and calendars differ.

Other Key Requirements

  • Collaboration and Organization: Strong project management and communication skills, highly organised, and calm when a plan has to change on site.

  • Mindset: Self-motivated and hands-on. At COROS we do the work ourselves, and that includes carrying the boxes.

  • Physical: Comfortable with hands-on build-up work, including lifting and carrying event equipment.

  • Language: Fluency in English, spoken and written. An additional European language is a plus.

  • Mobility: Substantial travel across Europe during the event season, including weekends, with time off in lieu. Valid driver's license.

How the role will grow

COROS Europe is growing fast, and this role is built to grow with it. As the European event programme expands and individual markets develop their own capacity, the scope of this role is likely to shift: fewer markets to cover, more depth and ownership in the ones that remain. How that plays out will depend on how the business develops and on the strengths the person in this role brings. What we can say today is that this is a function being built rather than inherited, and that the person building it will shape what it becomes.

The Setup

  • Reporting Line: Head of Europe.

  • Scope: Five direct European markets plus distributor-led territories.

  • Location: Remote, anywhere in the EU or the UK, within easy reach of a major airport. Wherever you're based, we'll set you up with a local employment contract.

  • Working Mode: Fully remote or hybrid if you live close to an office location, with occasional team get-togethers.

  • Job Type: Full-time.

Package & Benefits

  • Work in a motivated, international team.

  • Co-own the European event programme of a fast-growing brand from day one.

  • Space for ideas and independent work.

  • Flat hierarchy with short decision-making processes.

  • 25 days of paid vacation plus standard local holidays.

  • Compensation: The base salary range for this position starts at €45.000,- annually with the possibility to earn a performance-based bonus on top. This is the least we can do for you. The final offer depends on your experience, background, and location.

Volleyball is already the #1 most played girls' youth sport. There are 38M current and former players today. Of major sports, it's the only one that is women-first (~90% of players are female). But the volleyball market has been almost entirely missed by traditional sports investors, brands, and media.

LOVB is capturing this opportunity by creating a strong club business, and from that built-in audience and fandom, is creating the best Pro League in the world and a digital ecosystem that will connect all aspects of LOVB. This community-up approach will drive participation and fandom, while enabling greater empowerment for girls and young women living this amazing sport. About Leo Berwick

Leo Berwick is an innovative mergers and acquisitions consulting firm. We are composed of experienced advisors from global law and accounting firms who add value to transactions as trusted partners throughout the deal life cycle. At Leo Berwick, we hire the best and the brightest. Our teams deliver a dedicated and customized service to every client.

Within Leo Berwick, our technology, data, and AI team works with infrastructure and private equity clients, and private market investors and their portfolio companies, across the full deal lifecycle, from M&A services to AI strategy and execution. We believe technology can have an outsized impact on firm performance and enterprise value.

As a growth-stage firm, we move quickly, work collaboratively, and value people who take initiative and thrive in a fast-paced environment. Our culture is grounded in high performance, continuous learning, and the shared ambition to build something exceptional, together.

About the Role:

Leo Berwick is hiring a Senior Leader (Managing Director or Partner) to build and scale our power, utilities, and renewables practice, one of our core sectors. This is a senior, client-facing leadership role for someone with deep industry expertise in power, utilities, or renewables, paired with technology and/or data depth. You will lead technology diligence and data and AI value creation initiatives for PE sponsors and infrastructure funds investing in the energy and infrastructure space.

We’re looking for someone with 10–15+ years of experience, built at a technology consultancy, a boutique advisory firm, or as an operator in industry. You should be ready to build and sell a practice, not just deliver within one. Experience in technology consulting and M&A is an asset, but sector credibility and technical depth come first.

In this leadership role, you will have defined responsibilities and a focus area, and you will also be part of the leadership team, exposed to all aspects of building and growing the business and contributing well beyond your own practice.

Why Join Us:

  • The opportunity to help build and shape our technology, data and AI - power, utilities and renewables practice from the ground up
  • Equity participation aligned to the value you create
  • Direct access to leadership and accelerated career growth
  • Competitive compensation (base + performance bonus) and comprehensive benefits
  • Flexible, remote-first work model across North America
  • Significant breadth of experience: work across deal stages and problem types with C-suite portfolio company leaders and PE sponsors focused on infrastructure and the energy transition

What you'll do

Practice Leadership & Growth

•Sector Practice Building: Lead the build-out of Leo Berwick’s power, utilities and renewables technology advisory practice, defining our point of view, offerings, and go-to-market approach for the sector.

•Business Development: Originate and close new engagements with PE sponsors, infrastructure funds, and corporate acquirers active in power, utilities, and renewables. Bring the capability to build a book of business, recognizing any portable relationships remain subject to prior firm non-compete and non-solicit obligations.

•Internal Enablement: Train and mentor staff on how to run technology diligence in the sector — the operational, regulatory, and technology nuances specific to power and utilities that don’t show up in a generalist diligence approach.

Full-Lifecycle Deal Advisory

•Diligence & Risk Assessment: Lead buy-side and sell-side technology diligence workstreams to evaluate target technology environments, architecture, and organizational readiness ahead of a transaction.

•Carve-Out & Separation: Own technology separation planning and execution for carve-out transactions, including TSA scope definition, stranded cost management, and TSA exit strategy.

•Integration: Lead post-merger technology integration planning and execution, ensuring synergy realization and business continuity through Day 1 and beyond.

Client & Stakeholder Management

•Executive Relationships: Serve as the primary technology advisor to portfolio company C-suite executives (CIO, CTO, CDO) and PE deal teams throughout the transaction lifecycle.

•Engagement Leadership: Own engagement delivery end-to-end, managing cross-functional teams and ensuring quality, timeliness, and client satisfaction.

Firm Leadership & Collaboration

•Leadership Breadth: As part of the leadership team, contribute to all aspects of building and growing the business, and collaborate across practices and service lines (including data, AI and cyber engagements beyond your sector focus) as your expertise allows.

What We're Looking For:

In order of priority:

1. Sector Depth

•Power, Utilities & Renewables Expertise: Direct, hands-on experience serving clients in renewables, power generation, or utilities — not adjacent sectors like oil & gas or industrial products, and not corporate functions (e.g., finance) within a utility. This is the most important qualification for this role.

2. Technology & Data Depth

•Technical Depth: At Leo Berwick, leaders are in the architecture reviews, not just the readouts. On a typical engagement that means personally assessing a target’s architecture, reviewing its OT and IT environments (SCADA, EMS/DMS, AMI, GIS, asset and work management, ERP), interviewing IT and operations leadership, and writing the findings the deal team relies on.

•Active Technology Practitioner: You have built software or data solutions in your career (applications, data pipelines, analytics models, or integrations) and remain capable of getting into a build if an engagement calls for it.

•Data & AI Depth: Deep expertise in data and AI is essential, as it is what clients value most for diligence and value creation. This includes experience designing and executing AI use cases and conducting AI impact assessments.

•Cybersecurity & Compliance: Experience assessing cybersecurity and compliance risk, particularly for asset-heavy targets, is a decided asset when paired with your data and AI depth.

3. Seniority & Leadership

•Experience Level: You bring 10–15+ years of relevant experience in a leadership role.

•Commercial Acumen: Demonstrated ability to originate and grow business, not solely execute within an existing book of work.

•Team & Client Leadership: Experience leading cross-functional, often distributed teams, and building trust with senior executives and investment professionals.

Considered an Asset

•Technology M&A & Consulting Experience: A track record of buy-side, sell-side, carve-out, separation, or integration work in a deal context, as an advisor or as an operator inside an M&A process.

•PE or Fund-Facing Experience: Experience advising private equity firms, infrastructure funds, or corporate acquirers is strongly preferred.

Location

•This is a remote-first role based anywhere in North America. Travel is required across North America. Strong sector alignment is prioritized over location.

Benefits & Perks North America

  • Unlimited paid time off, including 2 weeks of disconnected time each year
  • Flexible working arrangements – remote and location flexibility
  • Attractive medical and dental insurance
  • Pension & retirement contributions

Accommodations are available upon request at any stage of the hiring process, in accordance with applicable accessibility and human rights legislation.

This role...


Employment Practice Leadership

  • Serves as the primary legal advisor to Human Resources and business leaders on the full range of employment and labor matters, including employee relations, investigations, accommodations, leave, wage and hour, discipline and terminations, reductions in force, and restrictive covenants.
  • Manages the employment matter portfolio end to end, including agency charges, demand letters, pre-litigation disputes, and settlement strategy, and direct outside counsel on litigated matters.

Function Operations & Process Improvement

  • Builds and runs the operating infrastructure for the employment function, including intake, triage, matter tracking, metrics, and regular reporting to the Deputy General Counsel.

  • Selects, deploys, and maintains legal technology for the function, including matter management, document automation, and AI-assisted tools.

Employment Governance & Compliance

  • Owns the employment compliance calendar and audit program, including postings, notices, filings, pay transparency, I-9, and EEO reporting obligations.
  • Monitors and implements changes in federal, state, and local employment law, with particular focus on multistate compliance.
  • Supports the remediation of legacy HR legal documentation and compliance gaps in partnership with the Deputy General Counsel.

Risk Management & Insurance

  • Partners with Risk and Finance on the corporate insurance program, including EPLI, D&O, fiduciary, and cyber coverage, and support renewals, coverage analysis, notice, and claims management.

Enterprise Initiatives

jobs.description:
Full-Stack Developer

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We are looking for a Full-Stack Developer with strong experience in TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Postgres to build and ship features across a modern client portal.

You’ll own features from design through production, working across the frontend, backend, database, and integrations as needed. This is a hands-on role where you’ll be expected to think beyond the happy path, build reliable features, and improve the codebase as you go.

You’ll work closely with a small engineering and product team, receiving fast feedback and having significant ownership over what you build.

What You’ll Own

End-to-End Feature Development

  • Take features from design prototype through production
  • Build frontend interfaces using TypeScript, React, and Next.js
  • Handle route handlers, database migrations, emails, and UI as part of a complete feature
  • Work across candidate profiles, roles and candidates pages, interview flows, billing, and other portal features
  • Ensure features are production-ready rather than focused only on the happy path

Data & UI Resilience

  • Build features that handle real-world data and edge cases
  • Account for empty states, error states, long names, lengthy CVs, and multiple applications
  • Ensure UI states are clear, intentional, and user-friendly
  • Identify potential edge cases before they become production issues
  • Improve existing features when you identify reliability or usability gaps

Testing & Code Quality

  • Write automated tests for areas that currently lack coverage
  • Add regression coverage for new features and important workflows
  • Keep the codebase stable and maintainable
  • Identify and resolve issues discovered through testing or code review
  • Leave each area of the codebase better than you found it

Database & Backend

  • Write and review Postgres migrations
  • Work confidently with SQL, joins, and database relationships
  • Read and reason about row-level security policies
  • Maintain predictable Supabase Auth and Realtime behavior
  • Understand how frontend, backend, and database changes work together

Third-Party Integrations

  • Work with integrations such as Stripe, Resend, Workable, and SparkHire
  • Connect third-party services to product features when required
  • Troubleshoot integration-related issues
  • Read and understand the existing Python FastAPI service when features interact with AI or data functionality

Code Review & Collaboration

  • Write clear and well-documented pull requests
  • Provide enough context for reviewers to understand and approve changes efficiently
  • Participate in code reviews and incorporate feedback
  • Progress toward reviewing API and database migration pull requests independently
  • Collaborate directly with engineering and product team members in a fast feedback environment

Requirements

  • 2–4 years of experience shipping production TypeScript and React applications
  • Strong experience with Next.js, ideally including App Router, Server Components, and Route Handlers
  • Solid understanding of SQL and relational databases
  • Ability to write joins, read migrations, and understand database relationships
  • Understanding of Postgres and row-level security concepts
  • Experience building production-ready UIs with thoughtful empty, loading, and error states
  • Experience working in a monorepo or codebase where features span frontend, backend, and database layers
  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests
  • Familiarity with pull requests and modern code-review workflows
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
  • Ability to own features independently from requirements through deployment
  • Strong written communication and attention to detail

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with Supabase
  • Experience with Stripe or Resend
  • Experience working with Workable or SparkHire integrations
  • Familiarity with Python and FastAPI
  • Experience with unit or integration testing
  • Experience working with AI or data-focused backend services
  • Experience using tools such as CodeRabbit or similar AI-assisted code review tools
  • Previous experience working in a small, fast-moving product team

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Can take a feature from a brief to production without needing every task broken down
  • Think about migrations, edge cases, testing, and integrations alongside the UI
  • Care about how features behave with real-world data
  • Communicate proactively when you encounter blockers
  • Welcome feedback and use it to improve your work
  • Are comfortable working across both frontend and backend systems
  • Prefer shipping small, reliable improvements consistently
  • Take pride in leaving the codebase cleaner and more stable than you found it

What Success Looks Like

  • Features move efficiently from design to production
  • New functionality works reliably across real-world data scenarios
  • Strong automated test coverage across key areas of the portal
  • Database migrations and security policies remain reliable and well-structured
  • Pull requests are clear, focused, and easy to review
  • Third-party integrations work consistently across product workflows
  • Bugs and edge cases are identified and addressed proactively
  • The codebase becomes more stable and maintainable over time

Typical Day

Your day may start with a design prototype, feature request, or product comment. You’ll work across the stack to turn that requirement into a production-ready feature—writing the database migration, building the UI, implementing the route handler, connecting required integrations, and adding tests.

Other days may involve fixing an edge case that surfaced in production, such as a candidate with multiple applications causing an unexpected issue in a list view. You’ll investigate the problem, implement the fix, test it, and deploy the improvement.

The team operates with a tight feedback loop, so expect short standups, direct collaboration, and most decisions to happen through comments and pull requests rather than lengthy meetings.

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application Review
  2. AI Rating & Recruiter Screening
  3. Technical/Client Interview
  4. Final Selection & Onboarding

Join a collaborative, agile development team dedicated to delivering innovative IT modernization solutions for the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (EPA). As a Senior Data Engineer, you will play a critical role in designing, building, and optimizing scalable data solutions that support scientific research, environmental analysis, and mission-critical decision-making.

Working closely with government stakeholders, software developers, data analysts, and business teams, you will help transform complex environmental data into reliable, accessible, and actionable information. This role offers the opportunity to apply modern data engineering practices and technologies in support of scientific and regulatory initiatives that have a meaningful impact on public health and the environment.

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and workflows to ingest, transform, validate, and deliver data from diverse sources.

  • Administer, monitor, and enhance relational and non-relational databases, including MySQL, PostgreSQL, and MongoDB.
  • Design and implement efficient, high-performing data models that ensure data quality, scalability, and ease of use.
  • Collaborate with software engineers, data scientists, business analysts, and EPA stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
  • Develop and maintain data integration strategies that support modern, cloud-enabled architectures and enterprise data management practices.
  • Troubleshoot data quality issues, performance bottlenecks, and system integration challenges.
  • Implement best practices for data governance, security, documentation, and lifecycle management.

  • Evaluate and recommend emerging technologies, tools, and methodologies to enhance the EPA's data ecosystem.

  • 9+ years of experience in data engineering, database development, or related technical roles.
  • Strong experience designing, developing, and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python for data processing, automation, and integration.
  • Deep expertise in SQL, database optimization, query tuning, and data modeling.
  • Experience working with both relational databases (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB or similar).
  • Strong understanding of data management principles, data architecture, and data governance practices.
  • Experience working within Agile software development environments.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

  • Excellent critical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Superior oral and written communications skills, and a demonstrated ability to maintain a patient and professional demeanor, with a can-do attitude.
  • Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly and professionally to both technical and non-technical parties (who may be key stakeholders).
  • Ability to manage equipment and services in remote locations.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote team environment.
  • Workability to perform well under pressure.
  • Strong customer service orientation.
  • Ability to maintain an organized workflow, with a high degree of attention to detail.

Beneficial:

  • Experience with cloud-based data platforms and services (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
  • Experience supporting analytics, reporting, machine learning, or scientific data processing workloads.
  • Knowledge of data quality frameworks, metadata management, and data governance tools.

Student Support and Intervention

  • Provide targeted small-group or individual instruction to students struggling in reading, math, or other core subjects
  • Implement evidence-based intervention strategies aligned with student needs and curriculum
  • Monitor and track student progress and adjust interventions accordingly
  • Support students in developing study skills, executive functioning, and independent learning strategies

​Collaboration with Classroom Teachers

Assessment and Data Management

  • Maintain accurate records of interventions, student performance, and progress reports

Family Communication and Support

  • Communicate with families regarding student progress and intervention plans

Professional Development and Collaboration

  • Collaborate with SPED staff and school leadership to ensure best practices in academic support

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree preferred
  • Valid teaching certification preferred

  • Experience in online or blended learning environments preferred

Instructional Skills

  • Knowledge of reading and math intervention programs and strategies

Collaboration and Communication

  • Strong ability to work collaboratively with teachers, parents, and leadership
  • Clear and professional communication skills

jobs.excerpt: Senior Manager, Strategic Sourcing – OEM Department: Global Strategic Sourcing Level: Senior Manager Reports To: Director, Strategic Sourcing Location: Remote Position Summary The Senior Manager, Strategic Sourcing – OEM is responsible for developing and executing the global sourcing strategy for CONMED’s Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and contract manufacturing portfolio.
jobs.description:
Senior Manager, Strategic Sourcing – OEM

Department: Global Strategic Sourcing
Level: Senior Manager
Reports To: Director, Strategic Sourcing
Location: Remote


Position Summary

The Senior Manager, Strategic Sourcing – OEM is responsible for developing and executing the global sourcing strategy for CONMED’s Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) and contract manufacturing portfolio.

This role owns the strategic and commercial relationship with key OEM partners and is accountable for delivering measurable improvements in cost, quality, delivery, supply continuity, innovation, working capital, and supplier performance. The Senior Manager will establish long-term sourcing strategies, lead complex commercial negotiations, strengthen supplier governance, and proactively manage supply and business risk across critical external manufacturing partnerships.

The role requires significant cross-functional leadership and the ability to influence across Global Operations, Engineering, Quality, R&D/NPI, Finance, Planning, Regulatory, and Legal to ensure sourcing decisions support CONMED’s operational, financial, and growth objectives.


Key Responsibilities


OEM Sourcing Strategy

  • Own and execute the multi-year global OEM sourcing strategy, aligning supplier capabilities, footprint, technology, capacity, cost, and risk with CONMED's business priorities.
  • Develop segmentation strategies for strategic OEM and contract manufacturing partners based on business criticality, spend, technology, supply risk, and growth potential.
  • Identify opportunities for supplier consolidation, diversification, localization, dual sourcing, outsourcing, and strategic partnerships.
  • Develop and maintain sourcing roadmaps that balance cost competitiveness, supply continuity, quality, innovation, responsiveness, and long-term capability.

Strategic Supplier & Relationship Management

  • Establish executive-level governance with critical OEM partners, including structured business reviews, performance scorecards, strategic roadmaps, and improvement plans.
  • Build long-term supplier relationships that create value beyond transactional cost reduction, including innovation, capacity, productivity, quality, and speed-to-market.
  • Lead supplier performance improvement and recovery plans when performance does not meet CONMED expectations.
  • Hold suppliers accountable for sustainable performance across quality, delivery, cost, service, compliance, and innovation.

Complex Negotiations & Commercial Management

  • Lead high-value and complex commercial negotiations with OEM and contract manufacturing partners.
  • Develop negotiation strategies leveraging should-cost models, open-book costing, benchmarks, total cost of ownership (TCO), market intelligence, volume leverage, and financial modeling.
  • Negotiate and manage long-term agreements covering pricing, productivity commitments, capacity, lead times, inventory, tooling, intellectual property, warranty, liability, continuity, and other critical commercial terms.
  • Partner with Legal, Quality, Finance, and business stakeholders to develop commercial structures that appropriately balance value and business risk.

Cost & Financial Performance

  • Develop and execute productivity pipelines delivering sustainable cost savings and cost avoidance across the OEM portfolio.
  • Understand supplier cost structures and identify opportunities across materials, labor, overhead, manufacturing processes, yield, logistics, and supply-chain design.
  • Translate sourcing strategies into measurable P&L, PPV, cash, inventory, and working-capital impact.
  • Partner with Finance to validate savings and communicate financial implications, investments, and trade-offs to leadership.

Supply Continuity & Risk Management

  • Proactively identify and mitigate supplier risks related to capacity, financial health, quality, geopolitical exposure, tariffs, sole-source dependencies, technology, regulatory requirements, and business continuity.
  • Develop mitigation strategies including alternate sourcing, capacity reservations, inventory strategies, supplier diversification, localization, and business continuity plans.
  • Lead critical OEM supplier escalations and coordinate cross-functional recovery efforts.
  • Maintain clear executive visibility to material supply risks and mitigation plans.

NPI & Innovation

  • Engage early with R&D, Engineering and NPI teams to influence sourcing decisions, supplier selection, manufacturability, cost, capacity, and supply strategy.
  • Ensure OEM partners are appropriately involved in new product development and product transfer initiatives.
  • Evaluate suppliers based on technology, engineering capability, scalability, compliance, cost competitiveness, and speed-to-market.
  • Drive early supplier involvement to improve product cost, manufacturability, quality, and launch readiness.

Cross-Functional & Enterprise Leadership

  • Serve as the strategic sourcing leader for OEM-related decisions across CONMED.
  • Influence senior stakeholders across Operations, Engineering, Quality, R&D/NPI, Planning, Finance, Regulatory and Legal without relying on direct authority.
  • Lead cross-functional sourcing initiatives and complex supplier decisions where competing business priorities must be balanced.
  • Translate complex supplier, cost, market, and risk information into clear executive recommendations.

Compliance & Responsible Sourcing

  • Ensure sourcing strategies and supplier relationships support applicable medical-device quality, regulatory, ESG, ethical sourcing, and compliance requirements.
  • Partner with Quality and Regulatory teams to ensure supplier qualification and change requirements are appropriately considered in sourcing decisions.
  • Incorporate responsible sourcing and supplier accountability expectations into strategic supplier management.

Education & Experience


Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Finance, Operations, or related discipline.
  • 8+ years of progressive experience in strategic sourcing, procurement, supply chain, supplier management, operations, or a related discipline.

Preferred

  • MBA, Master's degree, or equivalent advanced education.
  • Experience within medical device, life sciences, healthcare, or another highly regulated manufacturing environment.
  • Experience supporting NPI, product transfers, manufacturing outsourcing, and supplier transitions.
  • Experience working with global manufacturing and supplier networks.

The interpreter breaks the communication barrier in a wide range of industries that LanguageLine Solutions serves: Healthcare, Government, Insurance, Financial, Utilities, Travel & Hospitality, General Business, Law Enforcement, Court, and 911.


The interpreter processes information quickly, concisely and recognizes sensitive cultural differences. The interpreter is professional and courteous at all times and uses appropriate terminology and understands common industry procedures and practices. The interpreting sessions may involve simple or complex, technical or non-technical subjects.


This position does not involve written translation however translators and other skilled linguists are encouraged to apply. The Interpreters translate verbally.

  • Respond to the interpreting sessions promptly and conduct interpretation in a friendly and professional manner.

jobs.description:
Actionstep is a pioneer in cloud-based Legal Practice Management software (SaaS). Headquartered in Denver, with a growing global team across the UK, US, Australia and New Zealand, we empower thousands of law firms worldwide to run more profitable and efficient practices. We are fast-growing, innovative, and deeply focused on the success of our partners and customers. Partners are our growth engine: they source about half of our pipeline and implement 95%+ of new ARR.

The Director, Partner Lifecycle Automation & Tools leads the agentification of Actionstep’s partner engine. You will redesign how we recruit and enable partners, sell with them, implement, oversee and hand over customers, so that agents do the high-volume, rules-based and document-heavy work, and our people focus on judgement, relationships and accountability.

You will own the Partners & Services automation roadmap across the six plays and the lifecycle (recruit → enable → deliver → automate → capture). Your team owns the lifecycle use cases and feeds its automation and tools capability into the AI CoE (Nick), which keeps the shared platform and heavier agent builds. You will drive adoption across Actionstep teams and our partners, and prove the value in hours removed, time to go-live, failure to launch avoided and EBITDA delivered.

Who You Are

• A process redesigner first: you start from the outcome and redesign the workflow, rather than automating today’s steps.

• Hands-on with AI: you have built and shipped LLM-based agents, skills or automations yourself, and know where they fail.

• Value-obsessed: you set baselines before you build and report impact in dollars and hours.

• A translator: equally credible with partner consultants, PMs, engineers and the CFO.

• A change leader: you know adoption is the hard part, and you design for it.

• Pragmatic about risk: you design human-in-the-loop controls, data privacy and accuracy checks in from day one.

What you will do

Strategy and roadmap

• Own the Partners & Services automation roadmap across the partner lifecycle and the six plays, sequenced in waves by value and data readiness (Wave 1 from November: Project Health, Decision Tracker, Deal Readiness pilot).

• Maintain the agent portfolio with the COE KPI fields for each initiative: impact type, annual run rate, FY impact, go-live date and first-dollar date.

• Prioritise with David, the AI CoE and business owners; retire initiatives that don’t prove value.

Process redesign and delivery

• For each play, redesign the process with the business owner, defining what the agent does and what people decide.

• Act as product owner for each agent: requirements, acceptance criteria, testing with real projects, release and iteration.

• Build light agents, Claude skills and automations directly; feed this capability into the AI CoE (Nick), which keeps the shared platform and heavier agent builds, and work with Product, which owns API/MCP.

• Unblock high-value enablers, e.g. handing LA data loads to certified partners (de-encryption release, tools and training: ~3 FTE, $250k+ per year).

Data and tool foundations

• Join up the partner data chain (Salesforce, Asana, PlanHat, Zendesk, Academy) so projects carry ARR, readiness score, partner and status end to end.

• Own the partner-facing tool stack: Academy and certification tracking, partner scorecards, the Enablement Assistant and the partner portal experience.

• Set standards for data quality, access, privacy and human review of agent outputs.

Adoption and value

• Drive adoption across Actionstep teams and partners: training, playbooks, champions and usage tracking.

• Report agent impact monthly to David and the AI CoE, and feed the Phase 1 and Phase 2 scorecards.

• Build a small, high-performing team of 3 FTEs (data migration, configuration, automation) and an AI-first way of working across Partners & Services.

Requirements

What you Bring

• 8+ years across business process automation, professional services operations, revenue/partner operations or product management in B2B SaaS, with 3+ years leading a team.

• Proven delivery of AI agents or LLM-based automation into production business workflows, with measured outcomes.

• Strong process design and change management skills (e.g. Lean, Six Sigma or service design).

• Working knowledge of Salesforce, Asana, PlanHat, Zendesk or similar, and of APIs and integration tools.

• Ability to build business cases and track benefits with Finance.

• Clear, confident communicator with executives, engineers and partners.

Advantages (strongly preferred)

• Hands-on experience with Claude, agent frameworks, MCP or similar tooling.

• Experience in partner or channel ecosystems, implementation services, or LegalTech.

• Experience with data migration or system configuration tooling.

  • 401K with company match
  • Flexible working and PTO
  • Take your birthday off
  • Frequent team building events
  • Fantastic training and development opportunities

jobs.description:
deine rolle bei karriere tutor

Du möchtest die Produktion digitaler Lernangebote aktiv mitgestalten und dafür sorgen, dass aus guten Konzepten hochwertige und praxisnahe Lernprodukte entstehen? Du behältst auch bei komplexen Produktionsprozessen den Überblick, koordinierst unterschiedliche Beteiligte und interessierst dich dafür, wie KI die Content- und Medienproduktion effizienter gestalten kann?

Als Product Owner Learning Content (m/w/d) übernimmst du bei Karriere Tutor in Vollzeit die Verantwortung für die Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung unserer hybriden Lernprodukte innerhalb der Produktion. Du begleitest den gesamten Produktionsprozess – von der Auftragsklärung über die Content- und Medienproduktion bis hin zur qualitätsgesicherten Fertigstellung. Dabei sorgst du dafür, dass Lernziele, Qualität, Termine und Ressourcen im Einklang stehen und alle Beteiligten reibungslos zusammenarbeiten.

Zu deinen Aufgaben gehören insbesondere:
  • Lernprodukte konkretisieren: Du übersetzt Produktkonzepte und fachliche Anforderungen in klare Produktionsaufträge mit definierten Zielgruppen, Lernzielen, Inhalten und Qualitätskriterien.
  • Produktion eigenständig steuern: Du planst Arbeitspakete, Prioritäten und Meilensteine, stimmst Kapazitäten ab und behältst Abhängigkeiten sowie Risiken im Blick. Bei Zielkonflikten führst du Entscheidungen herbei.
  • Zusammenarbeit organisieren: Du briefst und koordinierst interne und externe Fachexpert:innen, Autor:innen und Produktionspartner und arbeitest eng mit Fachbereichsleitungen, Operations und Medienproduktion zusammen.
  • KI sinnvoll einsetzen: Du betreust KI-gestützte Workflows und Agenten für die Content-Erstellung, prüfst ihre Ergebnisse und entwickelst die Abläufe gemeinsam mit den beteiligten Teams weiter.
  • Qualität und Übergabe sichern: Du organisierst Reviews, Abnahmen und Freigaben und stellst sicher, dass Lernmaterialien vollständig, konsistent und einsatzbereit übergeben werden.
  • Bestehende Angebote verbessern: Du nutzt Feedback und Kennzahlen, um Inhalte und Produktionsprozesse weiterzuentwickeln. Gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichsleitungen identifizierst du, wo Kurse aktualisiert, zusammengeführt oder neu entwickelt werden sollten.

dein profil

jobs.title: Director of HR, Hospitality Vertical
jobs.excerpt: Job Summary: The HR Director – Hospitality Vertical is a senior HR leader responsible for defining and executing the people strategy across the Hospitality Vertical within Volaris Group.
jobs.description:
Job Summary:

The HR Director – Hospitality Vertical is a senior HR leader responsible for defining and executing the people strategy across the Hospitality Vertical within Volaris Group. The role partners closely with the Hospitality Vertical CEO and other members of the Vertical Leadership Team, Business Unit leaders, and other HR partners. You will ensure that talent and organizational priorities support the Vertical's long-term growth, performance, and strategic objectives.

Operating within Volaris' decentralized business model, the HR Director provides strategic leadership, frameworks, and guidance while enabling Business Units to maintain appropriate autonomy. The role serves as a trusted advisor to the Vertical CEO and senior leaders on organizational effectiveness, leadership capability, talent, compensation, workforce planning, employee relations, and organizational change.

The HR Director also plays a significant role in the Hospitality Vertical's acquisition strategy, leading HR due diligence and supporting the integration of newly acquired businesses into the Vertical.

Job Description:

Job Responsibilities:

People Strategy & Executive Partnership

  • Partner with the Hospitality Vertical CEO and other members of the Vertical Leadership Team to develop and execute a people strategy aligned with the Vertical's business objectives and long-term priorities.
  • Serve as a trusted advisor to the Vertical CEO, other members of the Vertical Leadership Team, and Business Unit leaders on organizational structure, leadership effectiveness, workforce planning, talent decisions, and complex employee matters.
  • Translate Vertical and Business Unit priorities into practical HR initiatives that strengthen organizational capability and support profitable growth.
  • Identify people-related risks and opportunities across the Hospitality Vertical and develop appropriate strategies to address them.
  • Provide leadership, direction, and guidance to HR professionals supporting businesses across the Vertical.

Talent & Succession

  • Lead the Hospitality Vertical's talent management strategy, including talent reviews, succession planning, leadership development, and identification of high-potential talent.
  • Establish consistent approaches for assessing performance, potential, leadership capability, and organizational readiness across Business Units.
  • Partner with the Vertical Leadership Team and Business Unit leaders to build succession pipelines for critical leadership and specialist roles.
  • Support leadership development initiatives and strengthen management capability throughout the Vertical.
  • Facilitate the movement and development of talent across Business Units and the broader Volaris organization where appropriate.

Performance & Compensation

  • Provide strategic leadership for performance management, goal setting, and annual performance review processes across the Hospitality Vertical.
  • Lead Vertical-level merit and compensation planning, including budget development, market benchmarking, and guidance to Business Unit leaders.
  • Partner with leadership on incentive and bonus structures that align employee outcomes with business performance.
  • Promote consistent compensation principles while recognizing differences in business models, geography, talent markets, and organizational maturity.
  • Analyze workforce and compensation data to identify trends and support informed business decisions.

M&A Due Diligence & Integration

  • Lead the HR workstream for Hospitality Vertical acquisitions, including HR due diligence, identification of employment-related risks, and assessment of compensation, benefits, organizational structure, talent, and HR practices.
  • Partner with the Vertical CEO, other members of the Vertical Leadership Team, M&A, Legal, Finance, and Business Unit leadership throughout the acquisition process.
  • Develop and oversee HR integration plans for newly acquired businesses, balancing Volaris and Vertical requirements with the operating independence of acquired companies.
  • Advise leadership on organizational design, retention, leadership continuity, employee communications, and other people considerations associated with acquisitions.
  • Continuously improve HR due diligence and integration processes based on acquisition experience and the evolving needs of the Hospitality Vertical.

Organizational Effectiveness & Change

  • Advise the Vertical CEO, Vertical Leadership Team, and Business Unit leaders on organizational design and ensure structures, roles, and leadership capabilities support business strategy.
  • Lead or support significant organizational changes, including restructurings, leadership transitions, acquisitions, and organizational realignments.
  • Develop practical change and communication strategies that help leaders successfully implement organizational changes.
  • Support Business Units in building scalable people practices as their organizations grow and evolve.


HR Operations, Governance & Risk

  • Establish appropriate HR standards, frameworks, and governance across the Hospitality Vertical while preserving Volaris' decentralized operating philosophy.
  • Ensure Business Units maintain effective HR practices and comply with applicable employment requirements in the jurisdictions in which they operate.
  • Partner with Legal and external advisors on complex employment matters and significant employee relations issues.
  • Provide oversight and guidance related to HR systems, policies, benefits, payroll, and other HR operational processes where Vertical-level coordination creates value.
  • Use workforce analytics and HR metrics to identify trends, risks, and opportunities and provide meaningful insights to the Vertical CEO and Vertical Leadership Team.

Job Requirements:


Required Training and Education:

  • Bachelors degree in Business Administration, HR Management or similar equivalent

Desired Training and Education:

  • Master’s Degree in Business Administration, HR Management or HR Certification

Certification or Licensing:

  • Not required but preferred

Required Experience:

  • 6+ years of progressive HR leadership experience, preferably supporting multiple businesses, divisions, or geographic regions.
  • Experience operating as a strategic HR partner to Senior Executives and business leaders.
  • Strong experience in talent management, succession planning, organizational design and compensation.
  • Strong understanding of employment practices, employee relations, and HR risk management.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a decentralized, entrepreneurial environment.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen with the ability to connect people decisions to business performance.
  • Excellent judgment, communication, influencing, and relationship-building skills.
  • Ability to balance strategic leadership with hands-on execution when required.

Preferred Experience:

  • 8+ years of progressive HR leadership experience, preferably supporting multiple businesses, divisions, or geographic regions.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting mergers and acquisitions, including HR due diligence and post-acquisition integration.

Salary and Additional Pay*

Base salary range: $140,000 - $165,000

Other compensation: This position is eligible to participate in the discretionary company bonus plan.

* Individual compensation packages are based on various factors unique to each candidate, including skill set, experience, qualifications and other job-related reasons

jobs.excerpt: About the Company: ArcSite is the leading mobile sketching and drawing-based takeoff and estimating solution, trusted by designers, field sales teams, technicians, and inspectors.
jobs.description:
About the Company:

ArcSite is the leading mobile sketching and drawing-based takeoff and estimating solution, trusted by designers, field sales teams, technicians, and inspectors. Our intuitive platform empowers users to create professional drawings on any device—without the steep learning curve of traditional CAD software—helping businesses save time, generate quotes faster, and close deals more efficiently.

We’re a remote-first team with a strong sense of community, driven by growth, collaboration, and our core values: start with the customer, constantly improve, take risks, operate with transparency, and own it. At ArcSite, every team member has the opportunity to grow their career while making an impact, shaping the future of design, and living these values in everything we do.

About the Role:

ArcSite’s product-led growth motion drives roughly half of company revenue and is our largest source of qualified leads. As User Acquisition Manager, PLG, you’ll own user acquisition for our self-serve funnel, with a focus on bringing the right users into the ArcSite product efficiently and at scale.

You’ll lead acquisition strategy across paid channels and App Store Optimization (ASO), managing the channel mix, budget, experimentation, and performance needed to grow self-serve signups and installs. You’ll work closely with Product and Marketing to understand which users and acquisition sources drive the strongest downstream outcomes, using those insights to continuously improve targeting, spend, and channel strategy.

This is a hands-on role for someone who understands the unique dynamics of self-serve and product-led acquisition and knows how to turn paid and organic channels into a scalable growth engine.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own user acquisition strategy: Develop and execute the acquisition strategy for ArcSite’s PLG motion, identifying opportunities across paid and organic channels to increase qualified self-serve signups and installs.
  • Manage paid acquisition: Own and optimize paid search, social, display, affiliate, and other relevant acquisition channels, with a focus on self-serve users rather than sales-assisted lead generation.
  • Lead ASO strategy: Own App Store Optimization across iOS, Android, and Windows, including keyword strategy, listing optimization, creative testing, ratings and reviews, and regional/international optimization.
  • Manage acquisition budget and channel mix: Allocate and optimize spend across acquisition channels to balance growth, volume, and CAC efficiency.
  • Build and optimize acquisition experiments: Develop a structured testing roadmap across channels, audiences, creative, landing pages, bidding strategies, and store listings to identify opportunities for growth.
  • Measure acquisition quality: Analyze acquisition sources and downstream product behavior to understand which channels, audiences, and campaigns produce the highest-quality users. Use these insights to improve targeting, channel mix, and investment decisions.
  • Partner cross-functionally: Work closely with Product, Marketing, and Analytics to share acquisition insights, align on growth opportunities, and ensure acquisition strategy supports the broader PLG funnel. Product owns activation and conversion; this role owns getting the right users into the funnel.
  • Own acquisition reporting: Establish and monitor key acquisition metrics including CPI, CPA, CAC, signup volume, channel efficiency, store listing conversion, ASO visibility and rankings, and acquisition-source quality.
  • Stay ahead of acquisition trends: Continuously evaluate emerging channels, platform changes, competitive activity, and new acquisition opportunities relevant to PLG and self-serve SaaS.

Requirements

  • 4–6+ years in user acquisition, growth marketing, or performance marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS or mobile apps with a self-serve/product-led motion
  • Hands-on experience managing paid acquisition campaigns across search, social, display, and/or affiliate channels
  • Hands-on ASO experience across app store platforms (iOS, Android, and/or Windows), including keyword optimization and regional/international strategy
  • Familiarity with paid bidding platforms (e.g., Google Ads, Apple Search Ads, Meta Ads Manager) and ASO/monitoring tools (e.g., Sensor Tower, AppTweak, Storemaven)
  • Working knowledge of product analytics tools (e.g., Mixpanel, Amplitude) to evaluate the downstream quality of acquired users
  • Comfort with SQL and CAC/funnel-efficiency analysis

Nice to Have

  • Experience acquiring users across multiple platforms, including iOS, Android, Windows, and Web.
  • Experience in B2B SaaS, vertical SaaS, mobile applications, or field-service/construction technology.
  • Experience working within a PLG organization where product usage and self-serve conversion are central to the growth model.
  • Experience with ArcSite’s marketing and analytics stack, including HubSpot, GA4, ChartMogul, Ahrefs, ASOlytics, and Mixpanel.

Benefits

  • Fully remote
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401K match
  • $75 monthly wellness stipend

ArcSite is an equal opportunity employer and fosters an inclusive environment. We do not discriminate based on gender, race, ethnicity, orientation, creed, or other traits. We welcome people from diverse backgrounds and perspectives to apply to our positions.

jobs.title: Penetration Tester - Cloud Security (Canada)
jobs.excerpt: Packetlabs was built by an ethical hacker after seeing vulnerability assessments presented as penetration tests.
jobs.description:
Packetlabs was built by an ethical hacker after seeing vulnerability assessments presented as penetration tests. Our slogan "Identify Risks Before They Become Headlines" drives at the importance of not providing our clients with a false sense of security.

As a Penetration Tester – Cloud Security, you will assess cloud environments by simulating real-world attacks to find vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, and design weaknesses before malicious actors can exploit them. You will perform security assessments across AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and other cloud service providers. Your work will cover identity and access management (IAM), network configuration, compute, storage, APIs, containers and Kubernetes, serverless, and CI/CD pipelines. For each finding, you will validate the real impact and give clients remediation guidance they can act on.

Cloud environments rarely stand alone, so you must have hands-on experience attacking the identity systems connected to them. This includes hybrid Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID environments, and identity providers such as Okta federated into AWS. You should be comfortable moving between on-premises and cloud, abusing trust relationships, and escalating privileges across tenants, subscriptions, and accounts.

Working alongside a team of highly skilled offensive security professionals, you will think like an attacker: chaining weaknesses together, bypassing security controls, and demonstrating business impact rather than listing isolated findings. To be clear, running CIS benchmarks or automated configuration scans is not a cloud penetration test. Those tools can inform your work, but this role is about manual, adversarial testing that proves what an attacker could actually do. You will combine offensive technique, a working knowledge of how cloud environments are built and operated, and creative problem-solving to help clients understand and reduce their risk.

This role requires a strong technical foundation, a drive to keep learning, and a commitment to an exceptional client experience through high-quality testing, reporting, and communication. Preference will be given to candidates with prior experience as a Cloud Architect or Cloud Engineer who also have a solid understanding of the penetration testing process.

Who we are looking for

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Software Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 2–5 years of experience performing cloud penetration testing, or cloud infrastructure security or architect experience for AWS and/or Azure.
  • Strong understanding of secure software development principles and common application security vulnerabilities.
  • Experience performing manual penetration testing of cloud environments such as AWS and/or Azure.
  • Strong programming or scripting experience in languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript, C#, C/C++, SQL, or similar languages.
  • Experience using roadrecon, azurehound, apeman, and/or opengraph tools and other industry-standard offensive security tools. Having your own opengraph extensions written and demonstrated is highly valued.
  • Familiarity with application or infrastructure testing with EDR bypasses, is considered an asset.
  • Experience validating automated scanner results and performing manual verification of vulnerabilities.
  • Strong written communication skills with the ability to produce clear, concise, and actionable security reports.
  • Relevant certifications such as OSCP, OSWE, BSCP, GWAPT, or equivalent are highly desirable. While not required, equivalent or alternative experience demonstrating intermediate experience in security testing and/or penetration testing is needed

What you’ll be doing

  • Cloud Security Assessments
    • Plan and execute cloud security assessments across AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and other cloud service providers using manual testing methodologies and industry-standard security tools.
    • Perform authenticated and unauthenticated cloud security testing to identify vulnerabilities, misconfigurations, excessive permissions, and security weaknesses across cloud infrastructure, services, and cloud-native environments.
    • Conduct cloud configuration reviews, Identity and Access Management (IAM) assessments, Conditional Access policy reviews, network security assessments, and cloud architecture security reviews to identify weaknesses in authentication, authorization, access controls, and privilege management.
    • Assess CI/CD pipelines, DevSecOps workflows, and software delivery processes to identify security vulnerabilities in build and deployment configurations, pipeline permissions, secrets management, source code repositories, and automated deployment mechanisms.
    • Validate automated cloud security scan results through manual verification and analysis to eliminate false positives, confirm security risks, and accurately assess potential business impact.
    • Evaluate Conditional Access policies, multi-factor authentication (MFA), privileged access controls, identity federation, and Zero Trust security configurations to identify weaknesses that could lead to unauthorized access or privilege escalation.
    • Able to work with other teams or individually chain together attackers within multi-cloud, hybrid, and CI/CD infrastructure.
  • Client Delivery & Reporting
    • Prepare high-quality technical reports that clearly communicate security findings, risk ratings, business impact, and remediation recommendations.
    • Present assessment findings to technical teams, development teams, security leadership, and executive stakeholders.
    • Provide technical guidance to clients regarding remediation strategies and application security best practices.
    • Manage assigned engagements while ensuring delivery timelines, quality standards, and client expectations are achieved.
  • Technical Leadership & Continuous Improvement
    • Maintain current knowledge of cloud security threats, emerging attack techniques, secure development practices, and offensive security methodologies.
    • Contribute to the continuous improvement of cloud security testing methodologies, reporting standards, internal tooling, and technical documentation.
    • Participate in technical research, internal training, peer reviews, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
    • Collaborate with technical teams to strengthen service quality and improve application security capabilities across the organization.

How Success is Measured

Performance in this role is evaluated using a combination of technical, operational, and client-focused measures, including but not limited to:

  • Successful delivery of cloud security assessments within established quality, budget, and timeline expectations.
  • Accuracy, completeness, and technical quality of security findings and client reports.
  • Positive client feedback regarding technical expertise, communication, and professionalism.
  • Demonstrated expertise across application security testing methodologies and offensive security techniques.
  • Contribution to technical research, methodology development, internal tooling, and knowledge-sharing initiatives.
  • Effective collaboration with Delivery Managers, Project Managers, and consulting team members.

Why us?

  • Receive immediate and ongoing offensive security training, mentorship, and professional development to advance your technical capabilities
  • Collaboration with a highly skilled team of security professionals who are passionate about technical excellence and raising the bar
  • Competitive compensation and growth opportunity
  • GRRSP with corporate matching in Canada

jobs.description:
About Perle

Perle is an AI infrastructure company building expert-driven training data, evaluation systems, and applied AI products for the world's leading labs and enterprises. With experts across more than forty markets, we specialize in the work that requires real human judgment: domain expertise, linguistic nuance, and cultural fidelity that generic data vendors cannot deliver.

1. About the opportunity

Role: Paid Luxembourgish Conversation Recorder (Remote, freelance)

Get paid to chat in Luxembourgish from home. Perle collects real speech recordings that help AI systems understand how people actually talk, and we're looking for native Luxembourgish speakers to join our recording team.

2. What you'll do

  • Join short online calls with another Luxembourgish speaker through our recording platform
  • Chat naturally about everyday topics: work, food, travel, hobbies, family. Topic suggestions are provided
  • Speak only Luxembourgish during recordings, in your normal, relaxed way
  • Record from a quiet room using headphones

3. Who we're looking for

  • Native Luxembourgish speaker (Luxembourgish is your first language or the language you grew up speaking at home)
  • Aged 18 or over
  • Comfortable having relaxed, unscripted conversations with strangers
  • Reliable and able to show up for scheduled sessions
  • No experience needed; all ages, genders and regional accents welcome

jobs.excerpt: About Project This is an early-stage company building an AI platform for the legal industry.
jobs.description:
About Project

This is an early-stage company building an AI platform for the legal industry. The platform pairs advanced reasoning with secure, privacy-first infrastructure so professionals can trust it with their most sensitive work.

The role

We’re hiring a Product Designer to shape how our product looks, feels, and works. You’ll be working directly with the founders and the engineering team to turn a fast-moving roadmap into clean, intuitive, trustworthy experiences for professional users.

This is a hands-on, end-to-end role: research, flows, wireframes, and polished UI – you own the whole arc, not just handoffs. Because the team is small, your work is visible from day one, and the patterns you set become the design foundation for everything that follows.

What you’ll do

  • Own product design end to end — from problem framing and user flows to wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI.
  • Design clear, intuitive interfaces for complex, information-dense workflows (documents, review, analysis).
  • Partner closely with front-end engineers to ship pixel-accurate, responsive, accessible UI.
  • Talk to users to understand their real workflows and validate designs with them.
  • Build and maintain a design system and component library as the product grows.
  • Shape the brand and visual language where needed.

What you bring

  • 3–5 years of product design experience shipping real software, ideally web applications.
  • A strong portfolio showing end-to-end work: flows, interaction design, and polished, professional UI.
  • Fluency in Figma, with comfort prototyping and working from (or building) a design system.
  • A talent for designing for complexity — turning dense, expert workflows into something clear and calm.
  • Self-direction and clear communication on a small, distributed team.
  • Fluent with AI tools — you actively use them to improve your workflow and move faster.

Nice to have

  • Experience designing for expert or professional users (legal, medical, finance, or enterprise).
  • Comfort with HTML/CSS, or a habit of working closely alongside engineers in code.
  • Brand or visual-identity work beyond product UI.
  • Interest in AI / LLM products and designing for trust.

The role

This position sits within Nebius Token Factory, our serverless platform for running and customizing open-source LLMs in production. Token Factory allows for serverless inference and fine-tuning backed by in-house optimizations like custom speculative decoding, quantization, cache-aware routing and dedicated endpoints. Customers come to us to move from prototype to scaled production without the cost and complexity of building and tuning their own inference stack.

Our Solutions Architects own the technical delivery of customer engagements: deploying open-source models, tuning the serving stack, benchmarking against the customer's success criteria, and carrying the technical relationship through to production. Sales Engineers qualify and scope the opportunity; SAs execute it. Technical Account Managers take it from production onward.

We're looking for a Manager, ML Solutions Architecture to lead our US regional SA teams. Your scope is PoC delivery and post-sales technical support: the people who do it, the standard they do it to, and the operating cadence that keeps it predictable. You will report to the Head of Solutions Architecture and partner with a peer manager in the other region.

We expect you to push people when they need pushing, make the uncomfortable call when deliverables don't land even though the effort was real, and take ownership of the documentation work: implement and monitor the following of the guidelines, ticket hygiene, and making sure the team actually uses all three.

You're welcome to work remotely from the United States.

Your responsibilities will include:

Lead the team

  • Manage a team of 4 Solutions Architects, with continued growth planned: 1:1s, goal setting, performance reviews, promotion cases, and individual growth plans
  • Build an accurate picture of each SA's strengths, gaps, and preferences, and allocate accounts and engagements against both expertise and interest
  • Run the cadence that surfaces blockers early, then take them to the development, product, and business teams that can clear them, and stay on them until they do
  • Hold people to outcomes: distinguish effort from delivered results, say so plainly when the two diverge, and reflect it in ratings and compensation decisions
  • Onboard new joiners through to their first independently delivered engagement
  • Coach SAs into stronger engineers and stronger communicators, and make deliberate calls about who is ready for more scope

Own delivery

Own the operating system of the team

  • Maintain and extend the team's documentation: responsibilities, runbooks, guides, onboarding, definitions of done, engagement closure templates. Keep it accurate and reachable; link, don't copy
  • Get it used, not just written: documentation nobody reads is a cost, not an asset
  • Keep the ticket tracker the system of record, so PoC and production status is readable without asking anyone
  • Instrument the work: define and report the metrics that show whether delivery is getting faster and more reliable over time

Here's what you'll be doing:

You'll conduct real-time video consultations with patients via the Fresh platform, assess their suitability for cosmetic injectable treatments, and where clinically appropriate and within your endorsed scope of practice, prescribe Schedule 4 medicines and issue treatment authorisations for Fresh Clinic treating nurses.

The core work centres on three things: thorough patient consultation and medical assessment, informed consent and collaborative treatment planning, and clinical documentation maintained to the highest standard. Clinical Decision-Making & Collaboration

Governance, Documentation & Quality Assurance

Why Pythian:

We quickly earned a reputation for solving tough data challenges. We were there when the industry moved from on-premises to cloud environments, and as enterprises sought more from their data, we expanded our competencies to include advanced analytics.

Today, we empower organizations to embrace transformation and leverage advanced technologies, including AI, to stay competitive. We deliver innovative solutions that meet each client’s data goals and have built strong partnerships with Google Cloud, AWS, Microsoft, Oracle, SAP, and Snowflake. The powerful combination of our extensive expertise in data and cloud and our ability to keep on top of the latest bleeding edge technologies make us the perfect partner to help mid and large-sized businesses transform to stay ahead in today’s rapidly changing digital economy.

Why you:

Pythian sits at the intersection of data engineering, AI production, and managed services — helping enterprises turn data complexity into competitive advantage. With three decades of deep managed services heritage and strategic partnerships across the leading cloud and database technology ecosystems, we are at the forefront of helping clients move from AI experimentation to AI in production.

We are looking for a polished, quota-carrying Sales Executive who is energized by the AI moment and knows how to help enterprise clients build the modern, well-managed data foundations that make production AI possible at scale. You are comfortable hunting new logos, converting inbound leads, and growing existing accounts. You bring credibility in conversations about Database Managed Services, Production AI, and cloud and database technologies — and you know how to co-sell effectively with OEM and hyperscaler partners to drive mutual value.

What Makes This Role Unique:

Pythian’s portfolio spans the full stack from data foundations to production AI — Production AI, Database Managed Services, AI Strategy & Automation, Data Migrations, Cloud Consulting, and Agentic AI solutions, supported by partnerships across Google Cloud, Oracle, AWS, Microsoft Azure, SAP, and the broader modern data ecosystem. This means you’re never selling a point solution; you’re building long-term, high-value partnerships with clients who want a trusted advisor to help them scale intelligently.

If you’re energized by the AI transformation happening across enterprise technology right now, know how to sell complex managed services, and want to represent a company with deep technical credibility and a growing AI practice — this role is built for you.

What you will be doing:

Territory & Pipeline

AI & Data Services Sales

  • Lead discovery and solution conversations around Production AI, AI Strategy, Agentic AI, and AI Automation with enterprise buyers (CAIO, CDO, CTO, CIO).
  • Articulate how modern, well-managed data estates — across databases, cloud data platforms, and data migrations — are the critical scaffolding for scalable AI.

  • Build and maintain strong field relationships with partner account teams, knowing how to activate the right partner resources at the right stage of a deal.
  • Serve as the primary relationship owner for your accounts while leveraging Pythian’s delivery, solutions, and field CTO resources as needed.

Deal Execution & Internal Orchestration

  • Lead enterprise sales cycles end-to-end: discovery, business case development, proposal, negotiation, and close.
  • Act as the internal project manager for your deals — coordinating across Solutions Architecture, Delivery, Legal, and Finance to keep complex cycles moving, ensure scope integrity, and deliver proposals on time.
  • Know when and how to engage the right internal resources (Field CTO, practice leads, delivery SMEs) and manage those relationships to build credibility with prospects without over-committing delivery capacity.
  • Prepare and present compelling proposals, RFP responses, and executive-level business case materials.
  • Document client interactions, capture competitive intelligence, and share win/loss insights to continuously improve Pythian’s go-to-market.

Travel as required to attend client meetings, partner events, industry conferences, and Pythian’s annual sales kickoff.

What we need from you:

  • 6+ years of enterprise technology sales experience with a consistent record of meeting or exceeding quota.
  • Active experience selling Data & AI services — managed databases, cloud data platforms, AI strategy, or production AI implementations — to enterprise buyers.
  • Demonstrated ability to sell managed services: you know who to call, how to build the business case, and how to navigate procurement for recurring-revenue engagements.
  • Experience co-selling with hyperscaler or OEM field teams (Google Cloud, Oracle, AWS, Microsoft, or similar), including familiarity with partner programs, deal registration, and funded motions.
  • Strong internal project management instincts: proven ability to orchestrate cross-functional resources — solutions architects, delivery leads, legal, finance — across complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles without losing momentum or scope control.
  • A hunter’s instinct for new logos combined with the relationship acumen to grow and retain existing accounts.
  • Polished enterprise presence with the ability to engage confidently at VP and C-suite level across business and technical audiences.
  • Proficiency in Salesforce for pipeline management, forecasting, and account planning.

Strongly Preferred

  • Experience selling within one or more of Pythian’s core technology ecosystems: Google Cloud (BigQuery, Vertex AI, Gemini) and/or Oracle (database, infrastructure), and also AWS, Microsoft Azure, Snowflake, Databricks, or SAP.
  • Familiarity with the modern data stack and cloud data platforms across multiple hyperscalers.
  • Comfort positioning AI solutions — Agentic AI, GenAI/RAG, MLOps, AI automation — to enterprise decision-makers.
  • Experience with Database Managed Services or Infrastructure Managed Services sales cycles and pricing models.
  • Background selling into $300M–$1B revenue companies in manufacturing, retail, logistics, finance, or healthcare verticals.
  • Relevant cloud, database, or AI certifications are a plus.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic territory planning and disciplined pipeline management.
  • Consultative selling — ability to diagnose business problems before proposing solutions.
  • Influence, persuasion, and consensus-building across complex enterprise buying committees.
  • Continuous learning mindset — genuinely curious about AI developments and their enterprise implications.
  • Clear, compelling written and verbal communication; strong presentation and proposal skills.
  • Relevant Bachelor’s degree or equivalent combination of experience and education.

What you will receive:

  • Love your work/life balance: Flexibly work remotely from your home, there’s no daily travel requirement to an office! All you need is a stable internet connection.
  • Love your coworkers: Collaborate with some of the best and brightest in the industry!
  • Love your development: Hone your skills or learn new ones with our substantial training allowance; participate in professional development days, attend training, become certified, whatever you like!
  • Love your workspace: We give you all the equipment you need to work from home including a laptop with your choice of OS, and an annual budget to personalize your work environment!
  • Love yourself: Pythian cares about the health and well-being of our team. You will have an annual wellness budget to make yourself a priority (use it on gym memberships, massages, fitness and more). Additionally, you will receive a generous amount of paid vacation and sick days, as well as a day off to volunteer for your favorite charity.

AI Disclaimer

Root is on a mission to unbreak insurance by creating experiences people love at prices they can't believe.
