Root's Engineering team is committed to building a flexible platform on which our product designers and quantitative scientists can quickly test ideas, deploy them into production, and iterate, with the ultimate objective of a delightful customer experience coupled with effective risk management.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a Senior Security Engineer to lead our Data Security domain and help define how the organization protects sensitive data at scale. In this role, you will contribute to the data security roadmap and help establish the standards, control requirements, and risk priorities across the data lifecycle.

You will partner closely with Data Platform, Analytics, Engineering, Security Operations, and GRC teams to protect policyholder and corporate data in cloud-native environments. Your responsibilities will include data discovery and classification, encryption and key management, data obfuscation and de-identification, fine-grained access controls, secure data sharing, retention and deletion, backup protection, monitoring, and data loss prevention.

This is a hands-on, highly collaborative role. You will establish secure patterns and standards, influence technical decisions, automate repeatable workflows, and help teams adopt practical controls that enable secure use of data for business and analytics purposes.

Salary Range: $111,500 - $139,400 (Eligible for competitive bonus and equity offering)

Root is a "work where it works best" company. This means we will support you working in whatever location that works best for you across the US.

How You Will Make an Impact

  • Help establish the data security strategy and roadmap for sensitive policyholder, customer, employee, and corporate data.
  • Protect PII, financial information, health-related information where applicable, claims data, and other regulated or confidential data across its full lifecycle.
  • Establish standards for data classification, encryption, key management, masking, tokenization, anonymization, pseudonymization, retention, deletion, and secure data sharing.
  • Design and improve data access governance, including least privilege, RBAC/ABAC, privileged access, row-level controls, column-level controls, and periodic access reviews.
  • Partner with Data Platform and Analytics teams to embed security controls into data pipelines, warehouses, data lakes, reporting platforms, and machine learning workflows.
  • Improve visibility into sensitive data stores, data flows, third-party transfers, and access patterns through discovery, monitoring, DLP, and related security tooling.
  • Establish secure backup, recovery, and resilience requirements for critical data.
  • Translate regulatory and business requirements into practical technical controls and measurable risk-reduction initiatives.
  • Lead cross-functional prioritization, balancing urgent risk remediation with long-term data security maturity and SOC 2 readiness.
  • Automate security workflows using scripting, APIs, policy-as-code, and approved AI-assisted tools while protecting confidential and regulated information.
  • Develop playbooks, reference architectures, and reusable patterns that improve consistency and reduce operational overhead.
  • Participate in the Security Engineering on-call rotation, triaging alerts and security issues during business hours and responding to after-hours escalations as needed.
  • Communicate data security risks, decisions, and recommendations clearly to engineers, business stakeholders, and senior leadership.

What You Will Need to Succeed

  • Hands-on experience securing sensitive data in cloud environments and applying controls across storage, processing, analytics, and data-sharing systems.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in insurance, financial services, healthcare, or another regulated industry.
  • Experience with data security posture management, data activity monitoring, enterprise DLP, or cloud data security platforms.
  • Familiarity with major cloud providers and cloud-native data services.

jobs.description:
Location:Remote

Reports to:Editor in Chief, Chalkbeat

Type:Full-time

Salary Range:$130,000 - $145,000 per year, depending on location and experience


Civic News Companyis leading a civic revival.


We were founded to address one of the most consequential market failures of our time: the collapse of local news. Since 2008, nearly two-thirds of U.S. newsroom jobs have disappeared, leaving communities without trusted reporting on education, elections, and public health. Our mission is simple and urgent: to help people understand how America works so they can make it work better.


ThroughChalkbeat(education),Votebeat(elections), andHealthbeat(public health), we operate a national network of local news bureaus that combine deep local expertise with centralized national infrastructure.


THE OPPORTUNITY

Civic News is seeking a Deputy Editor in Chief to support our journalists and boost our newsroom leadership capacity. In this newly created role, Chalkbeat’s Deputy will partner with the Editor in Chief to set and execute the editorial vision for the newsroom. In addition, they will oversee several reporting teams and collaborate with the Managing Editors and Bureau Chiefs to extend a clear vision forward. The role will blend day-to-day journalism guidance with big-picture strategic thinking for key newsroom projects.


As Chalkbeat enters its next phase of growth, our most important metric will remain impact — so a successful candidate will have experience in developing must-read stories that reach wide audiences and drive discussion and change. They will also be an experienced and inspiring newsroom leader with a strong track record of project planning, change management, and experimentation.


The key responsibilities for this role include:

  • Working with the Editor in Chief to set the vision as Chalkbeat enters a new phase of growth and ensure it’s being carried out.

  • Overseeing several of our current local bureaus and reporting teams, with a focus on ensuring that Chalkbeat coverage drives impact in the form of informed decision-making and debate.

  • Coaching leaders on setting and achieving goals, monitoring progress, and supporting their team members’ professional growth.

  • Supporting the implementation of Civic News Academy.

  • Working on high-priority initiatives, including but not limited to impact tracking improvements, further development of a newsroom AI strategy, and future geographic expansion.

  • Collaborating closely with our growth and community team to expand our loyal audience.

  • Ensuring enterprise projects are deeply compelling and well executed.

  • Serving as a newsroom leader, representing organizational priorities to local teams and vice versa.


What background and skills do you have? (We know not all strong candidates will have all the skills we list. That’s OK. What else do you bring to the table? Please tell us!): The person we seek:

  • 10+ years of work experience, including leadership experience.

  • Experience reporting and editing breaking news, daily, and enterprise stories.

  • A track record of leading effective teams with inspiration, high standards, and accountability, including experience coaching employees at different experience levels.

  • A track record of managing complex projects, from initial vision to developing the processes that make them sustainable.

  • Experience developing editorial strategy and building an audience.

  • A deep knowledge of America’s education story paired with curiosity about its future.


Here are our Civic NewsValuesand how they show up in our work together:

  • We work as one team.

    Rebuilding local news requires collaboration. We actively nurture a harmonious environment of dignity, respect, and professionalism. We assume good intent, support one another’s growth, and have a team-oriented approach to solving problems together.

  • We pursue truth with intellectual honesty.
    Our work demands rigor. We seek facts, challenge assumptions, and engage thoughtfully with perspectives different from our own. We follow the evidence wherever it leads.

  • We practice inclusive journalism.

    Strong civic life depends on representation and trust. We commit to antiracism, equity, and inclusive practices. We build meaningful relationships with the communities we serve and reflect their realities in our reporting.

  • We earn trust every day.

    We develop subject-matter expertise. We operate transparently. We take responsibility for our work and keep learning so our journalism remains credible, relevant, and strong.

This full-time, remote-eligible position may be based anywhere in the continental United States. Civic News Company already has a presence in Chicago, Colorado, Indianapolis, Newark, Pennsylvania, Arizona, Texas, Michigan, Tennessee, New York City, and Washington, D.C.


The salary range is $130,000 to 145,000; final salary will be determined based on level of experience and geographic location, with a generous benefits package, including:

  • Medical, vision, and dental insurance

  • Time off that truly supports rest, including 20 days of PTO, a paid one-week recess, 5 sick days, 3 floating holidays, and 12 paid holidays in 2026

  • Retirement support through a 401(k) with a 4% employer match that is immediately vested

  • 100% paid parental leave: 18 weeks fully paid, plus a 2-week part-time return-to-work ramp-up

  • Flexible Spending Plan for eligible medical or childcare expenses

  • Annual professional development stipend

  • Employer-provided life insurance and short- and long-term disability coverage

  • Monthly reimbursement for cell phone and internet expenses


Civic News Company recognizes a staff bargaining unit, Civic News Company, affiliated with the Writers Guild of America, East,a labor union representing thousands of members who write content for news and online media, motion pictures, and television.This position is not included in the Civic News Company bargaining unit.


Physical Requirements of the Job

This role is primarily sedentary and involves extended periods of sitting and regular use of standard office equipment, including computers and phones, for up to 8 hours per day. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position.

Civic News Company Commitment

Civic News Company is committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive organization. We believe restoring civic trust requires a plurality of voices, backgrounds, and experiences. Civic News Company is committed to equal employment opportunities and welcomes applicants and employees from diverse backgrounds, including but not limited to races, colors, national origins, ancestries, creeds, religions, genders, ages, disabilities, veteran status, sexual orientations, and marital statuses. We encourage individuals of all backgrounds to apply and contribute to our shared vision.

Civic News Company participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. If E-Verify cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, Civic News Company is required to give you written instructions and an opportunity to contact Department of Homeland Security (DHS) or Social Security Administration (SSA) so you can begin to resolve the issue before Civic News Company can take any action against you, including terminating your employment. Civic News Company can only use E-Verify once you have accepted a job offer and completed the Form I-9.

jobs.description:
About Us

We are a modern marketing collective built for scale, efficiency, and impact. As the parent company, Agital supports three specialized agencies: Go Fish Digital, REQ, and WDG, with shared infrastructure, advanced technology, and deeply experienced people, allowing each brand to do its best work.

Go Fish Digital is an engineering-forward performance marketing agency specializing in SEO, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), its Barracuda AI platform, social commerce, and conversion-focused creative.

WDG designs and builds complex enterprise web experiences for associations, nonprofits, foundations, universities, and other mission-driven organizations.

REQ is a digital marketing and communications agency specializing in brand, reputation, and advocacy for global organizations across technology, healthcare, finance, hospitality, and real estate.

Together, we operate as one collaborative ecosystem, combining deep expertise, AI-powered capabilities, and a culture of curiosity to help ambitious brands grow while creating meaningful opportunities for our people.

About the role

Go Fish is seeking a Senior Coordinator, Media to support the planning, activation, optimization, and reporting of integrated media campaigns across a portfolio of clients.

In this role, you’ll build on a strong foundation in media execution while taking greater ownership of campaign management, performance monitoring, and client deliverables. You’ll work across digital and traditional media channels, applying audience insights, platform knowledge, and performance data to help improve campaign outcomes.

You’ll be expected to operate with increasing independence, proactively identify issues and opportunities, and serve as a reliable resource for Coordinators and other team members. This role is ideal for someone who has developed strong executional skills and is ready to take the next step toward broader account and strategy ownership.

What You’ll Do

Media Strategy & Planning

  • Develop a strong understanding of client business goals, target audiences, campaign objectives, and key performance indicators
  • Apply audience, industry, competitive, and platform research to support integrated media recommendations
  • Assist with the development of media plans, including channel recommendations, targeting approaches, budgets, timelines, and campaign details
  • Refine targeting and audience recommendations based on available research, client priorities, and campaign performance
  • Build and maintain media flowcharts, budget documents, planning materials, and client presentations
  • Support the development of tactical recommendations across paid search, paid social, programmatic, video, streaming, direct media, and other applicable channels
  • Begin connecting individual channel tactics to the broader customer journey and integrated media strategy
  • Identify missing information, planning considerations, or potential risks and proactively raise them with the account team

Activation & Execution

  • Independently manage assigned campaign setup, trafficking, launch, and maintenance responsibilities
  • Execute campaigns accurately across applicable media platforms and channels
  • Apply established processes, naming conventions, tracking requirements, and platform best practices consistently
  • Improve execution accuracy and consistency by identifying gaps and recommending process improvements
  • Complete thorough quality assurance reviews before launch and following significant campaign changes
  • Coordinate creative assets, trafficking instructions, tracking requirements, platform specifications, and launch timelines
  • Maintain accurate campaign settings, budgets, documentation, and supporting account materials
  • Monitor delivery and pacing and make approved adjustments to keep campaigns aligned with planned budgets and timelines
  • Troubleshoot routine campaign issues and escalate more complex risks with clear context and recommended next steps
  • Support direct media buys and vendor coordination, where applicable

Optimization & Performance

  • Monitor campaign performance against established goals, benchmarks, and key performance indicators
  • Identify performance trends, delivery issues, and optimization opportunities across assigned campaigns
  • Complete routine optimizations independently and more advanced optimizations with guidance
  • Recommend adjustments to budgets, bids, audiences, placements, creative, frequency, and other campaign variables
  • Apply platform and audience insights to improve campaign efficiency and effectiveness
  • Support structured testing plans, including audience, creative, placement, bidding, and platform tests
  • Document optimizations, hypotheses, campaign changes, and resulting performance impact
  • Flag performance concerns early and provide relevant data and context to support decision-making
  • Begin developing evidence-based recommendations rather than only reporting what happened

Measurement & Analysis

  • Pull, organize, and validate campaign data for recurring and ad hoc reporting
  • Ensure data accuracy and consistency across platforms, pacing documents, dashboards, and client-facing reports
  • Analyze campaign performance and identify clear trends, insights, and areas of opportunity
  • Contribute written performance narratives that explain what happened, why it happened, and what the team recommends next
  • Connect campaign metrics to defined media goals and client business objectives
  • Maintain reporting dashboards, optimization logs, budget trackers, and campaign documentation
  • Support test measurement and post-campaign analysis
  • Identify potential data discrepancies and work with internal teams to investigate and resolve them
  • Develop familiarity with attribution, incrementality, and other measurement approaches used by the agency

Client & Business Impact

  • Build a working understanding of client businesses, audiences, industries, competitive environments, and growth priorities
  • Support day-to-day client communication related to campaign status, performance, and deliverables
  • Prepare client meeting materials, performance reports, presentations, agendas, and follow-up documentation
  • Participate actively in client meetings and present assigned campaign updates or performance findings
  • Respond to routine client and internal questions with accurate information and appropriate context
  • Communicate risks, delays, or performance concerns proactively
  • Demonstrate an understanding of how media recommendations support broader marketing and business goals
  • Maintain professionalism, responsiveness, and accuracy across all client-facing work

Integrated Collaboration

  • Collaborate with Integrated Media, Client Strategy, creative, analytics, organic, and other agency teams
  • Coordinate campaign needs, creative requirements, tracking details, deadlines, and deliverables across internal stakeholders
  • Support integrated planning and execution across paid search, paid social, programmatic, video, streaming, direct media, and other channels
  • Share relevant campaign performance insights with channel and account team members
  • Help ensure that messaging, audience strategy, creative, landing-page experience, and measurement are aligned
  • Participate in internal planning, status, reporting, and performance discussions
  • Proactively communicate dependencies or issues that could affect campaign timelines or outcomes
  • Contribute to organized and consistent account workflows

Team Support & Development

  • Serve as a resource for Coordinators by answering routine questions and sharing established processes and best practices
  • Support the onboarding and development of junior team members
  • Review Coordinator work when assigned and provide clear, constructive feedback
  • Model strong organization, accountability, attention to detail, and communication
  • Share platform updates, useful resources, and campaign learnings with the broader team
  • Take ownership of assigned workstreams and follow them through to completion
  • Ask for feedback and demonstrate continued growth in strategic thinking, communication, and account ownership
  • Contribute to a collaborative and solutions-oriented team environment

Platforms, Innovation & Industry Learning

  • Build proficiency across the media platforms, tools, and systems required for assigned accounts
  • Apply platform features, audience capabilities, and best practices to day-to-day campaign work
  • Stay informed on industry trends, platform changes, privacy developments, automation, AI, and emerging media opportunities
  • Test and apply new platform features when appropriate and approved
  • Participate in agency training, certifications, vendor education, and ongoing professional development
  • Share relevant platform updates and explain how they may affect current campaigns
  • Evaluate new capabilities with a focus on client goals, campaign performance, and operational feasibility
  • Continue developing expertise across multiple media channels while building deeper knowledge in assigned areas

What You Bring

  • 1–3 years of experience in media, marketing, advertising, analytics, or a related field
  • Hands-on experience supporting or managing paid media campaigns
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, advertising, communications, business, or a related field, or comparable professional experience
  • Working knowledge of integrated media planning, campaign activation, optimization, and reporting
  • Experience working with at least one major paid media platform, with an interest in developing broader cross-channel expertise
  • Strong attention to detail and a consistent record of producing accurate work
  • Ability to independently manage assigned tasks, timelines, and campaign responsibilities
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with campaign data, budgets, and performance metrics
  • Ability to identify trends and translate data into clear observations and recommendations
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
  • A proactive, solutions-oriented approach to problem-solving
  • Willingness to take ownership, ask thoughtful questions, and escalate concerns appropriately
  • Ability to provide support and guidance to more junior team members
  • Strong professional judgment, accountability, and integrity

Bonus Qualifications

  • Agency experience supporting multiple clients or accounts
  • Experience across more than one media channel, such as paid search, paid social, programmatic, display, video, CTV, streaming audio, or direct media
  • Familiarity with Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn, and/or demand-side platforms
  • Experience working with Google Analytics, campaign dashboards, attribution tools, or other measurement platforms
  • Experience with Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, pivot tables, and data analysis
  • Familiarity with trafficking, pixels, conversion tracking, campaign tagging, and URL parameters
  • Experience coordinating with media vendors, publishers, or platform representatives
  • Relevant media or platform certifications
  • Exposure to reporting automation, data visualization, or media planning tools

Why Join Us

You'll work alongside talented people who are passionate about solving problems, helping clients grow, and delivering meaningful results. We're a collaborative, fast-moving team where curiosity is encouraged, ideas are welcomed, and great work is recognized.

We believe the best work happens when people are trusted to take ownership, supported in their growth, and empowered to bring their unique perspectives to the table. Whether you're just getting started or bringing years of experience, you'll have the opportunity to make an impact while continuing to learn and grow.

Benefits & Compensation

We believe great people deserve great support. Our company offers competitive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, well-being, and career growth, including:

  • Competitive compensation
  • Flexible work environment
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Unlimited paid time off
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Company-paid life and disability insurance
  • Paid parental leave
  • A collaborative culture with autonomy and ownership

Additional Information

No agencies, please.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Advanced Energy United (United) is currently seeking a Policy Principal to help shape political strategy on our Decisionmaker Education and Engagement team (DMEE).

The Director, GVAP, Solid Tumors Pipeline provides critical strategic insights and guidance to ensure pipeline assets meet future market access needs and maximize commercial potential. The person in this position will focus on identifying market access-related evidentiary gaps in clinical development plans that could result in a breadth of reimbursement inconsistent with planned labelled population(s) and/or pricing that does not sustainably support the business. The person in this role will work cross-functionally with relevant stakeholders to develop recommendations to close those gaps and/or for evidence generation that, if implemented, would result in optimizing reimbursement and pricing potential. The person in this role must be capable of estimating the impact of different clinical development scenarios on access and price potential. The person in this role will confer with the ED, GVAP, Lead Solid Tumors, to determine how and when to disseminate GVAP analysis and recommendations. Furthermore, the position will support portfolio prioritization exercises.

This is a senior role that is critical in setting the foundation for the Company’s future Solid Tumor (ST) product success in that the person in this role develops a strategic vision for the pipeline, which is informed by market access expertise and a deep understanding of the evolving needs of global payers.

Essential Functions of the job:

Pipeline Market Access Strategy Development:

  • Lead the creation and implementation of global pricing and market access strategies for ST pipeline products (typically but not exclusively Phase II and III assets), aligning with clinical and commercial goals.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally to integrate access requirements into the development process, influencing trial design, endpoints, and evidence generation to meet payer needs.
  • Lead the collection and aggregation of feedback from all regions in which the Company operates and develop recommendations regarding clinical development and other evidence generation based on that feedback.
  • In alignment with the ED, GVAP ST, represent the GVAP ST perspective (aligned with Regions and/or focus markets and HEOR) to governance or oversight bodies of the Company (e.g., GPT, GBT)

Value Proposition & Evidence Generation:

  • Develop early value propositions that resonate with global payers and support future pricing, reimbursement, and access decisions.
  • Work closely with Clinical, Medical Affairs, and Health Economics & Outcomes Research (HEOR) teams to shape clinical trial design and evidence-generation strategies that align with target market access requirements.
  • Identify and prioritize evidence gaps; work closely with HEOR to ensure development of health economic models, burden-of-illness studies, and other data to address payer concerns and enhance product differentiation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement:

  • If delegated by ED, GVAP ST, serve as the primary market access point of contact for one or more GPTs.
  • Collaborate with R&D, Commercial (incl. PSV), Medical Affairs, and Regulatory Affairs to ensure access-related insights and payer needs are integrated into the overall development strategy.
  • Provide input into clinical decisions and Business Development to ensure payer requirements are recognized, addressed and or additional evidence generated through other means, in support of the commercial strategy development expectations, trends and risks.
  • Engage with focus markets and regional access teams to ensure early alignment on access strategies and support local adaptation for specific market needs.
  • Working together with commercial, clinical, medical / HEOR and regional market access teams, align on early asset target product profile definitions and evidence required as well as planned value proposition that will support value positioning and reduce pricing and reimbursement uncertainties across all regions in which BeOne operates.

Pre-Launch Preparation:

  • Drive pre-launch planning for pipeline products, including the creation of early value toolkits and JCA relevant PICOs and early engagement strategies to optimize future access and reimbursement.

Market Insights & Competitive Landscape Analysis:

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer (Egocentric 3D Human Pose)
jobs.excerpt: About the Role We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our core research and development team focused on recovering accurate 3D human body and hand motion from egocentric (first-person) video.
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our core research and development team focused on recovering accurate 3D human body and hand motion from egocentric (first-person) video.

Human demonstration data is the foundation of robot learning, and its quality depends on accurately reconstructing human motion. In this role, you will develop models and production pipelines that transform head-mounted and body-mounted camera streams—including wide-FOV, stereo, motion-blurred, and heavily self-occluded video—into metrically accurate, temporally consistent 3D pose representations for robot policy training and human-to-robot motion retargeting.

You will work across the entire perception stack, including camera calibration, data annotation, model training, evaluation, and large-scale deployment. This role is ideal for engineers with strong expertise in both computer vision and deep learning who enjoy solving challenging real-world perception problems.

Responsibilities

  • Develop state-of-the-art 3D body and hand pose estimation models for egocentric video using monocular and stereo camera systems.
  • Build models for 2D/3D keypoint estimation, SMPL/SMPL-X, MANO, and full-body motion reconstruction.
  • Address challenging egocentric vision problems, including severe self-occlusion, motion blur, rolling shutter artifacts, truncated limbs, extreme viewpoints, and hand-object interaction.
  • Design and maintain camera geometry and calibration pipelines, including fisheye and wide-FOV camera models, stereo calibration, triangulation, and coordinate frame alignment.
  • Improve temporal consistency and physical plausibility using filtering, kinematic constraints, multi-view fusion, and multi-modal sensor integration.
  • Build scalable annotation, evaluation, and quality assurance pipelines for large-scale human motion datasets.
  • Optimize large-scale model training and high-throughput inference pipelines for production environments.
  • Collaborate closely with robotics engineers to convert reconstructed human motion into high-quality robot training data.
  • Contribute to system architecture, engineering best practices, and the long-term evolution of the perception platform.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Vision, Robotics, or a related field.
  • 3+ years of experience building and deploying machine learning systems.
  • Hands-on experience with 3D human pose estimation, hand pose estimation, or human motion tracking from video.
  • Strong understanding of multi-view geometry, camera calibration, triangulation, coordinate transformations, and projection models.
  • Strong Python programming skills and proficiency with PyTorch or TensorFlow.
  • Solid knowledge of modern deep learning techniques, model training, evaluation, and production ML workflows.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced collaborative environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with egocentric perception systems, AR/VR headsets, smart glasses, or wearable capture rigs.
  • Expertise with SMPL, SMPL-X, MANO, inverse kinematics, markerless motion capture, or hand-object pose estimation.
  • Familiarity with egocentric vision datasets and benchmarks.
  • Experience with modern video and 3D learning architectures, including Video Transformers, diffusion-based motion models, or 3D CNNs.
  • Experience building multi-camera capture systems, synchronization, and calibration infrastructure.
  • Experience with human-to-robot motion retargeting, teleoperation, imitation learning, or dexterous manipulation.
  • Experience developing annotation tools, active learning pipelines, or large-scale data quality systems.
  • Publications at leading conferences such as CVPR, ICCV, ECCV, NeurIPS, SIGGRAPH, or 3DV, open-source contributions, or demonstrated impact in applied AI systems.

What We Offer

  • Competitive salary and equity package
  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Generous paid time off and company holidays
  • Paid sick leave
  • Opportunity to work alongside leading researchers and engineers in robotics, computer vision, and AI
  • High-impact role building cutting-edge perception systems for next-generation robotics

Perfomance Growth Lead – Legend London

Remote first - London

Legend London is one of the UK’s fastest-growing menswear brands, built around premium everyday essentials designed for modern lifestyles.

The brand has scaled rapidly through a combination of:

  • eCommerce

  • Performance marketing

  • Highly effective social-first creative

With a growing global customer base and ambitious expansion plans, Legend are now entering the next stage of scale - focused on building category-defining menswear products that can continue driving growth internationally.

Product sits at the centre of that strategy.

The Opportunity

We’ve partnered with fast-scaling menswear brand Legend London to appoint a Performance Growth Lead who will take ownership of Meta advertising and help scale the business profitably across the UK, US and Europe.

This is not a standard media-buyer role. We’re looking for an exceptional operator who combines elite Meta buying expertise with sharp commercial judgement, genuine creative-strategy ability and an advanced approach to using AI across marketing.

Working closely with the founders, you’ll own decisions across media buying, budget allocation, performance analysis, creative direction, offers and landing pages. Your goal will be to maximise profitable new-customer growth and total contribution profit, not simply platform ROAS.

What You’ll Own

Meta, growth and commercial performance

• Manage and scale substantial Meta budgets across multiple countries and product categories.

• Allocate spend using contribution profit, demand, stock availability, margin and growth potential.

• Forecast performance at different spend levels and protect the business from inefficient scaling or misleading attribution.

• Analyse product, market, customer and offer performance, turning complex data into clear commercial action.

• Identify the true causes of performance changes, from creative fatigue and product-market fit to stock, pricing, returns, website conversion and budget allocation.

Creative strategy

• Build weekly and monthly creative strategies informed by performance data, customer psychology and market insight.

• Identify winning hooks, concepts, angles, formats and messages, then translate them into clear creative briefs.

• Develop a balanced pipeline across UGC, founder-led content, product demonstrations, testimonials, statics and brand-led creative.

• Review scripts, storyboards and edits, understanding why creative works and turning successful ideas into scalable territories.

AI, offers and conversion

• Use AI to analyse advertising, product and customer data; identify patterns and growth opportunities; and automate recurring reporting.

• Apply AI to creative concepts, customer research, briefs, landing-page structures, forecasting and internal workflows, while maintaining strong human judgement and quality control.

• Develop commercially viable offers, bundles and promotions, modelling the impact on AOV, margin, conversion and contribution profit.

• Create landing-page concepts and testing plans that improve continuity between the ad, proposition, offer and customer journey.

What Success Looks Like

You’ll be measured on the commercial outcomes that matter most, including:

• Total contribution profit and profitable new-customer revenue

• New-customer acquisition cost, blended MER and product/market profitability

• Creative winner rate and profitable spend capacity

• Landing-page conversion improvements and forecast accuracy

• Speed and quality of performance diagnosis and budget decisions

• Increased marketing productivity through AI

What We’re Looking For

• Strong hands-on experience managing and scaling Meta advertising for an e-commerce brand.

• Experience personally managing at least £300,000 per month, ideally £500,000+.

• A proven track record of scaling revenue while maintaining profitability.

• Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills and a strong understanding of contribution profit and e-commerce unit economics.

• Experience analysing performance across products, markets and customer segments.

• Strong creative-strategy and creative-briefing experience, with the ability to connect customer insight to winning advertising concepts.

• Experience developing offers, landing pages or conversion strategies.

• Practical experience using AI to improve marketing output, workflows and decision-making.

• Experience with Shopify and attribution or analytics platforms.

Fashion, apparel or footwear experience is strongly preferred. Experience within a fast-scaling, international DTC brand would also be highly valuable.

The Person

You’ll be highly analytical and naturally creative, commercially minded and focused on profit over vanity metrics. You’ll be proactive, decisive and detail-oriented, able to move quickly without losing accuracy. You’ll also be curious about new tools and ways of working, comfortable challenging assumptions with evidence, and low ego enough to learn closely from the founders while building stronger systems and processes.

Rewarding base salary

Remote first - future London office

High-growth environment with genuine ownership

Opportunity to shape the future product direction of a scaling global brand

jobs.excerpt: About the team Zillow Rentals is building a best-in-class vertically integrated marketplace that connects renters with property owners and managers — from large-scale multifamily communities to single-family homes.
jobs.description:
About the team

Zillow Rentals is building a best-in-class vertically integrated marketplace that connects renters with property owners and managers — from large-scale multifamily communities to single-family homes. We provide advertising solutions and a complete set of digital tools to help partners market their properties, identify prospective tenants, sign leases, and collect payments. This is a high-growth, high-focus area for Zillow and an opportunity to make an outsized impact. Our team includes applied scientists, engineers, designers, product managers, marketers, and researchers partnering across Zillow to deliver trusted experiences for millions of customers.

About the role

Every renter journey on Zillow starts with inventory. If the underlying listing data isn't complete, accurate, and rich, nothing downstream — messaging, touring, applications, leasing — performs the way it should. This role owns that foundation.

The Principal Product Manager for Listings will set the strategy for what makes Zillow's rental selection the deepest, richest, and most complete on the internet. You'll own how rental inventory is sourced, ingested, enriched, and scored for quality — ensuring consumer-facing teams have the best possible data to work with. This spans listing completeness and content quality, inventory coverage and growth, and the data and content partnerships that differentiate Zillow's selection. You'll partner closely with feed engineering on data quality and platform reliability, and represent listings strategy to senior leadership and external partners alike.

This is a high-visibility, strategic product role — not a narrow pipeline role. Get this right and you create a flywheel: richer inventory drives more renter engagement, which attracts more and better inventory. You're building the marketplace's core advantage.

What you'll tackle:

  • Listing completeness & quality: Raise the depth and quality of listing data across all inventory — pricing transparency, amenities, media richness, and the completeness scores that directly drive renter trust and conversion. You'll define what "great" looks like and build the system that gets inventory there at scale.

  • Coverage & inventory growth: Grow the breadth and depth of rental inventory on Zillow across property types and sourcing channels.

  • Data & content partnerships: Source new content partnerships (media, floor plans, review content) and optimize existing feed and aggregator relationships — negotiating, onboarding, and tuning third-party data sources so Zillow has the most comprehensive, highest-quality rental selection anywhere.

  • Platform reliability & syndication: Partner with engineering to keep the listings pipeline stable, performant, and trustworthy — balancing committed roadmap work against urgent partner escalations, and making disciplined tradeoffs when the two collide.

What success looks like:

  • Measurably better listings: A rising share of inventory delivered complete, accurate, and rich — backed by a completeness standard the whole ecosystem can rally around.

  • Broader, deeper coverage: Meaningful growth in rental inventory across channels and property types.

  • Partnerships that differentiate: New and optimized content partnerships that make Zillow's selection unmistakably the richest on the internet.

  • A reliable, scalable foundation: A listings platform that partners and renters trust — stable, performant, and ready for whatever the marketplace throws at it.

This role has been categorized as a Remote position. “Remote” employees do not have a permanent corporate office workplace and, instead, work from a physical location of their choice, which must be identified to the Company. U.S. employees may live in any of the 50 United States, with limited exceptions.In California, Connecticut, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York, Washington state, and Washington DC the standard base pay range for this role is $178,300.00 - $284,700.00 annually. This base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maine, Minnesota, Nevada, Ohio, Rhode Island, Vermont, and Virginia the standard base pay range for this role is $169,300.00 - $270,500.00 annually. The base pay range is specific to these locations and may not be applicable to other locations.In addition to a competitive base salary this position is also eligible for equity awards based on factors such as experience, performance and location. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location. Employees in this role will not be paid below the salary threshold for exempt employees in the state where they reside.

Who you are

You treat listings as a product, not a data feed. You care deeply about the completeness and quality of every listing on the platform — and you understand how upstream inventory decisions drive downstream renter experience and marketplace performance. You bring clarity to ambiguity, influence without authority, and make everyone around you better.

  • 10+ years in a Product Management role, with a focus on building consumer-facing technology products. Marketplace and/or e-commerce experience required.

  • Inventory & marketplace strategy: You think holistically about supply-side strategy — growth, quality, and the flywheel between inventory depth and consumer engagement.

  • Data quality & systems thinking: You're comfortable working with feed engineering on data pipelines, completeness scoring, and quality frameworks. You understand how upstream data decisions ripple into the downstream renter experience.

  • Partnership management: You've managed data and content partnerships at scale — negotiating, onboarding, and optimizing third-party data sources — and you're credible in the room with external partners.

  • Prioritization under pressure: You can hold a committed roadmap while absorbing unplanned work, with disciplined scope management and clear, honest tradeoff communication.

  • AI fluency: You actively use AI tools across the product development lifecycle — research, prototyping, analysis — and can think critically about where and how AI creates value in the product. You're an effective partner to AI/ML teams and comfortable evaluating AI capabilities, build-vs-partner-vs-buy decisions, and the tradeoffs inherent in AI-powered products.

  • Exceptional communication skills (verbal, written, and visual) with the ability to articulate complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences and influence at all levels.

  • Consistent record of shipping successful products at scale.

  • Passion for the real estate industry and a commitment to Zillow Group's mission and values.

Get to know us

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers. As the most-visited real estate platform in the U.S., we help customers navigate buying, selling, financing and renting with greater ease and confidence. Whether you're working in tech, sales, operations, or design, you’ll be part of a company that's reshaping an industry and helping more people make home a reality.

Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the country. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.

No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.

Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please contact your recruiter directly.

Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with applicable state and local law.

About ITC Worldwide

ITC Worldwide is a global leader in delivering high-impact technology training and consultancy services. We specialize in empowering professionals and organizations through expert-led instruction in enterprise platforms such as Cisco, Microsoft, AWS, and Red Hat. Our mission is to foster innovation and excellence through education.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled and certified Cisco Certified Systems Instructor (CCSI) to join our elite team of trainers. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in Cisco technologies, a passion for teaching, and a proven ability to deliver engaging and effective training sessions to technical audiences across the globe.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deliver official Cisco training courses to IT professionals, corporate clients, and academic institutions.
  • Facilitate hands-on labs, simulations, and interactive sessions to reinforce learning.
  • Customize training programs to meet specific client needs and learning objectives.
  • Stay current with Cisco technologies, certifications, and instructional standards.
  • Mentor learners pursuing Cisco certifications such as CCNA, CCNP, and CCIE.
  • Collaborate with curriculum developers to enhance course materials and lab environments.
  • Conduct assessments and evaluations to measure training effectiveness.
  • Support marketing and sales teams in promoting Cisco training offerings.
  • Maintain CCSI status through continuous learning, certification, and compliance with Ciscos Instructor Kit membership.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Valid Cisco Certified Systems Instructor (CCSI) credential.
  • Minimum of 710 years of experience in networking and Cisco technologies.
  • Proven track record of delivering Cisco certification training (e.g., CCNA, CCNP, CCIE).
  • Strong understanding of Cisco technologies including routing, switching, security, wireless, and collaboration.
  • Excellent presentation, communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Experience in instructional design and adult learning methodologies.
  • Ability to adapt training delivery to different learning styles and technical levels.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
  • Willingness to travel for on-site training engagements.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

Preferred Skills

  • Additional Cisco certifications (e.g., CCNP Security, CCIE Enterprise).
  • Experience with Cisco platforms such as Meraki, DNA Center, and SD-WAN.
  • Familiarity with virtual labs and e-learning platforms.
  • Ability to create interactive and multimedia training materials.
  • Knowledge of DevOps and cloud integration with Cisco technologies.
  • Experience in course development, examination, and assessment.

Professional Development

As part of ITC Worldwide, youll gain access to continuous learning opportunities, collaborate with top-tier instructors, and contribute to shaping the future of networking education.

jobs.title: Business Process Operations Analyst (GTM)
jobs.excerpt: We are seeking an experienced Business Process Operations Analyst (GTM Planning) to drive operational excellence across sales, partner, revenue, and business process initiatives.
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced Business Process Operations Analyst (GTM Planning) to drive operational excellence across sales, partner, revenue, and business process initiatives. This role is ideal for a highly analytical professional who combines business analysis expertise with sales operations, reporting, process improvement, and Microsoft ecosystem experience.

Position Summary

The Business Process Operations Analyst (GTM Planning) will support strategic Go-To-Market (GTM) initiatives by designing scalable business processes, developing operational reporting, improving sales and partner workflows, and driving cross-functional planning initiatives.

The successful candidate will collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Customer Success, Delivery, and Partner teams to optimize business performance through data-driven decision making, process automation, and operational governance.

Key Responsibilities

GTM Planning & Revenue Operations

  • Support annual and quarterly GTM planning cycles.
  • Develop territory planning, account coverage, capacity planning, and pipeline management models.
  • Analyze sales productivity metrics and identify opportunities for optimization.
  • Partner with Revenue Operations leadership to improve forecasting accuracy and pipeline visibility.
  • Create operational frameworks that support scalable sales growth.

Business Process Design & Optimization

  • Map current-state and future-state business processes using Visio.
  • Conduct process reviews and identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and automation opportunities.
  • Design and document standardized operating procedures.
  • Lead business process improvement initiatives across sales and partner organizations.
  • Ensure alignment of business processes with strategic objectives.

Business Systems Analysis

  • Gather, document, and validate business requirements.
  • Translate business requirements into functional specifications and user stories.
  • Facilitate stakeholder workshops and requirements discovery sessions.
  • Evaluate impacts of process and system changes.
  • Develop business cases and implementation recommendations.

Reporting & Analytics

  • Develop and maintain executive reporting dashboards.
  • Create Power BI dashboards to support leadership decision making.
  • Build KPI scorecards for Sales, Marketing, Partner Development, and Operations teams.
  • Perform trend analysis and operational performance reviews.
  • Present findings and recommendations to senior leadership.

Microsoft Dynamics 365 & Business Systems

  • Support reporting and analytics within Dynamics 365.
  • Analyze CRM data quality, process utilization, and pipeline effectiveness.
  • Partner with technical teams to improve CRM adoption and data governance.
  • Support business process automation initiatives across the Microsoft technology stack.

Jira Service Management & Project Governance

  • Manage workflows and reporting within Jira Service Management.
  • Facilitate project tracking and operational governance.
  • Support project documentation and stakeholder communications.
  • Collaborate with PMO and technical teams on process improvements.

Partner Ecosystem Operations

  • Support partner planning, partner performance management, and co-sell initiatives.
  • Develop reporting and operational frameworks for channel partner programs.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders to optimize partner engagement models.
  • Monitor partner-related KPIs and business outcomes.

Required Qualifications

Experience

  • 5+ years of GTM Planning experience.
  • 5+ years of Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or Business Operations experience.
  • 5+ years of Business Process Design and Process Improvement experience.
  • 5+ years of Business Systems Requirements Gathering and Analysis.
  • Experience supporting executive-level reporting and operational planning.
  • Experience working within Microsoft-centric environments.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced Power BI dashboard development.
  • Microsoft Dynamics 365 reporting and analytics.
  • Jira Service Management administration and reporting.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Microsoft Visio process mapping expertise.
  • Business process automation experience.
  • Requirements gathering and documentation expertise.

Business Analysis Skills

  • BRD creation.
  • Functional specification development.
  • User story creation.
  • Process documentation.
  • Workflow analysis.
  • Stakeholder management.
  • Root cause analysis.
  • Business case development.

Preferred Qualifications

Certifications (Preferred)

Candidates holding one or more of the following certifications are highly encouraged to apply:

  • PMP (Project Management Professional)
  • CBAP (Certified Business Analysis Professional)
  • CBPP® (Certified Business Process Professional)
  • Prosci Change Management Certification
  • PMI-PBA
  • Agile Scrum Certifications
  • Atlassian Jira Certifications
  • Microsoft Certifications (PL-900, PL-200, MB-210, MB-260, PL-300)

Preferred Industry Experience

  • Microsoft Partner Ecosystem
  • IT Services
  • Professional Services
  • Managed Services
  • Technology Consulting
  • SaaS Organizations
  • Cloud Services
  • CRM and ERP Environments

Success Measures

Within the first 12 months, you will be expected to:

  • Improve GTM planning accuracy and operational visibility.
  • Deliver executive-level Power BI dashboards and KPI reporting.
  • Increase sales and partner process efficiency.
  • Reduce manual operational activities through process automation.
  • Improve CRM reporting, adoption, and data quality.
  • Build scalable frameworks supporting revenue growth and partner expansion.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate has a unique blend of:

GTM Planning Expertise

Revenue Operations & Sales Operations Experience

Strong Business Analyst Background

Advanced Power BI Reporting Skills

Dynamics 365 Reporting Experience

Jira Service Management Knowledge

Process Mapping & BPM Experience

Microsoft Ecosystem Expertise

Partner Program and Channel Operations Experience

Strategic Thinking with Strong Analytical Capabilities

If you enjoy transforming complex business processes into scalable operational frameworks and driving measurable business outcomes through data, process, and technology, we encourage you to apply.

jobs.excerpt: ITC Worldwide is seeking a qualified Azure Native Architect to join our team, focusing on designing and implementing innovative solutions using Azure technologies.
jobs.description:
ITC Worldwide is seeking a qualified Azure Native Architect to join our team, focusing on designing and implementing innovative solutions using Azure technologies.

The ideal candidate will possess deep expertise in Microsoft 365 and Modern Workplace services, with a proven track record in managing complex migration projects and delivering tailored solutions that meet business needs.

Responsibilities

  • Lead Microsoft 365 tenant split and migration projects, ensuring a smooth transition with minimal disruption
  • Architect and implement solutions for Microsoft 365 services, including Active Directory, Azure Active Directory (EntraID), Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, and Intune
  • Manage and execute migrations across various MS 365 components like OneDrive, Teams, SharePoint, and Exchange Migration
  • Provide solutioning for Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps) to optimize workflows and processes
  • Provide administrative oversight and support for MS 365 services and infrastructure
  • Design and develop cost and effort estimation models for Microsoft 365 solutions
  • Configure and optimize Microsoft 365 Co-pilot, Exchange migration, and Intra ID (EntraID) settings as part of the migration process
  • Provide pre-sales support, including solution presentations, RFP responses, and client engagements
  • Implement and manage SharePoint Online solutions to ensure streamlined collaboration and document management
  • Ensure compliance with security protocols and best practices in the migration and setup of Microsoft 365 services
  • Develop and maintain documentation for solutions, configurations, and migration procedures

Requirements

  • Overall 8- 12 years of experience, proficient in Microsoft 365/Modern Workplace services, including Copilot, Exchange Migration, OneDrive, Teams, and SharePoint Online
  • Strong understanding and experience with Active Directory, Azure Active Directory (EntraID), and Intra ID
  • Hands-on experience with Exchange Online, Microsoft Teams, SharePoint Online, and Intune
  • Experience in M365 Solutioning, Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate), and Pre-Sales activities
  • Proven track record in tenant-to-tenant migration projects
  • Experience in building estimation models for Microsoft 365 solutions
  • Certifications: Relevant Microsoft certifications are a plus (e.g., Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert, Azure certifications)

*** Role is 2nd Shift, evenings after 1800 IST / 4-5 hours Daily ***

jobs.title: Azure Data Integration Engineer (DP600/700)
jobs.excerpt: The role involves building and managing data pipelines, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring data accuracy across various platforms such as Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake Gen2, and SQL environments.
jobs.description:
The role involves building and managing data pipelines, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring data accuracy across various platforms such as Azure Synapse Analytics, Azure Data Lake Gen2, and SQL environments.

This position requires extensive SQL experience and a strong background in PySpark development.

  • Certifications in Azure Data Fabric: DP-600 / DP-700

Responsibilities

Data Engineering:

  • Work with Azure Synapse Pipelines and PySpark for data transformation and pipeline management.
  • Perform data integration and schema updates in Delta Lake environments, ensuring smooth data flow and accurate reporting.
  • Work with our Azure DevOps team on CI/CD processes for deployment of Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and Workspace artifacts.
  • Develop custom solutions for our customers defined by our Data Architect and assist in improving our data solution patterns over time.

Documentation:

  • Document ticket resolutions, testing protocols, and data validation processes.
  • Collaborate with other stakeholders to provide specifications and quotations for enhancements requested by customers.

Ticket Management:

  • Monitor the Jira ticket queue and respond to tickets as they are raised.
  • Understand ticket issues, utilizing extensive SQL, Synapse Analytics, and other tools to troubleshoot them.
  • Communicate effectively with customer users who raised the tickets and collaborate with other teams (e.g., FinOps, Databricks) as needed to resolve issues.

Troubleshooting and Support:

  • Handle issues related to ETL pipeline failures, Delta Lake processing, or data inconsistencies in Synapse Analytics.
  • Provide prompt resolution to data pipeline and validation issues, ensuring data integrity and performance.

Desired Skills & Requirements

Seeking a candidate with 5+ years of Dynamics 365 ecosystem experience with a strong PySpark development background. While various profiles may apply, we highly value a strong person-organization fit.

Our ideal candidate possesses the following attributes and qualifications:

  • Extensive experience with SQL, including query writing and troubleshooting in Azure SQL, Synapse Analytics, and Delta Lake environments.
  • Strong understanding and experience in implementing and supporting ETL processes, Data Lakes, and data engineering solutions.
  • Proficiency in using Azure Synapse Analytics, including workspace management, pipeline creation, and data flow management.
  • Hands-on experience with PySpark for data processing and automation.
  • Ability to use VPNs, MFA, RDP, jump boxes/jump hosts, etc., to operate within the customers secure environments.
  • Some experience with Azure DevOps CI/CD IaC and release pipelines.
  • Ability to communicate effectively both verbally and in writing, with strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Understanding of the operation and underlying data structure of D365 Finance and Operations, Business Central, and Customer Engagement.
  • Experience with Data Engineering in Microsoft Fabric
  • Experience with Delta Lake and Azure data engineering concepts (e.g., ADLS, ADF, Synapse, AAD, Databricks).
  • Certifications in Azure Data Fabric: DP-600 / DP-700

Why Join Us?

  • Opportunity to work with innovative technologies in a dynamic environment where progressive work culture with a global perspective where your ideas truly matter, and growth opportunities are endless.
  • Work with the latest Microsoft Technologies alongside Dynamics professionals committed to driving customer success.
  • Enjoy the flexibility to work from anywhere
  • Work-life balance that suits your lifestyle.
  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
  • Career growth and professional development opportunities.
  • A collaborative and inclusive work culture.

jobs.excerpt: Cloud Migration Engineer (Oracle to Azure Workloads) Position Overview: We are seeking a skilled Cloud Migration Engineer to join our team and lead the migration of Oracle workloads to Azure.
jobs.description:
Cloud Migration Engineer (Oracle to Azure Workloads)

Position Overview: We are seeking a skilled Cloud Migration Engineer to join our team and lead the migration of Oracle workloads to Azure. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience with Azure cloud services, networking, and active directory, as well as proficiency in scripting languages and Infrastructure as Code (IaC). This role requires a deep understanding of network security, cost management tools, and strategies to ensure a seamless and efficient migration process.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead the migration of Oracle databases and applications to Azure cloud.
  • Design and implement Azure cloud solutions, ensuring high availability, scalability, and security.
  • Configure and troubleshoot network security settings to protect data and applications.
  • Utilize Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools to automate deployment and management of cloud resources.
  • Develop and maintain scripts using PowerShell to streamline migration and management tasks.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure successful migration and integration of Oracle workloads.
  • Monitor and optimize cloud resources to manage costs effectively.
  • Provide technical support and troubleshooting for post-migration issues.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards and best practices for cloud security and data protection.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

  • Azure Cloud Proficiency: Extensive experience with Azure cloud services, including virtual machines, storage, networking, and active directory.
  • Networking: Strong understanding of networking concepts, including VPN, VNet, and firewall configurations.
  • Active Directory: Experience with Azure Active Directory and its integration with on-premises AD.
  • Network Security: Proven ability to configure and troubleshoot network security settings, including NSGs, ASGs, and Azure Firewall.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Familiarity with IaC tools such as ARM templates, Terraform, or Azure Bicep.
  • Cost Management: Knowledge of Azure cost management tools and strategies to optimize cloud spending.
  • Scripting Languages: Proficiency in scripting languages, particularly PowerShell, for automation and management tasks.
  • Oracle Database: Experience with Oracle database administration and migration.
  • Problem-Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to address migration challenges.
  • Communication: Excellent communication skills to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Microsoft Certifications:
    • Azure Fundamentals (AZ-900)
    • Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)
    • Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305)
    • Azure Security Engineer Associate (AZ-500)
    • DP 600 Required
  • Oracle Certifications:
    • Oracle Database Administrator Certified Professional
    • Oracle Cloud Infrastructure Architect Associate
    • Oracle Database@Azure Specialist

jobs.excerpt: About AmorServ AmorServ delivers technology services, IT support, and digital solutions to enterprise clients.
jobs.description:
About AmorServ

AmorServ delivers technology services, IT support, and digital solutions to enterprise clients. We work across multiple product lines and client engagements, which means our designers shape experiences for both internal platforms and external customer-facing products. Speed, polish, and craft all matter — and AI is now a core part of how we get there.

The Opportunity

We're hiring a UI/UX Designer who has fully embraced AI-assisted design tooling — Figma AI, Google Stitch, v0, Galileo, Magic Patterns, Midjourney, and the rapidly evolving stack around them. This isn't a role for someone who occasionally uses AI for inspiration. We want a designer who treats AI tools as a first-class part of their workflow: generating, iterating, prototyping, and shipping at a pace that wasn't possible two years ago.

You'll own the design output across multiple AmorServ initiatives, partnering closely with engineering to move from idea prototype production-ready UI in days, not weeks.

What You'll Do

  • Lead end-to-end UI/UX design for AmorServ web and mobile products — from discovery and wireframes through high-fidelity mockups and interactive prototypes.
  • Use AI design tools (Figma AI, Google Stitch, v0, Magic Patterns, Galileo, Uizard, etc.) as part of your daily workflow to accelerate ideation, generate variations, and produce production-grade UI faster.
  • Translate business requirements and user research into clean, accessible, conversion-focused interfaces.
  • Build and maintain design systems — components, tokens, patterns — that scale across multiple AmorServ products.
  • Prototype real, clickable experiences that engineers can build directly from, with handoff specs that leave no ambiguity.
  • Use generative AI for visual assets, icon systems, illustrations, and marketing creative when appropriate, while maintaining brand consistency.
  • Run lightweight user testing and incorporate feedback rapidly.
  • Stay ahead of the AI design tooling landscape and bring new workflows into the team.

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • Demonstrable fluency with AI design tools. You should be able to walk us through projects where AI tools materially shaped the output, not just decorated it.
  • Strong portfolio showing shipped product work — web, mobile, or both — with clear visual craft.
  • Expert-level Figma skills (auto-layout, components, variants, variables, prototyping).
  • Solid grasp of design systems, accessibility (WCAG basics), and responsive design.
  • Ability to write clear copy for UI — microcopy, empty states, error messages, onboarding.
  • Comfort with ambiguity, fast iteration, and direct feedback.
  • Clear written and visual communication. You can explain why a design works, not just that it does.

Nice to have:

  • Experience designing for B2B / enterprise software, IT services, or technical products.
  • Front-end fluency — enough HTML/CSS/Tailwind/React to read code, tweak prototypes, or hand off cleanly to engineers.
  • Experience with prompt engineering and getting consistent, on-brand output from generative tools.
  • Motion design (Framer, Rive, After Effects, or Lottie).
  • Background designing AI-powered product features (chat interfaces, agent UIs, generative experiences).

How You Work

  • You ship. You'd rather get a v1 in front of users this week than a v3 in a month.
  • You think in systems, not screens. Every component you make is one someone else can reuse.
  • You treat AI tools as leverage, not a crutch. You know when to generate and when to draw.
  • You sweat the details — spacing, type rhythm, color, motion — because they compound.
  • You're opinionated but not precious. You defend good ideas and let go of bad ones quickly.

What We Offer

  • Compensation matched to experience — we're open from mid-level through lead/principal.
  • A modern AI tooling stack, fully paid for. If a new tool ships and it's worth using, you get it.
  • Real ownership over what you design and how it ships.
  • A small, fast team where your work is visible and your judgment matters.
  • Remote-friendly with flexible hours.

How to Apply

Attach the following as one document:

  • Your portfolio (link or PDF). We care about depth on 2–3 projects more than breadth.
  • A short note (no cover letter required) covering: which AI design tools you use weekly, and one example of a project where AI tooling changed how you'd normally approach the work.
  • Your résumé.

We review every application. If your portfolio shows the craft and the AI fluency, you'll hear back.

AmorServ is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on merit and craft

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Scientific Associate Director - Project Toxicologist

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role, you will serve as the key scientific interface between Translational Safety & Risk Sciences (TSRS) and cross-functional project teams from discovery through post-marketing. TSRS is seeking a Scientific Associate Director to serve as a Project Toxicologist and subject matter expert, reporting to a Senior Director Project Team Representative (PTR) Manager.

You will be responsible for developing and implementing fit-for-purpose nonclinical safety strategies built on a rigorous scientific foundation and aligned with regulatory expectations. As programs evolve, you will flexibly adapt strategies in response to emerging data, and project team needs while leading multidisciplinary TSRS teams. As a PTR, you will partner closely with project teams developing innovative therapeutics across a range of modalities—including biotherapeutics, small molecules, targeted protein degraders, and other complex modalities (e.g. RNA-based therapies) for indications in inflammation, rare diseases, oncology, and cardiometabolic diseases, including obesity. PTRs are encouraged to develop subject matter expertise in a specific modality, therapeutic area, or sub-discipline within nonclinical safety (e.g. drug-induced liver toxicity).

Key Responsibilities

As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will embed complex, high-priority products and related product teams to accelerate Amgen’s adoption of the Digital Product Operating Model (DPOM), strengthen the product management capability, and help teams shift from output to outcome mindsets. Reporting to the Director, Product Management Catalysts, this individual contributor role will serve as a senior hands-on player-coach, partnering directly with Digital Product Managers, business leads, technology leads, data scientists, compliance and quality partners, adjacent product teams, product group leaders, and senior functional stakeholders.

This role will primarily embed with complex, interdependent individual products, though may operate across multiple related product teams when dependencies, stakeholder complexity, or where product outcomes require it. The Associate Director will coach and upskill DPMs and cross-functional teams while helping them apply DPOM practices to real product work. This role will also capture learnings from embedded engagements and contribute insights back to the Product Management Hub to improve DPOM playbooks, tools, standards, Catalyst practices, and enterprise adoption approaches.

Product Strategy, Outcomes, and Prioritization
