About AssetIntel

AssetIntel is a software company that develops asset management software products for the transportation infrastructure industry. Our clients include state transportation agencies, city governments, toll authorities, transit agencies, the Federal Highway Administration (FHWA), and civil engineering firms. For more information, visit our website.

Job Description

We're looking for a Python developer to own the analytical engines behind our products — the codebases where math meets production software. These systems span a range of problems: long-term deterioration modeling and budget optimization, real-time hazard prediction using live data, probabilistic damage assessment, geospatial analysis, and lifecycle cost forecasting. They are the core of what makes our products work.

You'll work alongside domain experts and researchers to turn mathematical formulations into clean, maintainable, production-grade Python. You'll also progressively improve existing code — better architecture, better patterns, better reliability.

This is not a role where you can treat the math as a black box. You need to be genuinely curious about the models and algorithms you're implementing. You don't need to arrive knowing this domain, but you need to be the kind of person who wants to understand it deeply.

What You'll Do

  • Translate mathematical specifications into production code. You'll receive formulations, equations, and pseudocode from the research side of the team. Your job is to understand the intent and write Python that is correct, readable, testable, and maintainable.
  • Improve existing codebases. The current code works in production but has room for architectural improvement. You'll progressively modernize it — better modularity, type safety, test coverage, error handling, and overall code quality.
  • Build new analytical features end-to-end. As our products evolve, you'll implement new capabilities — taking them from mathematical concept to deployed, production-ready code.
  • Bridge the gap between research and engineering. The ability to communicate across these worlds — asking good questions, translating between math and code, pushing back constructively — will be critical to your success here.

What We're Looking For

    • At least 3 years of professional experience working with Python.
    • Strong Python fundamentals — you write clean, idiomatic Python and care about code quality.
    • Experience with numerical/scientific Python libraries: pandas, NumPy, SciPy.
    • Ability to read and reason about mathematical formulations — comfort with equations, probability distributions, and optimization concepts, or a genuine eagerness to learn.
    • Experience writing and maintaining production Python code, not just scripts or notebooks.
    • Good instincts for software architecture — when to refactor, how to decompose large modules, how to manage dependencies.
    • Clear communication skills, especially the ability to collaborate with researchers and domain experts.
    • Comfort with Git and collaborative development workflows.

Bonus points if you've worked with any of the following: mathematical optimization (LP, MIP), geospatial tools like GeoPandas or Shapely, real-time data pipelines or external APIs, Docker and containerized deployments, or cloud infrastructure (Azure or similar). We also especially value people who've introduced engineering discipline — tests, CI/CD, type hints — into messy research codebases without breaking everything in the process.

Nice-to-haves:

    • Experience with multiprocessing in Python and memory-aware resource management.
    • Familiarity with probabilistic modeling, fragility analysis, or statistical risk assessment.

Benefits and Perks
  • Work remotely - anywhere from India.
  • Market-competitive total compensation package and performance-based bonus.
  • Company-paid medical coverage.
  • Fully equipped home office setup, including a high-spec computer, dual monitors, desk, and chair.
  • Plenty of growth opportunities, working alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry.

CrossCountry Mortgage (CCM) is the nation's number one distributed retail mortgage lender with more than 9,000 employees operating over 700 branches and servicing loans across all 50 states, D.C. and Puerto Rico. Our company has been recognized ten times on the Inc. 5000 list of America's fastest-growing private businesses and has received many awards for our standout culture.

A culture where you can grow! CCM has created an exceptional culture driving employee engagement, exceeding employee expectations, and directly impacting company success. At our core, our entrepreneurial spirit empowers every employee to be who they are to help us move forward together. You’ll get unwavering support from all departments and total transparency from the top down.

CCM offers eligible employees a competitive compensation plan and a robust benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, as well as a 401K. We also offer company-provided short-term disability, an employee assistance program, and a wellness program.

Position Overview:
The Mortgage Regulatory Counsel supports compliance-related system and process initiatives by providing legal interpretation, guidance, and review of mortgage regulatory requirements. This role serves as the primary legal resource for fees, disclosure, document, and related document-vendor matters, while also supporting broader mortgage regulatory research and analysis as needed. This role partners closely with Compliance, Technology, Operations, and other stakeholders to ensure legal requirements are translated accurately into business requirements, testing expectations, and compliant system behavior. The Mortgage Regulatory Counsel is responsible for evaluating whether implemented system configurations, document logic, workflows, and outputs satisfy applicable legal and regulatory requirements.

Job Responsibilities:
• Serve as the primary legal resource for fee, disclosure, document, and document‑vendor matters by interpreting applicable federal and state mortgage regulations and providing guidance on fee treatment, disclosure timing and content, document triggers and packages, and related workflow requirements.
• Conduct legal research and analysis on mortgage regulatory questions, including questions outside the fee and disclosure lane, as assigned.
• Turn legal requirements into practical guidance and decision points that Compliance, QA, Technology, and business teams can use for requirements, testing, and implementation.
• Review and approve regulatory requirements, interpretations, and legal positions prepared by Compliance or other stakeholders before implementation where appropriate.
• Evaluate whether proposed system configurations, document logic, disclosures, workflows, and related outputs satisfy regulatory requirements and internal legal interpretations.
• Review testing results, issue findings, and supporting evidence to determine whether observed system behavior or document output meets legal and regulatory expectations.
• Determine pass/fail conclusions, identify follow-up legal questions, and clarify when requirement changes, additional testing, or configuration updates are needed.
• Partner with Technology, Operations, Compliance, and external vendors to help resolve questions related to legal requirements, system behavior, and document generation or delivery.
• Support implementation and ongoing maintenance of document-vendor related legal requirements, including review of how disclosures and documents are generated, triggered, or populated within the loan origination system.
• Document legal interpretations, decisions, issue resolutions, and review conclusions in a clear and organized manner to support implementation, audit, examination, and internal review needs.
• Provide timely legal input on open issues, exceptions, and questions so that compliance-related workstreams can continue to move forward.
• Identify emerging legal issues, gaps, or inconsistencies in requirements, documentation, testing, or system behavior and communicate needed action to stakeholders.

Qualifications and Skills:
• Juris Doctor (JD) from an accredited law school and active license to practice law in at least one U.S. jurisdiction.
• Experience practicing in mortgage, consumer financial services, regulatory compliance, or a related legal field, with advanced knowledge of mortgage regulatory requirements.
• Experience with mortgage fees, disclosures, documents, and related regulatory requirements, preferred.
• Experience supporting implementation or maintenance of loan origination system document logic, disclosure behavior, or document-vendor integrations, preferred.
• Experience with loan origination systems, disclosure processes, document review, or vendor-managed document solutions, preferred; experience with DocMagic is a plus.
• Comfortable collaborating across Legal, Compliance, Technology, Operations, and external vendors in a dynamic environment.
• Advanced legal research and analytical skills, including demonstrated skill in interpreting complex federal and state regulatory requirements and applying them to business processes, system functionality, and document outputs.
• Skilled in determining whether system configurations, workflows, and outputs satisfy legal requirements without necessarily serving as the technical designer of those solutions.
• Advanced judgment and skill in identifying issues requiring formal legal interpretation versus those that can be addressed through practical clarification or guidance.
• Excellent communication skills, including translating legal concepts into actionable guidance for Compliance, Technology, QA, and business stakeholders.
• Skilled in managing multiple legal questions, reviews, and workstreams at the same time while meeting deadlines and supporting project progress.
• Skilled in identifying gaps, inconsistencies, or risks in requirements, testing results, documentation, or system behavior.

• Excellent attention to detail.

The Post Closing Specialist is responsible for coordinating the resolution of conditions identified by the investor during purchase review. To resolve conditions, the Post Closing Specialist is expected to research the loan file, clarify any ambiguity or potential concerns with the investor, determine alternative solutions, work with clients, partner with the appropriate departments to obtain additional or corrected documentation, and request investor exceptions as needed to clear loans for purchase in a timely manner. The Post Closing Specialist uses investor sites and the LOS system to obtain daily suspense reports, uploads documentation to the investor for curing and purchasing of loans, monitors daily workload, and documents and provides updates on all conditioned loans in the pipeline.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Obtain daily suspense reports from investor’s sites to identify loans that have be suspended for purchase.

  • Document notification of suspense information in the system, logging the date of the first condition issued on the loan daily upon receipt of the suspense condition and the suspense(s) cure by date.

  • Review and obtain clarity from the investor when needed to determine the suspense item and what the investor is looking for to cure defect.

  • Review the closed loan file to determine if suspense item(s) are already in the loan file.

  • Collaborate with internal and external departments and the clients to obtain documentation needed to cure suspense items timely.

  • Log documentation received and upload all suspense documentation promptly to investor sites for review and purchasing of the loans.

  • Monitor daily condition reports from the investor for updates on suspended loans or new conditions as received.

  • Notify management on any issues of salability at an investor.

  • Monitor time of loans on the warehouse lines and advise Post Closing Manager of those at potential risk for curtailment from the warehouse.

  • Monitor a pipeline to ensure all loans shipped are either conditioned or purchased on time.

  • Maintain knowledge of agency and investor guidelines and overlays.

  • Excellent attention to detail and decision-making skills.

  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite.

jobs.description:
Category: Technology

Location: Philippines


Remote Job (Philippines-based preferred)

Offshorly is a digital staff augmentation and delivery company with UK management and a Philippines-based team. We provide Developers, Designers, PMs, QA, and strategic delivery support to global clients. We are mid-shift from a traditional dev-led delivery model to CAST (Client AI Solutions Team), an AI-native, forward-deployed model built on shared playbooks and embedded creative/business and data/tech units, and this role sits at the center of that transition.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Head of Delivery to own the operational backbone of how Offshorly delivers work across a portfolio of global clients: quality standards, playbooks, team optimization, and mentoring across Project Managers and delivery teams. This is the person who defines what excellent delivery means at Offshorly and builds the systems and tool kit that make it repeatable. You'll also be the escalation point after Project Managers when delivery issues need to go further, solving problems fast and representing Offshorly with professionalism.

This is both a strategic and tactical role. You'll have real input into how the delivery model evolves as CAST matures. We're results-oriented here, so you'll have real autonomy in how you run delivery, not oversight for its own sake.

Ideal for someone who loves bringing structure, solving delivery blockers, and keeping people moving forward.

Client account ownership is a secondary, not primary, expectation for this role. Where a candidate can also carry account management and client success responsibilities, that is a genuine bonus. Where they cannot, the General Manager will cover that ground directly.

Key Responsibilities:

Operational Excellence and Team OKRs (Primary):

  • Own delivery quality and standards across all client projects and CAST units, including leading onboarding for new clients so expectations and success metrics are aligned from day one.

  • Coordinate with delivery teams to keep resources aligned across client projects and business goals; track timelines and blockers and escalate risk to leadership when needed.

  • Set and track business OKRs tied to delivery, productivity, and quality from which team OKRs build on.

  • Mentor Project Managers and Team Leads, including performance reviews.

  • Build and evolve delivery playbooks so AI orchestration stays consistent as CAST progressively rolls out across delivery teams.

  • Contribute to shaping delivery strategy as CAST matures, including client reporting and capacity forecasting for delivery pipelines.

  • Partner with AI Team leadership on how playbook and orchestration rollout affects delivery standards, without owning AI Excellence reporting or team oversight directly (that sits elsewhere).

Account Management and Client Success (Secondary, bonus if covered):

  • Internal alignment with PMs to stay across delivery status and client needs.

  • External client management touchpoints (monthly and/or quarterly).

  • Build working relationships with clients, partnering with leadership on the bigger picture.

What You'll Own:

Day-to-Day Delivery:

  • Portfolio success: shared ownership with PMs of client expectations, risk mitigation, and on-time delivery; own delivery health checks across the portfolio.

  • Resource and capacity planning: prioritize and coordinate resources across Project Managers, managing the impact of reallocation or resource changes.

Documentation and Planning:

  • Playbook documentation: create, maintain, and version delivery playbooks and case studies, with support from PMs, as the operating model evolves.

  • Performance tracking: own the metrics that show delivery is actually improving, and present your delivery metrics directly at quarterly Board reviews, full ownership of the numbers you're accountable for.

  • Process improvement: find better ways to deliver, and to bring the team along on new ways of working.

What We're Looking For:

  • Minimum 5+ years in delivery management, project management, or digital operations.

  • Experience managing remote cross-functional digital teams (Developers, PMs, QA, Designers).

  • Strong understanding of Agile / hybrid delivery practices, and comfort redesigning process rather than just running an existing one.

  • A mentoring track record, not just management. This role builds people as much as it builds process.

  • Someone motivated by shaping delivery strategy alongside running it day to day.

  • Comfortable with autonomy, measured on outcomes rather than close oversight.

  • A proactive, can-do attitude to everyday problem solving.

  • Calm under pressure, proactive in finding solutions.

  • Bonus: experience with AI-native or AI-augmented delivery models.

  • Bonus: account management or client-facing experience (this is not required, but genuinely valued).

What You'll Get:

  • Ownership of how Offshorly delivers, at a moment where that model is actively being redefined.

  • A genuine voice in shaping delivery strategy as the business evolves.

  • Real autonomy to run delivery your way, we care about outcomes.

  • A people-first culture that values growth, ownership, and contribution.

  • Structured career support and advanced AI training.

  • Bonuses and very competitive salary.

  • Direct partnership with the executive leadership team on the next chapter of the business.

Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

Silvus Technologies, a leading provider of advanced MANET and MIMO communications systems, is reshaping mesh network technology for mission-critical applications – on the ground, in the air and at sea. Its battle-proven StreamCaster family of MANET radios and proprietary MN-MIMO waveform provides the vital communications link for defense, law enforcement and public safety agencies around the world, and in the toughest operational environments.

With deep roots in DARPA research, Silvus Technologies develops world-class advanced communications technologies that are reshaping the tactical communications landscape. From pure line-of-sight to extreme non-line-of-sight, Silvus radios form a self-healing, self-forming mesh network, enabling secure and reliable connectivity, including video and high-bandwidth data.

Silvus Technologies is a wholly owned subsidiary of Motorola Solutions, Inc.


Job Description

THE OPPORTUNITY

Would you like to join an incredibly talented group of people, doing very challenging work, with the prime directive of “Keeping Our Heroes Connected”?

Silvus is seeking a proactive and growth-oriented Director of Sales, OEM/Prime Partners, who will report to the Senior Director, OEM/Primes. The successful individual in this role will drive sales and manage relationships with our OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturer) and Prime Contractor partners. This role does not interface with the end customer (e.g., DoD) but instead focuses on ensuring Silvus technology is designed into and sold through our partners' platforms (e.g., unmanned systems, C2 applications, etc.). This is a quota-carrying, B2B account management and sales role.

This position is eligible for 100% remote work depending on location. The travel requirement for this role is from 25-50%, or 1-2 weeks per month.

  • Market Awareness: Stay updated on trends, changes, and competitor actions in the market that may impact the company's positioning. This includes setting and meeting an annual target for new business to support our growth in the Unmanned systems market.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Clinical
jobs.excerpt: About ECP ECP is a market-leading SaaS solution that enables senior living communities to better care for their residents.
jobs.description:
About ECP

ECP is a market-leading SaaS solution that enables senior living communities to better care for their residents. ECP is used in over 8,000 communities. We're looking to further expand by increasing the number of customers that use our software and increasing the scope of how we serve our customers by developing and releasing new products.

Senior living is deeply under-penetrated with software and ECP is one of the largest and fastest-growing software companies in the industry. We recently raised a growth round of equity to reinvest in our product, technology, and go-to-market. Our mission is to build world-class software that improves the quality of life for seniors and improves clinical, business, compliance, and operational performance for our customers.

The Role

The clinical product is ECP's flagship, and caregivers are in it every shift. When a nurse documents a medication administration or a care aide records an overnight observation, that's our software.

The team you'd join builds the next generation of it. The new platform is live and customers are using it, but most clinical functionality still sits in ColdFusion and AngularJS. We move customers a function at a time, so a caregiver can be in the new platform for one task and in ColdFusion for the next. Finishing that migration is the near-term work, and we're doing it with AI. The hard part is proving a migrated workflow still does what it did before.

You'd report to the Senior Engineering Manager for Clinical, on a team of four engineers with a tech lead and a dedicated product manager. You'd own clinical domains end to end, moving them onto the new platform for most of your first year and building new capability on them after that.

The stack: The new code is Node, React, and TypeScript on AWS, with domain-driven design and an event bus between the products. Data is SQL Server on a single-tenant database model, one per community. You won't write much ColdFusion, but you'll read plenty of it.

What You'll Build

The migration. You'll take a workflow that lives in ColdFusion today, work out what it does including the parts nobody wrote down, and rebuild it. You own that domain through to production, and you write the tests that prove it works. Not all of it carries over unchanged. The medication administration workflow is already redesigned and waiting, and you'll settle with product up front which differences are deliberate, so nobody reads one as a regression later.

New clinical capability. Once a domain lands on the new platform, the team builds on it. You'll work with the product manager on scope and sequencing, and we expect you to push back when there's a cheaper way to get a caregiver the same outcome.

The quality bar. The team is moving toward engineer-owned automated coverage in Playwright, and we want it to go further. You carry the pager for the domains you build.

What Success Looks Like

At six months the migration is well underway, and several of the domains that moved are yours. Caregivers are using them. The team has taken its cues from you on what AI-generated work is fit to merge, and review isn't where the migration slows down.

Past the migration, this job is new clinical capability, and the measure is how quickly a caregiver gets something they asked for.

Requirements

Required

  • Depth in TypeScript on both sides of the stack, Node on the server and React in the browser. Tell us about a feature you took from the data model to the interface, and what you'd model differently now.
  • AI-assisted development is how you work, daily, on production code, and you know where you stopped trusting it.
  • You've pointed AI at a large codebase you didn't write and gotten useful work out of it. The part we want to hear about is what you did when the first answer was confidently wrong because the model couldn't see enough of the system.
  • You've moved other engineers along in how they use AI.
  • Domain-driven design in a complex domain. The version that matters here is drawing a boundary against a system you can't change, so tell us about one you drew and what it cost you when it landed in the wrong place.
  • You've built software where a defect has consequences past a bad user experience, and it changed how you test and how you ship. You were on call for it.
  • Data modeling and query performance where the tenant model is the data model. You've found and fixed a query that was fine in development and fell over on your largest customer.
  • You work with product instead of waiting on it. You've changed what got built by understanding the business problem behind a story.

Preferred

  • A legacy-to-next-generation migration you saw through, particularly one where both systems ran in production at the same time
  • ColdFusion, or another language you inherited rather than chose
  • HIPAA, PHI, or another regulated data environment
  • SQL Server, AWS, event-driven architecture in production
  • Offline-first or progressive web applications
  • Playwright or comparable browser automation you owned yourself
  • Healthcare, or time spent watching clinical staff work

If you’re ready to do your best work, at scale, with purpose — this is your place.


Position Overview

As a Senior Platform Engineer, your primary mandate is to manage our platforms to improve business continuity, best practices and contribute to the developer experience end-to-end, eliminating friction, accelerating onboarding to first contribution, and lifting productivity across the entire software delivery lifecycle. You will drive modernization and platform initiatives and steward high-leverage practices (Engineering, DevEx, SRE, DevSecOps, and AI-assisted engineering), operating both hands-on and strategically while partnering with executive leadership and guiding Staff/Senior engineers to deliver scalable, reliable, compliant, and cost-efficient solutions on AWS. Crucially, you will translate day-to-day developer needs into Golden Paths, opinionated tooling, and policy-backed workflows, enabling adoption through clear documentation, targeted training, and automated self-service capabilities.

Key Responsabilities

  • Architectural Strategy: Define and steer medium and long-term architectural strategies for the platform, ensuring efficiency, scalability, and reliability across all AWS environments.
  • Platform as a Product: Codify architecture into practice by delivering reference implementations and Golden Path templates for high-performance builds and standardized scaffolding.
  • GitOps & Continuous Delivery: Engineer safe delivery and reusable GitHub Actions. Institutionalize GitOps using ArgoCD/Flux and Flagger for progressive rollouts (canary/blue-green) with automated, SLO-gated rollbacks.
  • Cloud-Native Orchestration: Manage and optimize Kubernetes operations using Karpenter for intelligent node provisioning, as well as HPA and KEDA for event-driven autoscaling.
  • Observability & SRE: Make observability the default through OpenTelemetry and New Relic. Define SLIs/SLOs, establish error-budget policies, and automate tracking of post-incident actions.
  • Security & Service Mesh: Raise cloud and service security, operate and propose improvements related to OAuth2/JWT and secrets lifecycle management (Secrets Manager/KMS). Implement Policy-as-Code adoption across CI/CD and Kubernetes admission controllers.
  • Event-Driven Excellence: Design and operate event topologies covering Kafka partitioning, compaction, retention policies, and schema evolution, including performance and reliability.
  • AI-Assisted Engineering: Promote the adoption of AI-assisted practices to enhance code quality, automated refactoring, automated operations, and technical documentation.
  • FinOps & Efficiency: Drive cost-aware architecture through cloud computing best practices, scalability, and platform/service efficiency, not merely focusing on savings plans or reservations.
  • Technical Governance: Implement governance and controls that ensure the correct management of services, security, and compliance of our platforms and technologies, contributing to a culture of excellence.

Requirements

Software Engineering & Architecture

- Academic Foundation: Background in Computer Science, Engineering, or related disciplines.

- Expert Development: Extensive hands-on experience in software engineering, with solid proficiency in Java (Spring Boot) and TypeScript/Python.

- Distributed Systems: Mastery of Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and microservices architecture, designing for high performance and high availability.

- Build: Deep knowledge of Bazel build systems.

Cloud & Infrastructure (AWS Expertise)

- Expert-Level AWS: Deep, practical experience with core services: EKS, Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, S3, IAM, Networking, and Security.

- Infrastructure as Code: Advanced experience with Terraform (modules/policy enforcement) and Pulumi (multi-language stacks).

- Kubernetes Internals: Deep knowledge of EKS, including Karpenter for scaling, Istio for service mesh, and Argo/Flux for GitOps.

Security, Reliability & Observability

- SRE & Resilience: Mastery of reliability patterns (circuit breakers, retries, back-pressure, stress tests, application architecture) and SLO-driven operations.

- Security Hardening: Expert knowledge of AWS security controls, OPA/Rego policy design for admission controllers, and container security (image signing, ECR scanning).

- Full-Stack Observability: Proficiency in OpenTelemetry design and integration with New Relic, Grafana, and Prometheus.

Developer Experience (DevEx)

- Self-Service Platforms: Proven experience building Internal Developer Portals and ephemeral environments.

- Delivery Automation: Expertise in GitHub Actions, Flagger for progressive delivery, and feature-flag governance.

Soft Skills

- Strategic Mindset: Ability to translate complex business goals into long-term technical direction.

- Influential Leadership: Excellent communication skills to influence stakeholders and mentor technical leaders.

- Autonomy & Accountability: High degree of ownership with a bias for action in fast-paced, large-scale environments.

- Constructive Culture: Active contributor to feedback loops, ADR/RFC hygiene, and continuous learning.

Industry-Specific Knowledge

- Real-world experience in critical workloads and regulated environments (ideally Fintech).

- Ability to translate compliance controls (PCI-DSS, LGPD) into automated technical patterns.

  • Flexible meal allowance (via Flash).
  • TotalPass membership to take care of your health.
  • Spanish or Portuguese classes.

Diversity & Inclusion at RecargaPay

At RecargaPay, you’ll have the freedom to be who you are because we believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us more creative and stronger. Here, everyone is welcome to express themselves authentically. We value the richness of each journey and the multiple ways of seeing the world, without distinctions of gender, race, sexual orientation, age, religion, or any other characteristic that makes us unique.

About the Use of Your Data

By sharing your resume with us, you authorize the use of your data for analysis during the selection process and possibly for other opportunities within the RecargaPay group. ALTEN Mexico is a subsidiary of ALTEN Group. ALTEN group has been a leader in engineering and information technology for more than 30 years and operates in 30 countries across Europe, North America, Asia, Africa, and the Middle East and employs more than 46,000 people, 88% of whom are engineers.

We are looking for Systems Requirements Engineer Jr:

Intermediate System Requirements Engineer – Infotainment Subsystem
Acts as the key liaison between Design & Release Engineers (DREs) and System Architects, ensuring that technical and regulatory needs are translated into clear, specific, and actionable requirements for the design, development, validation, and release of vehicle electrical and electronic components.

Utilizes Requirements Engineering methodologies to elicit, analyze, document, and maintain system requirements. Experienced in specialized tools such as IBM DOORS for requirements management, IBM Engineering Workflow Management (RTC) for workflow control, and JIRA for issue tracking.

Collaborates closely in system design and development, actively participating in the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC). Applies analytical methods such as DFMEA to ensure the quality and reliability of the infotainment system, including the integration of advanced technologies such as Apple CarPlay and Android Auto.

Activities:

1. Requirements Definition & Management

    • Write, update, and maintain technical requirements for the Infotainment subsystem (and Cabin Thermal & Safety, as applicable) throughout production phases.
    • Conduct requirements elicitation through stakeholder interviews and workshops.
    • Utilize IBM DOORS for requirements management and traceability.

2. Systems Analysis & Design

    • Perform system requirements analysis using established engineering methodologies.
    • Collaborate in the design and development of infotainment hardware and software systems.
    • Support system modeling and architecture activities.

3. Technical Coordination & Liaison

    • Act as the key link between Design & Release Engineers (DREs) and System Architects.
    • Work cross-functionally with multidisciplinary engineering teams to ensure correct hardware–software integration.

4. Diagnostics & Troubleshooting

    • Identify, analyze, and resolve hardware and software system failures.
    • Apply diagnostic tools to detect and address technical issues.

5. Project Tracking & Workflow Control

    • Use IBM Engineering Workflow Management (RTC) and JIRA to manage workflows, tasks, and issue tracking.
    • Contribute to the complete Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) for infotainment components.

6. Quality Assurance & Risk Analysis

    • Conduct thorough testing to validate system functionality and reliability.
    • Perform DFMEA to identify and mitigate potential design risks.

7. Technical Documentation

    • Create and maintain detailed records of diagnosed issues, implemented solutions, and established requirements.
    • Prepare and update technical documentation, including specifications and reports.

Requirements

  • University Degree (Bachelor’s or Engineering) in related fields such as: Mechatronics Engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Systems Engineering, Software Engineering, Telecommunications Engineering
  • Requirements Engineering: Basic level (0–1 years of experience in definition, management, and elicitation of requirements).
  • Requirements Management with IBM DOORS: Basic level (0–1 years of experience).
  • Workflow Control with IBM Engineering Workflow Management (RTC): Basic
  • Issue Tracking with JIRA: Basic (0–1 years of experience).
  • Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC): Basic (0–1 years of experience).
  • Diagnostics and Troubleshooting (HW/SW): Basic (0–1 years of experience).
  • Systems Engineering Methodologies: Basic
  • Vehicle Communication Protocols (CAN, LIN): Basic
  • Embedded Systems Knowledge
  • DFMEA Analysis: Basic
  • Design for Six Sigma (DFSS): Basic
  • CATIA V5: Basic
  • Knowledge of Apple CarPlay / Android Auto: Basic (0–1 years of experience).
  • Programming Languages (Python, C/C++): Basic level
  • Knowledge of Vehicle Safety Regulations: Basic level

Benefits

  • Competitive salary
  • Above-law benefits
  • Career growth and development plan
  • Remote work scheme
  • Support for home office setup

jobs.excerpt: About Withings Medical Group Withings is a global leader in connected health devices — from smart blood pressure monitors and scales to sleep and activity trackers.
jobs.description:
About Withings Medical Group

Withings is a global leader in connected health devices — from smart blood pressure monitors and scales to sleep and activity trackers. Withings Medical Group extends this mission into clinical care. The ACCESS program integrates device-generated data, AI-driven insights, and a dedicated virtual care team to manage cardiometabolic conditions — hypertension, dyslipidemia, CKD, obesity, and diabetes — meeting patients where they are, in their homes, across up to 50 states.

The role in one sentence

As our first clinical hire, you won’t just fill a role — you will help shape it. This is a rare opportunity for a forward-thinking NP to work at the intersection of virtual care, digital health, and value-based medicine, partnering directly with the Medical Director to build the workflows, protocols, and care standards that will define how ACCESS delivers outcomes at scale.

This is a part-time 1099 independent contractor role, designed to convert to a full-time salaried position as the ACCESS program scales. We expect this transition to occur as the program grows toward 1,000+ patients, contingent on program growth and mutual fit.

What you’ll do

Clinical care

  • Conduct virtual medical evaluations via video, phone, and asynchronous forms — confirming diagnoses, assessing for target organ damage, and documenting baseline metrics.
  • Create and manage holistic, evidence-based care plans for patients with ACCESS-defined conditions: obesity, dyslipidemia, hypertension, ASCVD, mild-to-moderate CKD, and pre/diabetes.
  • Act as the primary prescriber in Full Practice Authority states, including medication titration and renewal per clinical protocol. In non-FPA states, prescribe under Collaborative Practice Agreements with the Medical Director.
  • Manage device-triggered Red Alerts (e.g., BP >180/110) — triaging patients for ER referral or immediate titration adjustment during business hours.
  • Provide warm handoffs to referring clinicians in urgent situations, including new renal failure presentations.

Documentation & risk capture

  • Document all patient interactions — synchronous and asynchronous — in the EHR with accurate ICD-10 coding.
  • Capture comorbidities accurately (e.g., CKD Stage 3b) to ensure correct reimbursement at the CKM rate rather than the standard eCKM rate.
  • Prepare PCP care coordination reports to maintain the ACCESS-model partnership with referring physicians.

Program building

  • Collaborate with the Medical Director to develop and refine evidence-based titration algorithms and clinical protocols.
  • Contribute to building scalable workflows that can support rapid patient volume growth.
  • Provide feedback on app-based care tools, behavioral support content, and remote monitoring integration to continuously improve the patient experience.

Requirements

What you’ll bring

  • Active NP license in good standing in your home state; IMLC/eNLC compact license strongly preferred. Willingness to obtain licensure in target states within 90 days of start.
  • Board certification through ANCC or AANP as a Family, Adult-Gerontology Primary Care, or Adult-Gerontology Acute Care NP.
  • Minimum 2 years of post-licensure clinical experience in primary care, internal medicine, endocrinology, cardiology, or geriatrics with a strong command of cardiometabolic conditions.
  • Demonstrated comfort with telehealth or digital care delivery — you thrive in a screen-based, asynchronous-forward environment.
  • Strong documentation discipline and familiarity with EHR systems.
  • Excellent independent clinical judgment — you are comfortable making decisions without a physician in the room.
  • US residency (all 50 states and US territories).

Bonus points for

  • Experience with value-based care, CMS quality measures, or ACO/care management programs.
  • Familiarity with CKM (Cardiovascular-Kidney-Metabolic) conditions and GLP-1 therapy management.
  • Comfort prescribing under Collaborative Practice Agreements in non-Full Practice Authority states.
  • Spanish language proficiency — our platform serves both English and Spanish speakers.
  • Prior experience building or launching a new clinical program or service line.

Benefits

  • Part-time 1099 contract to start, estimated at 20 hours per week, with a competitive hourly or project-based rate.
  • A structured path to full-time conversion as ACCESS scales toward 1,000+ patients — this is a ground-floor opportunity, not a permanent contractor role.
  • Open to candidates anywhere in the US — this role is fully remote. We have a preference for candidates based in or near Boston, as occasional in-office collaboration at our Boston headquarters is a plus, though not required.
  • Direct access to senior leadership and real ownership over how ACCESS is built — your decisions will shape the program from day one.
  • Upon conversion to full-time: full Withings benefits package including health coverage, 401(k) match, wellness reimbursements, and access to Withings products.

jobs.description:
About PCR & Orbit

Professional Computing Resources (PCR) supports complex, regulated organizations, especially higher education and the public sector, with technology asset management solutions across hardware and telecom.

Orbit is PCR’s new cloud product for software lifecycle management. Orbit unifies software spend, usage, renewals, vendor contracts, and ROI insights into a single system of record, paired with an AI powered layer that helps teams surface what matters and what to do next.

Orbit has a strong runway through PCR’s installed base, with a large horizontal opportunity beyond it. Orbit is the starting point, not the finish line. We intend to keep shipping modules and adjacent products over time to address more of the IT workflow in higher ed and the public sector, leveraging PCR’s distribution and Valsoft’s operational strength to move quickly.

The role

We’re hiring a Head of Revenue to lead Orbit’s go to market from launch through early scale. This is the first dedicated commercial hire for Orbit. You will own pipeline creation, run full cycle deals, and build the repeatable sales motion we will scale over time.

This is a hands on operator role. You will be a key bridge between the market and product, turning customer discovery into clear requirements, prioritization, and shipped capabilities that drive adoption and profitable growth. You will also continuously look for ways to grow Orbit and expand the opportunity, both by extending Orbit into adjacent workflows and by identifying new modules or product opportunities beyond Orbit that fit the higher ed and public sector IT workflow where PCR already plays today.

As traction grows, we will add tools and capacity such as marketing support, SDR support, and partners, but early on you will be the person driving momentum.

What you’ll do and own

1) Own revenue end to end, hands on

  • Own new revenue for Orbit and take a hands on approach to closing business
  • Build pipeline through targeted outbound, webinars and events, partnerships, and leveraging PCR’s installed base
  • Run deals end to end from discovery to demo to pilot or proof to proposal to negotiation to close
  • Sell to cross functional stakeholders and buying committees across IT, procurement, finance, and operations
  • Maintain strong CRM hygiene, forecasting, and a consistent weekly operating cadence for pipeline reviews and deal strategy

2) Build demand in a scrappy, repeatable way

  • Create and run outbound motions including account lists, sequencing, messaging tests, and a call email LinkedIn mix
  • Develop campaigns that create spikes in demand such as webinars, customer showcases, partner sessions, and conference follow ups
  • Establish a simple measurable funnel and iterate quickly using conversion rates, cycle length, and win loss themes
  • Use PCR’s credibility, relationships, and customer access to accelerate trust and shorten cycles

3) Translate market feedback into shipped must haves

  • Spend meaningful time in customer conversations to understand workflows, blockers, and urgency drivers
  • Turn insights into structured inputs for product and engineering including requirements, prioritization, integrations, packaging, and what needs to be true to win and expand
  • Partner closely with product and engineering to sharpen workflows and push fast iterations that improve conversion, adoption, and retention
  • Create early proof points such as reference customers, case studies, and outcome narratives

4) Keep expanding the opportunity, Orbit and beyond

  • Continuously look for opportunities to expand Orbit into adjacent needs across the higher ed and public sector IT workflow where PCR plays today
  • Identify and validate new modules, integrations, and next products through discovery, then help turn the best opportunities into a clear build and sell plan
  • Bring a GM mindset to growth by increasing ACV, improving retention and expansion, and strengthening Orbit’s strategic position over the next three to five years

5) Build the foundation for scale

  • Create the repeatable sales playbook including ICP, messaging, talk tracks, demo narrative, objection handling, sequences, and lightweight enablement
  • Recommend when to add capacity such as SDR, marketing support, partners, and CS based on leading indicators and what is proven
  • Help define the longer term commercial approach including coverage model, partner strategy, and the operating cadence that scales

Ideal background and requirements

Must haves

  • 6 to 12 plus years in B2B SaaS revenue roles with full cycle closing experience
  • Proven ability to create pipeline, not just work inbound, and deliver against a revenue target
  • Experience selling into multi stakeholder, multi budget environments with comfort navigating procurement, legal, and security
  • Strong discovery, presentation, negotiation, and written communication skills
  • High ownership and operational discipline, you run a tight cadence, keep deals moving, and improve the system
  • Experience in a startup, early stage, or bootstrapped environment where you wore multiple hats and built GTM foundations
  • Demonstrated ability to work with product, identify product opportunities from customer feedback, and translate them into must haves with product and engineering
  • Experience launching a new product or building a repeatable motion from scratch

Nice to haves

  • Higher ed, public sector, or healthcare experience
  • Familiarity with ITSM, ITAM, SAM, procurement, vendor management, or contract lifecycle concepts
  • Partnership or channel experience with resellers, associations, consultants, or ISV partners
  • AI curiosity and comfort positioning AI enabled workflows credibly with practical value, not buzzwords

Compensation

Base salary plus bonus tied to value creation in Orbit, specifically profitable MRR growth, with a ramp period and milestone based accelerators aligned to early stage execution.

Location and travel

Remote friendly, with travel for key customer meetings, conferences, and relationship building as needed.

jobs.excerpt: About PCR & Orbit Professional Computing Resources (PCR) supports complex, regulated organizations, especially higher education and the public sector, with technology asset management solutions across hardware and telecom.
jobs.description:
About PCR & Orbit

Professional Computing Resources (PCR) supports complex, regulated organizations, especially higher education and the public sector, with technology asset management solutions across hardware and telecom.

Orbit is PCR’s new cloud product for software lifecycle management. Orbit unifies software spend, usage, renewals, vendor contracts, and ROI insights into a single system of record, paired with an AI powered layer that helps teams surface what matters and what to do next.

Orbit has a strong runway through PCR’s installed base, with a large horizontal opportunity beyond it. Orbit is the starting point, not the finish line. We intend to keep shipping modules and adjacent products over time to address more of the IT workflow in higher ed and the public sector, leveraging PCR’s distribution and Valsoft’s operational strength to move quickly.

The role

We’re hiring a Head of Revenue to lead Orbit’s go to market from launch through early scale. This is the first dedicated commercial hire for Orbit. You will own pipeline creation, run full cycle deals, and build the repeatable sales motion we will scale over time.

This is a hands on operator role. You will be a key bridge between the market and product, turning customer discovery into clear requirements, prioritization, and shipped capabilities that drive adoption and profitable growth. You will also continuously look for ways to grow Orbit and expand the opportunity, both by extending Orbit into adjacent workflows and by identifying new modules or product opportunities beyond Orbit that fit the higher ed and public sector IT workflow where PCR already plays today.

As traction grows, we will add tools and capacity such as marketing support, SDR support, and partners, but early on you will be the person driving momentum.

What you’ll do and own

1) Own revenue end to end, hands on

  • Own new revenue for Orbit and take a hands on approach to closing business
  • Build pipeline through targeted outbound, webinars and events, partnerships, and leveraging PCR’s installed base
  • Run deals end to end from discovery to demo to pilot or proof to proposal to negotiation to close
  • Sell to cross functional stakeholders and buying committees across IT, procurement, finance, and operations
  • Maintain strong CRM hygiene, forecasting, and a consistent weekly operating cadence for pipeline reviews and deal strategy

2) Build demand in a scrappy, repeatable way

  • Create and run outbound motions including account lists, sequencing, messaging tests, and a call email LinkedIn mix
  • Develop campaigns that create spikes in demand such as webinars, customer showcases, partner sessions, and conference follow ups
  • Establish a simple measurable funnel and iterate quickly using conversion rates, cycle length, and win loss themes
  • Use PCR’s credibility, relationships, and customer access to accelerate trust and shorten cycles

3) Translate market feedback into shipped must haves

  • Spend meaningful time in customer conversations to understand workflows, blockers, and urgency drivers
  • Turn insights into structured inputs for product and engineering including requirements, prioritization, integrations, packaging, and what needs to be true to win and expand
  • Partner closely with product and engineering to sharpen workflows and push fast iterations that improve conversion, adoption, and retention
  • Create early proof points such as reference customers, case studies, and outcome narratives

4) Keep expanding the opportunity, Orbit and beyond

  • Continuously look for opportunities to expand Orbit into adjacent needs across the higher ed and public sector IT workflow where PCR plays today
  • Identify and validate new modules, integrations, and next products through discovery, then help turn the best opportunities into a clear build and sell plan
  • Bring a GM mindset to growth by increasing ACV, improving retention and expansion, and strengthening Orbit’s strategic position over the next three to five years

5) Build the foundation for scale

  • Create the repeatable sales playbook including ICP, messaging, talk tracks, demo narrative, objection handling, sequences, and lightweight enablement
  • Recommend when to add capacity such as SDR, marketing support, partners, and CS based on leading indicators and what is proven
  • Help define the longer term commercial approach including coverage model, partner strategy, and the operating cadence that scales

Ideal background and requirements

Must haves

  • 6 to 12 plus years in B2B SaaS revenue roles with full cycle closing experience
  • Proven ability to create pipeline, not just work inbound, and deliver against a revenue target
  • Experience selling into multi stakeholder, multi budget environments with comfort navigating procurement, legal, and security
  • Strong discovery, presentation, negotiation, and written communication skills
  • High ownership and operational discipline, you run a tight cadence, keep deals moving, and improve the system
  • Experience in a startup, early stage, or bootstrapped environment where you wore multiple hats and built GTM foundations
  • Demonstrated ability to work with product, identify product opportunities from customer feedback, and translate them into must haves with product and engineering
  • Experience launching a new product or building a repeatable motion from scratch

Nice to haves

  • Higher ed, public sector, or healthcare experience
  • Familiarity with ITSM, ITAM, SAM, procurement, vendor management, or contract lifecycle concepts
  • Partnership or channel experience with resellers, associations, consultants, or ISV partners
  • AI curiosity and comfort positioning AI enabled workflows credibly with practical value, not buzzwords

Compensation

Base salary plus bonus tied to value creation in Orbit, specifically profitable MRR growth, with a ramp period and milestone based accelerators aligned to early stage execution.

Location and travel

Remote friendly, with travel for key customer meetings, conferences, and relationship building as needed.

You'll be accountable for gross and net revenue retention across the customer base and report directly to the CRO.

This is a rare setup: you're inheriting a healthy, high-performing team with strong operating frameworks, documented processes, and an established forecasting discipline — built by a leader who is moving into a company-wide operations role. Your mandate isn't to fix something broken. It's to take full ownership, develop the management bench, and scale the organization ahead of the company's growth.

  • Enterprise relationships. Direct ownership of executive relationships with our largest customers.
  • Operating rigor. Weekly and monthly operating cadences — portfolio reviews, call coaching, QBRs, onboarding execution — enforced consistently across segments.
  • Cross-functional leadership. The face of CS with Sales (handoffs, account planning), Product (escalations, feature input), and Finance (renewals, forecasting).
  • Efficiency and AI adoption. Evolving coverage models, tooling, and AI-assisted workflows so revenue under management grows faster than headcount.

  • A track record of building repeatable process: operating cadences, forecast discipline, onboarding and QBR programs
  • Executive presence — you can coach a call review in the morning and present retention strategy to the board in the afternoon
  • A high-ownership mindset: the number is yours from day one

Nice to have: construction industry or vertical SaaS experience. Our CSMs bring deep domain expertise — we need you to bring world-class CS leadership.

Why This Role

  • Own a complete function

  • A company culture built on our values: Be Curious, Keep It Simple, Customer Obsession, Raise the Bar

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack .NET Developer
jobs.excerpt: UnionTrack builds the software labor unions use to run their operations, from membership management to training and certification.
jobs.description:
UnionTrack builds the software labor unions use to run their operations, from membership management to training and certification. Unions face constant pressure to deliver more for their members while keeping operating costs down, and growing regulation is changing how they must store and transmit members’ personal data.

UnionTrack takes that work off their plate so unions can spend their time and resources on their core mission: protecting the rights of today’s workforce and training the next generation of skilled workers. Our goal is to become the go-to platform for labor union management and membership operations.

We’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack .NET Developer to help build and grow the UnionTrack platform. You’ll work across the stack, from SQL Server and C# APIs to the Angular screens our customers use every day, with a strong focus on the financial features unions depend on, such as dues, payments, billing, and reporting. This role will both support our legacy systems and help us build the next iteration of Engage, our flagship platform. You’ll also help us find practical ways to use AI, both in how we build software and in the product itself. This is a fully remote (US or Canada Based) position reporting to the Director of Development.

What you’ll do:

  • Build features end to end: C# and ASP.NET Core Web API on the back end, SQL Server for data, and Angular on the front end.
  • Own the front-end work for the features you build, including layouts, forms, and data-heavy screens, using our existing design patterns and component libraries. You’ll partner with our UI team on larger design efforts.
  • Build and maintain the financial side of the platform, including dues and payment processing, billing, reconciliation, and financial reporting, with the accuracy and auditability that handling money requires.
  • Support our legacy system, built largely on SQL Server stored procedures, for a period of time: fixing bugs, working customer escalations, and making careful changes while keeping existing functionality stable.
  • Help plan and carry out the modernization of legacy functionality onto our current platform.
  • Design, build, and maintain secure, scalable REST APIs and third-party integrations, including payment processors and other financial services.
  • Use AI coding tools in your daily work and help the team adopt them well, reviewing generated code for quality, security, and correctness.
  • Explore and help build AI-powered features in the product where they make our customers’ work easier.
  • Work closely with product, UI/UX, and QA teammates in an Agile environment, and contribute to technical design and architectural direction.
  • Build and support cloud services on Azure, including Azure Functions, and help improve our CI/CD pipelines in Azure DevOps.
  • Protect members’ personal and financial data through secure coding practices, sound authentication and authorization, and privacy-conscious data handling.
  • Write automated tests, review code, mentor other developers, and help resolve production issues.

Requirements

What you bring:

  • 5+ years of professional development experience with C# and modern .NET, including building production REST APIs.
  • Strong SQL Server skills, including schema design, query tuning, and writing and maintaining complex T-SQL stored procedures, plus hands-on experience with Entity Framework Core and Dapper.
  • Solid front-end experience with Angular or a similar modern framework, including TypeScript, HTML, and CSS.
  • Good design sense. You can build a clean, consistent, usable screen on your own, and you know when a problem calls for a dedicated designer.
  • Experience building or supporting financial functionality, such as payments, billing, invoicing, accounting integrations, or financial reporting, along with a high regard for precision and data integrity.
  • Hands-on experience with AI, or at minimum a real interest in it. That could mean using AI coding assistants day to day, working with LLM APIs, or building AI features. Curiosity and good judgment matter more to us than a long track record here.
  • A willingness to support a legacy system for a period of time, plus experience reading, debugging, and refactoring stored procedure-heavy business logic.
  • Experience with Azure services (such as Azure Functions, App Service, and Azure SQL), Git, and Azure DevOps or similar CI/CD tooling.
  • A solid understanding of API security, including OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect.
  • Strong debugging and automated testing skills.
  • A strong sense of ownership, from design decisions through production.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, and experience mentoring other developers through code reviews and pairing.

Nice to have:

  • Experience building membership, association, or other line-of-business SaaS applications.
  • Experience with payment processors, ACH, or PCI DSS compliance.
  • Familiarity with accounting concepts such as general ledger, accounts receivable, or reconciliation.
  • Experience with PrimeNG or Kendo UI, or other component suites.
  • Experience building AI-powered features using LLM APIs, retrieval-augmented generation, or multi-step agentic workflows.
  • Experience with real-time communication using SignalR, or with message queues such as Azure Service Bus.
  • Experience working with regulated or sensitive personal data.

jobs.title: Senior IT Project Manager & Application Team Lead (Freelance kan)
jobs.excerpt: 📋 Tâches et responsabilités Senior IT Project Manager / IT Team Lead Une fonction qui combine le pilotage de la delivery IT, le leadership d'équipe et la gestion d'un portefeuille applicatif.
jobs.description:
📋 Tâches et responsabilités

Senior IT Project Manager / IT Team Lead

Une fonction qui combine le pilotage de la delivery IT, le leadership d'équipe et la gestion d'un portefeuille applicatif.

Votre rôle
Au sein du département ICT, vous pilotez les projets IT qui vous sont confiés tout en assurant le leadership de l'équipe applicative.

Vous contribuez à la livraison des projets, à l'organisation et au développement de l'équipe ainsi qu'à la gestion et à l'évolution du portefeuille applicatif. Vous veillez à fournir une visibilité claire et suffisamment anticipée sur l'avancement, les risques, la capacité disponible et les arbitrages nécessaires.

Piloter les projets et la delivery IT
Vous assumez la responsabilité de la delivery IT des projets qui vous sont confiés. Vous assurez la maîtrise du périmètre IT, du planning, des ressources, du budget IT, des risques, des dépendances et de la qualité.

Dans le cadre d'un projet Business, vous prenez en charge le volet IT et sa livraison, en collaboration avec le responsable du projet Business. Vous conservez une vue d'ensemble du projet afin d'identifier et de signaler à temps les risques ou dépendances susceptibles d'affecter la delivery IT. Le reporting global reste sous la responsabilité du responsable du projet Business.

Pour les projets exclusivement IT, vous assurez le pilotage complet du projet jusqu'à sa livraison, y compris le reporting.

Vous anticipez les écarts, analysez l'impact des changements et des nouvelles demandes, puis formulez des propositions pour permettre les décisions et arbitrages nécessaires. Vous assurez le reporting relatif au périmètre dont vous avez la charge.

Diriger et accompagner l'équipe
En tant que Team Lead, vous êtes responsable du fonctionnement opérationnel de l'équipe et du people management.

Vous organisez les activités, définissez les priorités, gérez la capacité et favorisez une collaboration efficace entre les profils impliqués dans l'analyse, le développement, les tests et la mise en production.

Vous accompagnez les collaborateurs dans leur fonctionnement quotidien et leur développement professionnel. Vous veillez à la qualité des activités réalisées, identifiez rapidement les difficultés et les risques, puis prenez les mesures nécessaires ou les escaladez lorsque la situation l'exige.

Gérer la capacité et le portefeuille applicatif
Vous participez activement à la gestion et à l'évolution du portefeuille applicatif de l'équipe.

Vous gardez une vue d'ensemble des besoins liés aux projets, à la maintenance, aux évolutions technologiques, aux risques et à la capacité nécessaire. En concertation avec le management, vous proposez les priorités et arbitrages requis et contribuez aux exercices périodiques de forecast et de planification.

Vous veillez à un équilibre dans l'affectation de la capacité entre les projets, la maintenance et les autres priorités du portefeuille.

Garantir la maîtrise de la delivery
Vous vous assurez que chaque étape de la delivery, de l'analyse à la mise en production, est correctement préparée, coordonnée et suivie.

Vous suivez le planning, le budget IT, le forecast, la capacité, les risques et les dépendances. Vous garantissez une visibilité suffisante sur les écarts et les difficultés.

Vous collaborez étroitement avec le Business, les équipes ICT et les autres parties prenantes afin d'assurer une livraison maîtrisée et de qualité.

📝 Votre profil

Vous disposez d'une expérience senior en gestion de projets et en leadership d'équipes IT.

  • IT Project Management : minimum 8 ans d'expérience;
  • Team Leadership et People Management : minimum 5 ans d'expérience;
  • Gestion du planning, du budget, de la capacité, des risques, des dépendances et des changements : minimum 8 ans d'expérience;
  • Expérience dans des environnements combinant projets et maintenance d'applications : minimum 5 ans;
  • Cycle de développement et de livraison d'applications : minimum 5 ans d'expérience;
  • Azure DevOps : minimum 3 ans d'expérience;
  • Bonne culture technique permettant de comprendre et de challenger les sujets IT sans devoir intervenir comme expert technique;
  • Forte capacité d'analyse, d'anticipation et de prise de décision;
  • Capacité à identifier rapidement les problèmes et à les escalader de manière appropriée;
  • Leadership et communication claire avec des interlocuteurs Business et IT.

Une connaissance de .NET/C#, SQL, des API, des architectures applicatives et des environnements CI/CD constitue un atout.

Langues
Vous avez une excellente maîtrise professionnelle du néerlandais ou du français, ainsi qu'une bonne connaissance de l'autre langue nationale, le français ou le néerlandais.

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Senior IT Project Manager / IT Team Lead

Een rol waarin IT-delivery, teamleiding en het beheer van een applicatieportfolio samenkomen.

Jouw rol
Binnen de ICT-afdeling stuur je de toegewezen IT-projecten aan en neem je tegelijk de leiding over het applicatieteam op.

Je draagt bij aan de oplevering van projecten, de organisatie en ontwikkeling van het team en het beheer en de verdere evolutie van het applicatieportfolio. Je zorgt voor een duidelijke, tijdige en voldoende vooruitziende rapportering over de voortgang, risico's, beschikbare capaciteit en noodzakelijke beslissingen.

🛠️ Verantwoordelijkheden

IT-projecten en delivery aansturen
Je staat in voor de IT-delivery van de projecten die aan jou worden toegewezen. Je bewaakt de IT-scope, de planning, de middelen, het IT-budget, de risico's, de afhankelijkheden en de kwaliteit.

Binnen een Business-project neem je het IT-luik en de bijbehorende oplevering op, in samenwerking met de verantwoordelijke voor het Business-project. Je behoudt een globaal overzicht, zodat je risico's of afhankelijkheden die de IT-delivery kunnen beïnvloeden tijdig identificeert en meldt. De globale rapportering blijft de verantwoordelijkheid van de verantwoordelijke voor het Business-project.

Voor projecten die uitsluitend op IT betrekking hebben, neem je de volledige projectaansturing op tot en met de oplevering, inclusief de rapportering.

Je anticipeert op afwijkingen, analyseert de impact van wijzigingen en nieuwe aanvragen en formuleert voorstellen die de nodige beslissingen en afwegingen ondersteunen. Je rapporteert over het domein waarvoor je verantwoordelijk bent.

Het team aansturen en begeleiden
Als Team Lead ben je verantwoordelijk voor de operationele werking van het team en het people management.

Je organiseert de activiteiten, bepaalt de prioriteiten, beheert de capaciteit en bevordert een efficiënte samenwerking tussen de profielen die betrokken zijn bij analyse, ontwikkeling, testen en ingebruikname.

Je begeleidt medewerkers in hun dagelijkse werking en professionele ontwikkeling. Je bewaakt de kwaliteit van het werk, signaleert moeilijkheden en risico's tijdig en neemt de nodige maatregelen of escaleert wanneer de situatie dat vereist.

De capaciteit en het applicatieportfolio beheren
Je werkt actief mee aan het beheer en de verdere ontwikkeling van het applicatieportfolio van het team.

Je houdt overzicht over de behoeften rond projecten, onderhoud, technologische evoluties, risico's en de vereiste capaciteit. In overleg met het management stel je prioriteiten en noodzakelijke afwegingen voor en draag je bij aan de periodieke forecast- en planningsactiviteiten.

Je zorgt voor een evenwichtige inzet van de beschikbare capaciteit over projecten, onderhoud en andere prioriteiten binnen het portfolio.

De beheersing van de delivery waarborgen
Je zorgt ervoor dat elke stap van het deliveryproces, van analyse tot ingebruikname, correct wordt voorbereid, gecoördineerd en opgevolgd.

Je volgt de planning, het IT-budget, de forecast, de capaciteit, de risico's en de afhankelijkheden op. Je zorgt voor voldoende transparantie over afwijkingen en moeilijkheden.

Je werkt nauw samen met de Business, de ICT-teams en andere stakeholders om een beheerste en kwalitatieve oplevering te verzekeren.

📝 Jouw profiel

Je hebt ruime seniorervaring in projectmanagement en het aansturen van IT-teams.

  • IT Project Management: minstens 8 jaar ervaring;
  • Team Leadership en People Management: minstens 5 jaar ervaring;
  • Beheer van planning, budget, capaciteit, risico's, afhankelijkheden en wijzigingen: minstens 8 jaar ervaring;
  • Ervaring in omgevingen waarin projecten en applicatieonderhoud worden gecombineerd: minstens 5 jaar;
  • Levenscyclus van applicatieontwikkeling en -oplevering: minstens 5 jaar ervaring;
  • Azure DevOps: minstens 3 jaar ervaring;
  • Een goede technische achtergrond, zodat je IT-onderwerpen kunt begrijpen en kritisch kunt bevragen zonder zelf als technisch expert op te treden;
  • Sterk analytisch vermogen, anticipatievermogen en besluitvaardigheid;
  • Het vermogen om problemen tijdig te identificeren en op gepaste wijze te escaleren;
  • Leiderschap en duidelijke communicatie met Business- en IT-betrokkenen.

Kennis van .NET/C#, SQL, API's, applicatiearchitecturen en CI/CD-omgevingen is een pluspunt.

Talenkennis
Je hebt een uitstekende professionele kennis van het Nederlands of het Frans en een goede kennis van de andere landstaal, het Frans of het Nederlands.

💼 Offre

Vous ferez partie d'une PME belge en pleine croissance, où l’initiative et le développement personnel sont encouragés. Department Overview

Welcome to Motorola Solutions. You'll join the CC Insights team as the product moves from pilot to general availability. The team is remote and spread across the US, South Africa, Brazil and India. We build a unified reporting application that combines several analytics products into one AI-assisted experience. It runs on an Angular and .NET web application, an internal Data Platform (Databricks and Azure Synapse), embedded Power BI and an AI Chat that turns natural-language questions into SQL.

As the product matures, more of our backlog is about reliability, data quality, AI answer accuracy and security. This is a new, dedicated quality role. You'll be the first engineer working full-time on our testing foundation across the application, the data pipelines and the AI Chat.


Job Description

We're looking for a Senior SDET to design and build our test automation strategy and tooling across the full stack: the Angular/.NET application, the Databricks/Synapse data pipelines and the AI Chat system. You'll work closely with Full Stack and Data Engineers to catch problems before customers see them, whether that's a broken UI flow, a data load that fails silently or an inaccurate AI-generated answer.

Where You'll Start

You won't be expected to cover everything on day one. In your first 90 days, the priorities are:

  • Foundation: CI quality gates, and automated API and UI tests for our most critical user flows.
  • Data quality: automated checks on the Gold-layer data that feeds customer reports.

After that, you'll extend into AI Chat evaluation, performance and security verification, working with the engineers who own those areas.

Key Responsibilities

  • Testing foundation: Define the team's test strategy and build test frameworks and tooling that the whole team can extend, running as quality gates in our GitHub Actions pipelines.
  • UI and API automation: Modernise end-to-end UI testing and build API test suites for our .NET REST services.
  • Data quality: Implement automated checks across Bronze, Silver and Gold layers: schema drift, null-rate thresholds, duplicates, volume anomalies and source-to-target reconciliation.
  • AI Chat validation: Work with the engineers building the AI Chat to create a "golden question" evaluation set and regression suite that measures whether generated queries return the correct results and catches quality regressions when prompts or models change.
  • Performance: Establish performance baselines and automated load tests for high-volume customers (for example, p95 query latency targets).
  • Pipeline reliability: Test retry, checkpoint/watermark recovery and alerting paths so that failures are detected and recoverable, not silent.
  • Security verification: Validate fixes for findings from our scanning tools (e.g. OWASP ZAP, SonarQube) and confirm them by re-scanning before sign-off.
  • Definition of Done: Help define and enforce automated test coverage across critical user flows, APIs and data pipelines, and sign-off criteria for UI, pipeline and AI work.
  • Mentorship: Encourage a test-first mindset and help engineers write testable, observable code.


Basic Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field.
  • 5+ years in software quality or software engineering, including 3+ years of hands-on test automation in code (not primarily manual testing).
  • Proven experience building or scaling automated test frameworks for web UIs and/or APIs (e.g. Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, xUnit/NUnit, REST API test tooling) and integrating them into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Proficiency in at least one of C#/.NET, TypeScript or Python for writing test code.
  • Strong SQL, with experience validating data correctness (reconciliation queries, data quality checks, testing reports or analytics data).
  • Daily use of AI-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) as part of your workflow.
  • Advanced (C1) English, written and spoken, for working with globally distributed teams.
