Role: Senior Engineering Manager

Location: Remote, UK

Team: Development & AI

Job Type: Full-time, Permanent (37.5 hours)

Salary: Competitive, based on experience + benefits + package

Security Clearance Requirements

Please note that holding a current Security Clearance is not essential at the time of application, but eligibility is required.

This role requires the successful candidate to be eligible for Security Check (SC) clearance. To meet this requirement, applicants must:

  • Have the right to work in the UK
  • Have lived in the UK continuously for the past 5 years
  • Not have spent more than 6 months outside the UK in total during that period
  • Be willing to undergo security vetting as part of the onboarding process

About Us

Come and be a part of The Investigo Group(TIG), a dynamic coalition of cutting-edge tech firms specialising in Platform, Software, Data, AI and other bleeding-edge technology solutions. Our innovative prowess spans the globe while proudly hailing from the United Kingdom.

The group is multi-functional with a large portfolio of B2B products and services.

Our ecosystem is made up of:

Voixtel, secure communications and voice platforms for regulated and critical environments.

IIS, Providing secure internet access in both the public and private sectors. Its mission? To deliver world-class secure internet capabilities enhancing productivity across diverse skillsets and organisations.

Vestigo Consulting is our training and consultancy company, tailored around specialist sector-specific knowledge, and provides regular courses and CPD for our community. The Consultancy side concentrates on expert support of our customers as well as specifically assigned individual deployments.

Collaboraite is a bleeding-edge company that provides our Data and AI capability. A collaborative partner for designing user-centred secure data solutions to overcome operational hurdles, delivered through design thinking and agile coaching.

Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) are at the heart of The Investigo Group (TIG). We're dedicated to creating a workplace where people from all backgrounds are not only welcome but empowered to excel. We actively seek diverse talent, promote fairness, and foster an inclusive environment where every voice matters, driving innovation and progress in our dynamic tech community.

The group provides bespoke, secure, user-centric products fuelled by deep technical knowledge advanced data and analytical skills.

We proudly stand as a global leader in this space, partnering with esteemed entities that require these advanced forward-thinking capabilities. These partnerships have been forged from our understanding of customer challenges, as well as our expertise in developing world-leading enterprise product sets.

Join us at TIG, where innovation knows no bounds, and together, we'll shape the future of technology solutions for a safer, more efficient world.

About the Role

Are you an experienced Engineering Manager who genuinely enjoys developing people, building effective teams and creating an environment where engineers can do their best work?

We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to join our Development & AI organisation, taking a leading role in supporting our engineering people, strengthening management practices and helping our teams operate effectively as we continue to grow.

Our engineering organisation brings together a broad range of technical disciplines, each with different challenges, specialisms and development needs. As our teams evolve, we want to ensure our engineers have the leadership, support, career opportunities and working environment they need to succeed.

This is a senior, people-focused leadership position. You'll take ownership of day-to-day engineering management, working with both individual contributors and engineering managers to develop capability, improve collaboration and establish consistent, effective ways of working.

You'll also play an important role in engineering resource and capacity planning, recruitment, performance management and continuous improvement, helping ensure our teams have the right skills, structures and support to meet current and future priorities.

Importantly, this isn't a hands-on coding or technical architecture role. You'll need a strong understanding of software engineering and the challenges engineers face, but your real impact will come through developing people, improving organisational effectiveness and enabling great engineering work to happen.

Working closely with our Director of Development & AI, technical leadership and product stakeholders, you'll help shape a positive, collaborative and sustainable engineering environment.

If you're passionate about engineering leadership, enjoy solving organisational challenges and believe that great teams are built through trust, accountability and genuine investment in people, we'd love to hear from you.

About the team

You'll join our Development & AI organisation, working with talented engineers across frontend, backend, full-stack, desktop development, machine learning engineering (MLE) and quality assurance (QA).

Our teams work with a diverse technology stack, including:

  • Backend: Go (Golang), Java and Python
  • Frontend: React and TypeScript
  • Desktop: C#/.NET
  • Machine Learning Engineering: Python
  • Engineering practices: Cloud-native development, CI/CD, automated testing and modern software delivery

We work across a range of interesting technical challenges, from mobile emulation and streaming technologies to sovereign AI platforms and other specialist software solutions.

Our engineering structure includes dedicated technical leadership responsible for architecture, engineering standards and technical direction.

As Senior Engineering Manager, you'll work alongside these technical specialists, providing complementary leadership focused on people, management capability, engineering culture and team effectiveness.

We value technical excellence, collaborative problem-solving, personal ownership and continuous improvement. We're looking for someone who can help us build on those foundations and create an environment where engineers feel supported, challenged and empowered to develop.

What You'll Be Doing

    • Providing visible, approachable and effective leadership to engineers and engineering managers, creating an environment built on trust, accountability and collaboration.
    • Coaching, mentoring and developing individual contributors, existing managers and emerging engineering leaders.
    • Establishing consistent people management practices, including regular one-to-ones, constructive feedback, performance reviews and personal development planning.
    • Supporting engineers with career development, progression opportunities and clear expectations across different engineering disciplines.
    • Managing performance and addressing people-related challenges fairly, proactively and constructively, working alongside our People team where appropriate.
    • Taking ownership of engineering resource and capacity planning, ensuring our teams have the right people and capabilities to support business and delivery priorities.
    • Working with the Director of Development & AI and recruitment teams on hiring priorities, workforce planning, onboarding, retention and future skills requirements.
    • Identifying organisational bottlenecks, inefficient processes and opportunities to improve how engineering teams collaborate and deliver.
    • Working closely with product, delivery and technical leadership to improve planning, communication, dependencies and delivery predictability.
    • Helping establish meaningful measures of team health, engineering effectiveness and continuous improvement.
    • Supporting positive engineering practices that balance delivery commitments with sustainable workloads, individual wellbeing and long-term development.
    • Providing clear visibility of engineering capacity, capability gaps, organisational risks and development needs to senior stakeholders.

About You

More than anything, we're looking for an experienced, approachable and people-focused engineering leader who genuinely enjoys helping others succeed.

You'll understand that successful engineering management is about much more than tracking delivery or managing workloads. It's about building trust, developing capability, supporting individuals through challenges and creating the conditions for teams to perform consistently well.

You'll be comfortable having difficult conversations, addressing performance concerns and making balanced decisions that combine empathy with accountability.

You'll also be someone who can recognise when engineering processes or organisational structures aren't working effectively, bring people together to understand the challenges and introduce practical improvements without adding unnecessary complexity.

We'd particularly welcome candidates who have progressed from a software engineering background into management and understand the different challenges faced by engineers working across multiple technical disciplines.

You don't need to be the most technically knowledgeable person in the room. What matters is having the credibility to engage with technical specialists, an appreciation of modern engineering practices and the confidence to lead through people rather than technical authority.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role isn't simply about managing teams or introducing new processes. It's about building an engineering organisation where people have the leadership and support they need, teams work effectively together and delivery becomes increasingly predictable and sustainable.

Within your first three months, you'll have built trusted relationships across the engineering organisation, developed an understanding of our people, strengths and challenges, and identified the opportunities where your leadership can make the biggest difference.

Within six months, you'll be helping establish more consistent management and development practices, clearer expectations for engineers and managers, and practical improvements to planning, communication and collaboration across teams.

Within twelve months, we want to see an engineering organisation where people feel supported in their careers, managers are confident and effective, teams collaborate well, and leadership has greater visibility of engineering capacity and delivery risks.

Ultimately, you'll help us build an environment that can continue to grow and evolve without unnecessary bureaucracy, where engineers feel both supported and challenged to do their best work.

Requirements

Skills & Experience We Are Looking For

You don't need to tick every box. We're interested in candidates who can demonstrate strong engineering management experience, genuine leadership capability and a track record of helping individuals and teams succeed.

People Leadership & Development

  • Proven experience in software engineering management, with significant responsibility for people leadership, development and team effectiveness.
  • Experience managing individual contributors and engineering managers, or a demonstrable ability to lead through other managers.
  • A strong track record of coaching, mentoring and developing engineers at different stages of their careers.
  • Experience establishing effective performance management, feedback and career development practices.
  • Confidence managing complex people situations, including underperformance, interpersonal challenges and organisational change.
  • The ability to build positive, inclusive team environments that balance individual wellbeing with accountability and delivery expectations.

Engineering Management & Operations

  • Experience improving engineering working practices, team coordination, resource planning and delivery effectiveness.
  • Strong understanding of modern software engineering environments and the challenges involved in multidisciplinary software delivery.
  • Experience working with product and delivery stakeholders to improve prioritisation, planning and delivery predictability.
  • Ability to identify organisational bottlenecks and introduce proportionate, practical improvements.
  • Experience developing or implementing career frameworks, competency expectations or structured progression pathways.
  • Experience managing remote or distributed engineering teams.
  • Strong organisational awareness, stakeholder management and communication skills.

Technical Understanding & Collaboration

  • A solid understanding of modern software development lifecycles, CI/CD, automated testing and software delivery practices.
  • Sufficient technical knowledge to understand engineering challenges, engage with specialists and contribute meaningfully to engineering planning discussions.
  • Ability to work effectively alongside dedicated technical leaders, respecting the distinction between technical direction and people management.
  • Confidence translating technical and delivery challenges into appropriate people, capability or organisational actions.

Expert-level knowledge of our specific programming languages or frameworks isn't required, and this position does not involve routine hands-on development.

We're more interested in your ability to understand the challenges facing engineering teams and demonstrate how your leadership has helped people and organisations improve.

Nice to Have

Experience or exposure to some of the following would be beneficial:

  • Managing multidisciplinary teams spanning frontend, backend, full-stack, desktop development, machine learning engineering or QA.
  • Experience within cloud-native, SaaS, desktop software or other modern product-led technology environments.
  • Supporting engineering organisations through growth, transformation or changes to team structures.
  • Developing engineering career ladders, management frameworks or leadership development programmes.
  • Familiarity with Agile and Lean practices, engineering delivery metrics and continuous improvement approaches.
  • Experience partnering with Staff Engineers, Principal Engineers, Technical Leads or other dedicated technical leadership roles.
  • Formal management, coaching or leadership development training.

A degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related discipline may be beneficial, but isn't essential. We value demonstrable engineering management capability, relevant experience and proven leadership outcomes over formal qualifications.

Benefits

    • Private Medical & Health Cash Plan
    • 4x Life Assurance
    • Inclusive Culture: Enjoy an inclusive culture and environment.
    • Holiday: Generous holiday allowance.
    • Learning: Access to continuous learning and development opportunities.
    • Bonus Potential: Bonus potential based on performance and business-related factors.
    • Pension: Pension scheme contributions.
    • EV Car Scheme
    • More Benefits: Explore additional benefits on our career site.

How to Apply

Please note that the talent acquisition team is managing this vacancy directly and we do not require agency support.

Candidates who are successful will be required to undergo relevant security checks.

Our Process

Our talent acquisition team will be in touch if you're successful, the team will arrange a short screening call (max 30 minutes) to learn more about you, and what you are looking for and answer any questions you may have. If all goes well, the team will share your profile with the hiring manager for review. Our interview process is tailored to each role.

As an inclusive employer, please inform us if you require any reasonable adjustments.

Equal Opportunities

Here at TIG we are committed to equal opportunities and value diversity, equity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, sex, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

As a Group, we seek to ensure that individuals with disabilities receive reasonable accommodation throughout the hiring process and ultimately within the job itself. Please contact us to request any accommodations.

AAI/Ré uma empresa de tecnologia que coloca a inteligência artificial no centro da transformação digital de grandes marcas.

Na frente de RUN, a área de Growth & Digital Experience reúne Martech, Design, SEO/GEO e CRO. Nosso trabalho é fazer marcas serem encontradas, escolhidas e convertidas através de estratégias de crescimento, impactando diretamente os resultados dos nossos clientes. Atendemos marcas líderes em setores como aviação, varejo farmacêutico, cosméticos, construção e saúde.

Sobre a vaga

Buscamos pessoas Analistas de CRO Júnior ou Pleno com experiência em desenvolvimento front-end para construir e implementar testes A/B e personalizações nos sites e apps de grandes marcas, do código à leitura do resultado.

Você vai transformar hipóteses de otimização em experimentos no ar, em diferentes ferramentas de experimentação, com qualidade técnica, mensuração correta e aprendizado para o negócio. O trabalho é lado a lado com estrategistas de CRO, designers e analistas de dados, em contato com os times de marketing, produto e tecnologia dos clientes.

O que esperamos

  • Júnior:Implementa testes e personalizações a partir de especificações prontas, com revisão de código e QA acompanhados por uma pessoa mais experiente.
  • Pleno:Implementa com autonomia em várias ferramentas, estima esforço, propõe soluções técnicas, conduz a análise de resultados e apoia decisões de negócio.

Desenvolvimento e implementação de experimentos

  • Desenvolver variações de testes A/B, multivariados e split URL em JavaScript, HTML e CSS, a partir de hipóteses e protótipos de design.
  • Implementar personalizações por segmento, comportamento, origem de tráfego e etapa da jornada.
  • Operar múltiplas ferramentas de experimentação e personalização, como Adobe Target, Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization, Optimizely, VWO, AB Tasty e Dynamic Yield, adaptando a implementação a cada uma.
  • Garantir QA cross-browser e cross-device, sem flicker e sem impacto em Core Web Vitals, inclusive em SPAs e sites em React, Vue ou
  • Compreender sobre eventos com GA4, Google Tag Manager e camadas de dados para medir cada experimento.
  • Criar componentes e templates reutilizáveis para acelerar a implementação entre contas.

Análise e aprendizado

  • Acompanhar os testes no ar, monitorando amostra, divisão de tráfego e integridade dos dados.
  • Analisar resultados com rigor estatístico (significância, poder e duração) e segmentar para encontrar aprendizados.
  • Usar analytics, heatmaps e gravações de sessão para entender o funil e gerar novas hipóteses.
  • Documentar experimentos e resultados no repositório de aprendizados de cada conta.

Clientes e operação

  • Estimar esforço técnico e apoiar a priorização do roadmap de experimentos.
  • Apresentar resultados e recomendações nos ritos com os clientes.
  • Alinhar a implementação com os times de tecnologia dos clientes, respeitando seus ambientes e processos de publicação.

  • Disposição para aprender e operar diferentes ferramentas de experimentação e personalização.
  • Uso de IA generativa para acelerar o desenvolvimento e a análise de testes.
  • Conhecimento de GA4 e Google Tag Manager: eventos, data layer e validação de tags.
  • Capacidade analítica: leitura de resultados, noções de estatística aplicada a experimentos e análise de dados em planilhas.
  • Noções de UX, usabilidade e boas práticas de conversão em e-commerce e sites de grande porte.
  • Versionamento com Git e código organizado e documentado.
  • Comunicação clara para explicar decisões técnicas e resultados a públicos não técnicos.

Diferenciais

  • Visão estratégica e de negócios: conectar experimentos a metas de receita, conversão e retenção, e priorizar pelo impacto no negócio.
  • Experiência com mais de uma ferramenta de experimentação, especialmente Adobe Target, Salesforce Marketing Cloud Personalization, Optimizely ou VWO.
  • JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5 e CSS3, com manipulação de DOM e debugging no navegador (DevTools).
  • Experiência com React, Vue ou e com plataformas como VTEX, Salesforce Commerce Cloud ou Adobe Experience Manager.
  • SQL, BigQuery ou Python para análise de dados.
  • Inglês para leitura e conversação.

We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$400-US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

Remote, any location. US$400-US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

How it works

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.

  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.

  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.

  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.

  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.

  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.

  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering

  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)

  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++

  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing

  • Regular use of an AI coding tool

  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models

  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words

  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now

Nice to have

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure

Terms

About Silent Eight

We’ve been a trusted partner to the world’s largest financial institutions for over a decade, with AI running in production at global banks including HSBC and Standard Chartered. We automate the compliance decisions that stop money laundering and terrorism financing, at scale, in production, on real cases.

We’re headquartered in Singapore with our engineering hub in Poland, and we’re hiring an AI Developer based in Poland (anywhere in the country): a builder who designs and ships complex AI systems that actually work. We’re keeping a high bar for this hire and are looking for exceptional people who meet the full profile below.

The Role

This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who builds with AI every day. You’ll be one of the main builders behind our AI solutions: designing and shipping agentic systems, multi-step workflows and LLM-based applications, and taking them from first prototype to something reliable that people use.

You won’t need to lead customer conversations. Our client-facing AI consultants bring the problems; you work out how to solve them and build the solution. We’re looking for a real developer with solid engineering fundamentals who lives and breathes AI, not someone who only generates code with AI tools.

What You’ll Do

  • Design, build and ship complex AI systems, including agentic systems, multi-step workflows and LLM-based applications

  • Work closely with our AI consultants to turn customer problems into working technical solutions

  • Build RAG pipelines, tool-calling agents and integrations between LLMs, data sources and our platform

  • Test, evaluate and monitor what you build, with an eye on quality, reliability and cost

  • Solve hard, open-ended problems end to end, from prototype to production

  • Use agents to automate work and deliver measurable results across the business, including areas such as marketing

  • Keep testing new models, tools and techniques, and share what works with the team

What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years of professional software development experience: you write, review, test and maintain production-quality code yourself

  • Strong Python skills; TypeScript/Node.js is a plus

  • Proven hands-on experience building complex AI systems yourself, such as agentic systems or multi-step workflows, and taking them to production, not only prototypes. A simple app for a simple task isn’t enough

  • Practical experience with LLMs: RAG, embeddings and vector databases, tool and function calling, structured outputs and prompt engineering

  • Experience with agent and LLM frameworks such as LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Agent SDK or MCP

  • Good working English C1 level

  • Based in Poland

  • Experience in financial services, AML/FinCrime or other regulated environments, or using agents to drive results in business functions such as marketing, is a plus

What We Offer

  • A B2B contract with a competitive salary: PLN 25,000–35,000 net / month + VAT

  • Paid time off to balance work and life in the way that suits you best

  • Fully remote work, forever

  • A quarterly wellness allowance added directly to your invoice

  • Real opportunities for development, including paid Development Days and in-house training

  • A product that already works, with AI in production at Tier 1 banks, so you’re solving real problems for real customers

  • Direct access to our leadership team and short decision paths

  • The chance to be an integral part of an award-winning, fast-growing RegTech company that values a friendly working atmosphere

jobs.description:
Why this role exists

We've just moved our CRM to HubSpot and we're modernising . We want one connected system, from the first website visit to a closed deal, that Marketing and Sales both trust and that runs without manual effort. Today too much of our reporting is still done by hand, and our measurement has grown faster than its foundations.

We need one engineer to own the systems behind our growth. You'll architect HubSpot across marketing and sales, ship front-end code on , own the tracking layer and automate the rest. You won't be a product engineer, a designer, a copywriter or a Sales help desk. You'll build the engine that Marketing and Sales run on.

This is a remote-first position. We're looking for a person to be based in the UK, Poland or Switzerland, with occassional trips to our head office in Zurich.

What you'll own

HubSpot and RevOps systems (about 35% of your time)

  • Architecture of our HubSpot portal across Marketing and Sales: data model, custom objects, properties and governance
  • Pipeline and deal-stage configuration, lifecycle stages and lead routing, built with Sales leadership, who own the sales process
  • Attribution from first touch to closed deal, so we know which channels create revenue, not just leads
  • Lead scoring and intent signals that help Sales prioritise
  • Integrations and data quality: syncing HubSpot with our platform data in Databricks, ad platforms and enrichment, with deduplication and property hygiene
  • Self-serve pipeline and marketing dashboards, so teams get answers without filing requests
  • Using CRM data on the website (smart forms, personalisation), making practical use of HubSpot's AI features, and keeping a roadmap of what to build next
  • Deliverability, plus a modular email template system for HubSpot and Intercom

Website and front-end (about 25%)

  • Front-end development of coople.com: page templates, reusable components, Prismic CMS integration and landing pages
  • Performance, Core Web Vitals, accessibility (WCAG) and code quality
  • Technical SEO and AI-search discoverability: structured data, crawlability, multilingual setup (DE/FR/IT/EN, hreflang)
  • Marketing's technical lead on the website modernisation programme, including evaluating CMS options. You'll use AI-assisted development to ship at pace, working with our Engineering team, who own infrastructure and deployment standards

Measurement (about 20%)

  • The tracking layer end to end: tag management, event schemas, conversion tracking, and consent under GDPR and Swiss nFADP
  • Monitoring and alerting, so broken tracking is found in hours, not at month-end
  • Connecting web and product analytics to CRM outcomes, with the analytics and data teams owning KPI definitions and warehouse models

Automation and experimentation (about 20%)

  • Internal tools and AI-built automations that remove manual reporting and data-shuffling
  • Keeping the stack lean: tool audits, UTM and naming governance, documented schemas
  • Designing, building and reading out tests across the website and the funnel, starting from a clear hypothesis
  • Bringing your own growth ideas to the team, not just building other people's

Where the line sits: you build and run the systems; marketers decide what goes through them. Campaigns, content and copy stay with Marketing. The sales process, forecasting and enablement stay with Sales leadership. Batch changes and large admin updates are handled with our HubSpot partner, and dashboards are self-serve.

What success looks like

  • First 90 days: a HubSpot health check across Marketing and Sales with a prioritised roadmap, a documented tracking plan, the first ad-hoc reports replaced by self-serve dashboards, and your first components shipped to coople.com
  • First 12 months: one trusted view from first visit to closed deal, lead scoring and routing that Sales actually use, clean CRM data synced with our platform, a faster site delivered through the modernisation programme, and a measurably smaller manual-reporting load

What you'll bring

Must have

  • Experience owning a CRM's data model and configuration. HubSpot is preferred, but Salesforce or Marketo experience counts if you're ready to get HubSpot-certified within your first three months
  • Depth in analytics and tag management: GA4, Google Tag Manager (including server-side), consent mode, event design
  • Comfort with data: you can write SQL, work with APIs and shape data in Python or JavaScript
  • A track record of automating recurring work, including with AI tools, that you can show us
  • Day-to-day use of AI-assisted development (for example Claude Code, Cursor or Copilot), with the judgement to review what it produces
  • Proven front-end skills: you have shipped production pages or components with semantic HTML, modern CSS and JavaScript/TypeScript, ideally in a component-based framework (React/Next.js, TBC) with a headless CMS
  • Around 4+ years in web development, marketing technology, RevOps or growth engineering.
  • Fluent English, and the ability to say no to stakeholders constructively
  • The right to work in the country you're based in (UK, PL or CH)

Nice to have

  • RevOps remit like: pipeline design, lead routing, sales-marketing handover
  • Previous experience as a Data Engineer or a CRM Manager could relevant
  • HubSpot development (HubL, custom objects, Operations Hub, APIs)
  • Experimentation tooling (PostHog, Optimizely, VWO) and basic statistics for test readouts
  • Databricks or another data warehouse
  • Responsive email development, multilingual sites, or B2B marketplace experience

Our stack

HubSpot, Prismic, front-end framework (TBC), GA4, Google Tag Manager, PostHog, Intercom, Databricks, Supermetrics, Notion, plus whatever AI tooling helps you work faster. You'll help shape what we keep.

How we hire

  1. Screening call with our inhouse recruiter (20 min)
  2. Intro call with the Head of Growth Marketing (30 min, video)
  3. Technical conversation with Engineering about front-end and tracking (45 min)
  4. A short practical task based on a real HubSpot or automation problem, followed by a walkthrough (60 min)
  5. Conversation with Sales leadership and/or other relevant future team mates (in person or video)

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.excerpt: We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production.
jobs.description:
We are an AI-first company building innovative agentic frameworks, the systems that let LLM-driven agents research, plan, and act reliably in production. That means orchestrating multi-step workflows with retries, skips, and parallel execution; keeping long-running work persistent and observable; and serving per-tenant retrieval at scale. This isn't about wrapping an LLM in an API call, it's the hard backend engineering that makes agents dependable.

Our stack is Python (FastAPI) on AWS, with Terraform. We hire on engineering depth and judgment, not on a keyword count, and we work in whichever language you're strongest in during the interview (more below). As a Senior Engineer, you will own backend services and the orchestration layer on top of them, from design through deployment, operation, and the on-call that follows.

Our team is based in Tehran and pays salaries monthly in USD.

What You Will Do:

  • Design, build, and own backend services and the agent-orchestration layer end to end.

  • Build resilient systems that stay correct under load and degrade gracefully when a model, tool, or dependency fails.

  • Ensure operational excellence by making long-running, multi-step work observable and debuggable in production.

  • Shape technical direction through rigorous code reviews, mentorship, and pushing back on specifications when they misalign with engineering reality.

  • Drive the full software development lifecycle, translating ambiguous requirements into durable architectures and actionable technical plans.

What We Are Looking For:

  • 5+ years building and operating production backend systems, with deep ownership of at least one non-trivial service you can talk through end to end.

  • Deep fluency in your primary backend language, and the ability to pick up a new one fast. We work in Python; if it is not your daily language today, we expect you to ramp quickly.

  • Strong systems fundamentals — concurrency, data modeling, and failure modes — and the judgment to choose the right abstraction rather than the cleverest one.

  • Sound reasoning under ambiguity: you ask the clarifying question first, make the trade-offs explicit, and adapt when the constraints change.

  • Solid grasp of infrastructure and operations, including message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ), SQL and NoSQL stores, and running services in containers with an orchestrator (Kubernetes, ECS, Nomad, or similar).

  • Professional written English, enabling you to write crisp design documents and align stakeholders on complex technical trade-offs.

Even Better:

  • AWS (especially ECS) and Terraform, or comparable cloud and Infrastructure-as-Code experience.

  • Hands-on work with LLM, agentic, or RAG systems (LangChain, CrewAI, OpenAI/Anthropic SDKs, Hugging Face) and a real grasp of how non-deterministic agent steps differ from ordinary functions.

  • A recognized-bar engineering background, owned open-source work, or another verifiable standout signal.

How We Hire:

We use a deliberate, transparent two-stage process designed to see how you think and build:

  • 1. A 120-minute conversation focusing on your background and a collaborative system-design exercise and cultural fit..

  • 2. A 120-minute live technical session involving code review, live coding, and a self-review.

You may complete the technical session in your strongest language (Python, Go, Java, Kotlin, PHP, or TypeScript/Node.js). Web search is encouraged; AI assistants are not used. We want to see your fundamental engineering judgment.

What We Offer:

  • Competitive USD-based salary and a comprehensive benefits package.

  • Hybrid work flexibility with hours that support deep work.

  • The opportunity to work at the frontier of agentic AI, tackling hard problems with high ownership.

  • A highly educated, agile senior team that values pragmatism, learning, and continuous improvement.

If you would rather be judged on how you think than on a buzzword list, we would like to talk!
